We are currently looking for a full-time Estimator & Project Coordinator in the Philippines to work directly with the owner of the company.

This is intended to be a long-term position for the right person.

You will work closely with me every day through webcam, screen sharing,
, phone and online project-management tools.

This is not a basic data-entry or general virtual assistant position.

You will become part of our estimating and project-management team.



----------------------------------------





THE JOB



Echo Glazing is invited to bid approximately 5–10 commercial glass projects every month throughout the Vancouver, British Columbia area.

Your primary responsibility will be assisting with glass and aluminum quantity takeoffs and estimating from architectural drawings.

You will work directly with me to review drawings, determine quantities, organize estimates and prepare projects for bidding.

Once we are awarded a project, your responsibilities will expand into project planning, budgeting, purchasing, design, drawings and scheduling.

We will work together as a team.

The goal is to build a strong long-term working relationship and grow the company quickly.



----------------------------------------





ESTIMATING RESPONSIBILITIES



You will learn and assist with estimating commercial glazing projects, including:

 * Curtain wall

 * Aluminum storefront

 * Glass

 * Glass canopies

 * Glass guardrails

 * Frameless all-glass doors

 * Aluminum swing doors

 * Sliding doors

 * Commercial entrance systems

 * Aluminum framing

 * Door hardware

 * Glass hardware

 * Sealants and related materials



Your estimating responsibilities will include:

 * Reviewing architectural drawings

 * Reading floor plans and elevations

 * Reviewing architectural details

 * Performing glass quantity takeoffs

 * Performing aluminum quantity takeoffs

 * Counting doors and openings

 * Measuring dimensions

 * Creating Excel takeoff sheets

 * Organizing project quantities

 * Requesting supplier quotations

 * Comparing supplier pricing

 * Preparing estimates

 * Updating pricing

 * Tracking bids

 * Following up on quotations

 * Preparing bid submissions



You will be trained in our specific estimating process.

You do not need to be an expert in commercial glazing when you start, but you must be comfortable learning technical information and reading architectural drawings.



----------------------------------------





PROJECT COORDINATION



When Echo Glazing is awarded a project, you will also assist with project coordination.

Responsibilities will include:





PROJECT PLANNING



 * Review contract documents

 * Review architectural drawings

 * Create project schedules

 * Identify required materials

 * Identify long-lead items

 * Create project checklists

 * Track project deadlines

 * Coordinate with suppliers

 * Track outstanding information





PURCHASING



Assist with purchasing:

 * Aluminum

 * Curtain wall

 * Storefront

 * Glass

 * Doors

 * Door hardware

 * Glass hardware

 * Sealants

 * Membranes

 * Other project materials



You will communicate with suppliers and help track:

What was ordered → when it was ordered → when it is expected → where it needs to go → whether it has arrived.





BUDGETING



Assist with:

 * Project budgets

 * Material costs

 * Supplier quotations

 * Purchase orders

 * Cost tracking

 * Project changes

 * Comparing estimated costs to actual costs





DESIGN / DRAWINGS



Assist with basic design and drafting using AutoCAD.

You may work with:

 * Shop drawings

 * Door drawings

 * Aluminum details

 * Glass details

 * Field dimensions

 * Architectural drawings

 * Fabrication information





SCHEDULING



Help maintain project schedules and coordinate:

 * Glass deliveries

 * Aluminum deliveries

 * Door deliveries

 * Hardware

 * Site readiness

 * Installation requirements

 * Supplier lead times



----------------------------------------





REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



You should have experience with:





MICROSOFT OFFICE



 * Microsoft Excel — REQUIRED

 * Microsoft Word

 * Microsoft Outlook





DRAWING / PDF SOFTWARE



 * AutoCAD — REQUIRED

 * Adobe Acrobat Pro — REQUIRED

 * Experience working with architectural drawings





AI



 * Basic experience using ChatGPT or other AI tools

 * Ability to write basic AI prompts

 * Interest in learning how AI can be used to improve estimating and project management



You do not need to be an AI expert.

You simply need to be comfortable using AI and willing to learn.



----------------------------------------





THE IDEAL CANDIDATE



We are looking for someone who is:

Highly organized

Very detail-oriented

Good with numbers

Good with Excel

Comfortable reading drawings

Good at communicating in English

Reliable

Self-motivated

Fast learner

Comfortable working with computers

Interested in construction

Interested in learning and growing with the company

You should be comfortable working directly with the owner through webcam every day.

You should also be comfortable asking questions when you don't understand something.

We would much rather have someone say:

> "I'm not sure what this detail means. Can you explain it?"



than someone who guesses.



----------------------------------------





ENGLISH REQUIREMENT



Excellent written and spoken English is important.

You will be communicating directly with me every day.

You may also eventually communicate with:

 * Suppliers

 * Manufacturers

 * Architects

 * Contractors

 * Project managers

 * Customers



You must therefore be able to communicate clearly and professionally in English.



----------------------------------------





WORKING HOURS



This is a full-time position.





MONDAY – FRIDAY



9:00 AM – 4:00 PM Pacific Time

This corresponds to evening/night hours in the Philippines.

You must be able to consistently work these hours.

Because you will be working directly with me through webcam, being available during these hours is a requirement.



----------------------------------------





COMPENSATION



Starting salary:





$600–$1,000 USD PER MONTH



Salary will depend on:

 * Experience

 * AutoCAD ability

 * Excel ability

 * Construction experience

 * Estimating experience

 * English communication

 * Ability to learn



There is significant opportunity for increased responsibility and compensation as you become more experienced.

Our goal is to find someone who can grow with the company.



----------------------------------------





LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



We are not looking for someone who wants to work with us for a few months.

We are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term member of the Echo Glazing team.

You will have the opportunity to learn:

Commercial construction

→ Glass & aluminum

→ Estimating

→ Project management

→ Purchasing

→ Budgeting

→ AutoCAD

→ Construction scheduling

→ AI-assisted project management

As your knowledge increases, your responsibilities will increase.

Our goal is to grow the company and build a larger team quickly.

The right person can grow with us.



----------------------------------------





HOW TO APPLY



Please answer ALL of the following questions.





1. CONSTRUCTION EXPERIENCE



Tell us about your experience with construction, architecture, engineering, estimating or project coordination.





2. ARCHITECTURAL DRAWINGS



Have you worked with architectural drawings?

If yes, what types of drawings have you worked with?





3. ESTIMATING



Have you ever performed a construction quantity takeoff?

If yes, describe what you have taken off.





4. EXCEL



Rate your Excel skills from 1–10.

Please describe what you can do in Excel.





5. AUTOCAD



Rate your AutoCAD skills from 1–10.

Please describe your AutoCAD experience.





6. ADOBE ACROBAT PRO



How have you used Adobe Acrobat Pro?





7. AI



Have you used ChatGPT or other AI tools?

If yes, give an example of how you have used AI in your work.





8. ENGLISH



Please tell us about your English communication skills.





9. WORKING HOURS



Confirm that you are available to work:

Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–4:00 PM Pacific Time.





10. SALARY



What monthly salary are you expecting?





11. LONG-TERM EMPLOYMENT



Are you looking for a long-term full-time position?

Please explain.





12. IMPORTANT



At the very beginning of your application, write:

"I READ THE ENTIRE JOB POSTING AND I AM AVAILABLE TO WORK 9AM–4PM PACIFIC TIME."

Applications that do not include this sentence may not be considered.



----------------------------------------





INTERVIEW & TESTING



Shortlisted applicants will have a video interview with the owner.

We may also provide a short practical test involving:

 * Architectural drawings

 * Glass takeoff

 * Aluminum takeoff

 * Excel

 * AutoCAD

 * Basic estimating

 * Problem solving



The purpose of the test is to see how you think and how accurately you work.

We are looking for someone who can become an important part of our company.





IF YOU ARE INTELLIGENT, ORGANIZED, HARDWORKING, INTERESTED IN CONSTRUCTION AND WANT A LONG-TERM CAREER OPPORTUNITY WITH A CANADIAN CONSTRUCTION COMPANY, WE WANT TO HEAR FROM YOU.



Apply today.

title: Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer (Remote)
description:
Job brief

A US-based agency is looking for a Quality Assurance (QA) engineer to develop and execute manual and automated tests to ensure product quality.



QA engineer responsibilities include designing and implementing tests, debugging and defining corrective actions. You will also review system requirements and track quality assurance metrics (e.g. defect densities and open defect counts.)



The QA Engineer role plays an important part in our company’s product development process. Our ideal candidate will be responsible for conducting tests throughout Sprints and before product launches to ensure software runs smoothly and meets client needs, while being cost-effective. If you hold a QA Automation background and enjoy providing end-to-end solutions to software quality problems, we’d like to meet you.



Ultimately, you should monitor all stages of software development to identify and resolve system malfunctions to meet quality standards.



Responsibilities

Review requirements, specifications and technical design documents to provide timely and meaningful feedback

Create detailed, comprehensive and well-structured test plans and test cases

Estimate, prioritize, plan and coordinate testing activities

Design, develop and execute automation scripts using open source tools

Identify, record, document thoroughly and track bugs

Perform thorough regression testing when bugs are resolved

Develop and apply testing processes for new and existing products to meet client needs

Liaise with internal teams (e.g. developers and product managers) to identify system requirements

Monitor debugging process results

Investigate the causes of non-conforming software and train users to implement solutions

Track quality assurance metrics, like defect densities and open defect counts

Stay up-to-date with new testing tools and test strategies

Requirements

Proven work experience in software development

Proven work experience in software quality assurance

Strong knowledge of software QA methodologies, tools and processes

Experience in writing clear, concise and comprehensive test plans and test cases

Hands-on experience with both white box and black box testing

Hands-on experience with automated testing tools (such as Cypress or Selenium) 

Hands-on experience with UI automation

Hands-on experience in testing APIs through Postman

Knowledge of SQL and direct database testing

Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development process

Experience with performance and/or security testing is a plus



To be considered for an interview, please apply online on our form here (you will need to upload a current Resume/CV): 
/ilOIG



We will not entertain any applications via private messages on this platform.

Comfort working inside a CRM to manage and report on a pipeline

A track record (or clear evidence) of owning and hitting aggressive targets under time pressure

Strong multi-tasking and project-management instincts; you deliver on time, every time

Why Join Us

title: Biomedical Researcher — Basic Medical Knowledge
description:
Remote | Paid project with potential for ongoing work



I am seeking someone with extensive or limited biomedical researcher experience to build a detailed, source-backed knowledge base covering multiple myeloma, Natural Killer Cells and the biological elements connected to it.



Project objective



The ultimate goal is to create a comprehensive, organized research collection that can be supplied to an AI system for analysis without requiring additional internet searches.



The collection must contain the underlying explanations, study findings, biological mechanisms, and evidence—not merely links or brief summaries. Its purpose is to support investigation of disease mechanisms, potential therapeutic approaches, and unanswered research questions.



Research scope



Research must cover the following areas, expanding into related topics when there is a documented connection to multiple myeloma:



Normal immune function, B-cell development, NK -Cell, plasma cells, and antibody production.



Immunoglobulins, including IgG, its subclasses, other antibody classes, heavy and light chains, and related proteins.



Myeloma development, precursor conditions, disease subtypes, progression, and relapse.



Genetic and epigenetic changes, cellular signaling, metabolism, protein production, and mechanisms supporting cancer-cell survival.



The bone marrow environment, interactions with other cells, immune dysfunction, bone damage, and effects on other organs.



Established risk factors, suspected contributors, and proposed causes, with clear distinctions between causation, association, and speculation.



Diagnostic tests, biomarkers, imaging, staging, prognosis, and treatment-response assessment.



Existing treatments, mechanisms of action, clinical outcomes, adverse effects, and resistance mechanisms.



Investigational treatments, clinical trials, potential therapeutic targets, and unsuccessful or contradictory research findings.



Required detail for every relevant element



Each major cell type, protein, antibody, gene, pathway, biomarker, or other biological element must have a structured entry explaining:



Its name, definition, abbreviations, and synonyms.



Its structure, components, types, and subclasses, where applicable.



Where and how it is produced, activated, regulated, and broken down.



Its normal functions and interactions with other biological elements.



How its behavior changes in multiple myeloma.



Whether it is a possible cause, contributor, consequence, marker, or treatment target.



The evidence supporting each connection, including conflicting findings.



How it is measured or studied, where relevant.



Existing or proposed interventions involving it.



Remaining uncertainties and unanswered questions.



References supporting individual claims.



Example: IgG



An IgG entry must explain its definition, molecular structure, production by plasma cells, biological functions, subclasses, regulation, clearance, and interactions with other immune components.



It must also investigate its relevance to myeloma, distinguishing normal antibody function from abnormal monoclonal production and explaining what the evidence does—and does not—show. Being associated with the disease must never automatically be described as causing it.



Use this level of detail for other relevant elements.



Evidence and source requirements



Prioritize primary research, authoritative clinical references, systematic reviews, and recognized research institutions.



Record search terms, databases searched, search dates, and inclusion and exclusion criteria.



Set a clear literature cutoff date and document coverage gaps.



Read full studies where legally accessible. Clearly label findings based only on abstracts.



Include relevant methods, study population or experimental model, sample size, numerical results, and limitations.



Distinguish laboratory studies, animal studies, observational human research, and clinical trials.



Identify preprints, corrections, retractions, duplicate reports, and potentially outdated conclusions.



Include negative results and evidence that contradicts proposed explanations.



Record publication dates, source identifiers such as DOI or PMID, and exact supporting sections, pages, tables, or figures when available.



Do not invent missing information or fill evidence gaps with assumptions.



AI may assist with research, but every citation and factual statement must be verified against its source.



Deliverables



A structured master report with a detailed contents page.



A glossary and encyclopedia of relevant biological elements.



An evidence database linking claims to supporting and conflicting studies.



A relationship table connecting biological elements, disease mechanisms, and treatments.



A treatment and clinical-trial evidence table.



A source archive of legally accessible materials and original research notes.



A coverage report listing completed topics, missing information, inaccessible sources, and unresolved questions.



Clearly labeled, searchable files suitable for AI use, with stable entry and source IDs.



Provide both readable summaries and detailed evidence. A summary must not replace the underlying information needed to evaluate a claim.



Qualifications



Strong or some biomedical training and experience critically reviewing scientific literature are required. Expertise in hematology, oncology, immunology, molecular biology, or cancer research is strongly preferred.



Applicants should demonstrate that they can explain biological mechanisms, interpret research findings, and distinguish evidence from hypotheses.



Application



Please submit your résumé, relevant qualifications, a research sample, proposed rate, availability, and a brief project approach.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid pilot: a detailed IgG entry and its documented connections to multiple myeloma. The main project will proceed in agreed milestones after review of the pilot.



This project supports scientific research and hypothesis development. Any proposed treatment or experimental approach requires appropriate expert evaluation and validation.

title: Experienced Legal Assistant / Paralegal — Construction & Business Litigation
description:
Part-Time | Legal Research, Drafting, Trial & Appeal Preparation



We are seeking an experienced legal assistant or paralegal to help address ongoing construction and business disputes, prepare correspondence, conduct extensive legal research, and support litigation, trial preparation, and appeals.



The position will begin part-time, with the opportunity to increase hours or transition to full-time based on demonstrated reliability, consistency, accuracy, and workload.



Responsibilities



Draft letters, demand letters, payment demands, and responses to opposing counsel, owners, contractors, vendors, and other parties.



Assist with responses to ongoing legal matters, including discovery, motions, notices, and disputed claims, for attorney review where appropriate.



Conduct extensive research into case law, statutes, civil codes, procedural rules, and other relevant legal authorities, with a strong focus on California law.



Prepare research summaries that explain the applicable authorities, how they relate to the facts, and any contrary authority or unresolved questions.



Verify every legal citation against its original source, including quoted language, section numbers, case names, court, year, pinpoint citations, and whether the authority remains valid and supports the stated proposition.



Review construction contracts, change orders, invoices, payment records, project correspondence, and other evidence.



Build case chronologies, organize exhibits, summarize testimony, and identify inconsistencies or missing evidence.



Assist with trial preparation, post-trial motions, appellate records, and appeal preparation under attorney supervision.



Track deadlines, maintain organized case files, and provide consistent progress updates.



Required Qualifications



Substantive experience in civil litigation support, preferably involving construction, contracts, payment disputes, or business litigation.



Strong legal research and drafting skills, including experience using authoritative legal sources and tools to check whether cases remain valid.



Experience supporting trial preparation and appeals.



Proficiency with AI tools for research assistance, drafting, document review, and organization.



Ability to independently verify AI-generated content. AI output is never an acceptable source for a legal citation.



Excellent attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to distinguish established facts from allegations and assumptions.



Familiarity with California trial and appellate procedures strongly preferred.



Ability to meet deadlines, follow through on assignments, maintain confidentiality, and communicate reliably.



Accuracy Expectations



Accuracy is essential. Every citation and quotation must be checked before work is submitted. Fabricated cases, incorrect statutory references, unsupported legal statements, and unchecked AI-generated citations are unacceptable. If an issue cannot be verified, clearly flag it rather than guessing.



How to Apply



Please submit:



Your résumé and expected hourly rate.



Your availability, location, and time zone.



A brief description of your construction or business litigation experience, including trial and appellate support.



The legal research platforms and AI tools you use, and your process for verifying citations.



A redacted legal writing or research sample that you are authorized to share.



We are looking for someone who can research thoroughly, write clearly, and consistently deliver accurate (100% VERIFIED CITATIONS), well-supported work.

title: Static Ad Editor – 8 Figure Women's Supplement Brand
description:
We are looking for a highly creative Static Ad Editor who understands direct response advertising and can create high-performing static ads for Meta.



This role is not just about making ads look good. You need to understand why an ad works, how to match the creative to the customer’s awareness level, and how to write clear, direct, emotionally relevant copy that makes someone stop scrolling.



You will be responsible for creating static image ads from concept to final design, including the headline, supporting copy, layout, image direction, and overall creative execution.

Responsibilities

Create static ads for Meta that are designed to drive clicks, conversions, and profitable customer acquisition

Develop new ad concepts based on customer pain points, emotions, product benefits, and proven direct response angles

Write your own ad copy, including hooks, headlines, subheadlines, callouts, and supporting text

Understand and apply the 3 key customer awareness levels when creating ads:

Trigger Awareness: The customer is feeling a problem but may not fully understand what is causing it yet

Exploration Awareness: The customer is actively looking for answers, explanations, or possible solutions

Evaluation Awareness: The customer understands the problem and is comparing products, mechanisms, benefits, or offers

Create ads that match the customer’s current mindset instead of using generic headlines

Turn creative briefs, customer research, and product angles into strong static ad concepts

Work with the creative team to test new hooks, visual formats, angles, and messaging styles

Analyze winning ads and understand the creative strategy behind them

Create variations of winning concepts without simply copying the same ad repeatedly

Ensure the final static ads are clean, easy to read, visually strong, and aligned with the brand

Balance strong direct response messaging with tasteful, compliant, and brand-appropriate execution



Requirements

Experience creating static ads for eCommerce, DTC, supplements, wellness, beauty, or similar direct response brands

Strong understanding of Meta ads and what makes someone stop scrolling

Ability to write clear, compelling ad copy without relying on a copywriter for every concept

Strong understanding of customer awareness levels and how messaging changes at each stage

Ability to create ads that speak directly to customer problems, desires, objections, and emotions

Strong design sense, including layout, hierarchy, typography, spacing, and visual clarity

Ability to create multiple ad concepts quickly while maintaining quality

Comfortable receiving feedback and improving concepts based on performance data

Strong attention to detail

Familiarity with Canva, Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, or similar design tools

Understanding of direct response principles is a major plus



What We Are Looking For

We want someone who can think like a creative strategist, write like a direct response marketer, and design like a performance-focused editor.

The right person should be able to look at a product angle and create multiple static ad concepts that are visually engaging, emotionally specific, and written for the right awareness level.

You should not need every headline handed to you. You should be able to study the customer, understand what they are feeling, and turn that into strong static ads that can be tested on Meta.



Bonus Points

Experience with women’s wellness, supplements, beauty, postpartum, or health-related products

Experience creating ads for high-spend Meta ad accounts

Ability to break down why an ad works or does not work

Ability to use AI tools to speed up concepting, copywriting, and design iteration

Understanding of direct response frameworks, hooks, mechanisms, objections, and offer positioning





DO NOT APPLY IF YOU ARE:

A beginner

An agency or working with an agency.

DO NOT HAVE background in Ecommerce DTC

People who need direction or move slowly



How to Apply

Step 1: Fill-out the application form 



Step 2: Initial Screening

Step 3: Paid Test

Step 4: Final Interview with the CEO.

title: Print Graphic Designer – Artwork, Social Content & Blog (Custom Apparel, Long-Term)
description:
Love turning rough ideas into clean, print-ready art? Help a growing apparel shop put great designs on shirts, social media and our website every week.



About us

June's Tees is a growing US custom apparel and print shop (screen printing, DTF, embroidery, signs, promo items). We serve schools, sports teams, small businesses and event organizers. Almost every order needs artwork, and we're hiring one dependable, long-term designer to own it.



What you'll do

1. Make customer artwork print-ready: redraw logos as clean vectors, separate colors for screen printing, prepare transparent PNGs for DTF, and simplify designs for embroidery

2. Build mockups and proofs, and send them to customers through our staff dashboard

3. Create social media posts and short videos in COS Creator Studio, our social media platform (full training provided)

4. Write and update blog posts for our website, with photos and images that help customers find us on Google

5. Design ready-to-sell shirts for our online shop: seasonal, school, team and event designs



You'll do great here if you are

- Careful with details: we print exactly what the customer approves

- A clear writer in English (you'll write proof messages, captions and blog posts)

- Fast and organized with many small jobs at once

- Good at taking feedback and making changes quickly



Required

- Strong Adobe Illustrator skills (you'll need your own license)

- Experience preparing art for print: vectors, spot colors, print sizes, 300 dpi

- A portfolio that includes print or apparel work, not just digital art



Nice to have: screen print color separations, embroidery design knowledge, Photoshop, Canva, short-form video editing, blog writing or basic SEO, experience with school or sports designs.



Tools you'll use

Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Canva, Google Docs and Drive, COS Creator Studio (our social platform), and our staff dashboard (jobs, proofs, team chat). We'll train you on our systems.



Schedule

- Monday–Friday, 8:00 pm–12:00 am US Central Time (30 hours/week)

- That's 9:00 am–1:00 pm Philippine time now, and 10:00 am–7:00 am from November. Fixed hours, so proofs reach customers the same day.



Pay

- $4.50 USD/hour ($135/week, about $585/month), paid weekly during training

- $5.00/hour once training is signed off (60–90 days), with pay reviews every 6 months after that



Time off

- We observe major US holidays (New Year's Day, Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas) as paid days off.

- 3 paid leave days after 6 months.



Training

You start with guided training: our artwork rules for each print method, how we make and send proofs, creating posts in COS Creator Studio, and how we write blog posts. A short artwork quiz checks you've got it. The owner reviews your work before it reaches customers, and you take on more as you're ready.



Career path

As the business grows, strong performers get more hours, raises, and the chance to lead our design and content work.



How to apply

Apply through OnlineJobs and include:

1. The words "Blue Ink" at the start of your message

2. A link to your portfolio, with at least 3 print or apparel pieces

3. A screenshot of your internet speed test (speedtest.net)

4. Your answer to this: "A customer sends a blurry 200-pixel logo from
 and wants it printed 12 inches wide on the back of a shirt. What do you do?"



Applications without the code words and a portfolio won't be reviewed.

This is a results-driven role. You'll start with a documented process and a clear testing system, but we're not hiring someone to just follow it. You're measured on profitable spend scaled through your creatives, with clear targets set for each month of your first quarter. title: Virtual Assistant – Short and Long-Form Content Editor
description:
Virtual Assistant – Short and Long-Form Content Editor



Hi! I’m Tayla, and I’m looking for a creative, reliable Virtual Assistant to help me become more consistent with TikTok and long-form content.



I have lots of ideas and footage, but not always enough time to turn everything into finished content. I’m looking for someone who can help take those ideas out of my head (and out of my camera roll 😂) and turn them into cute, engaging, polished videos.



I’d love for this to become a collaborative working relationship where you learn my style and we can bounce ideas off each other not just a “send task → complete task” relationship.



What You’ll Help With



Your main focus will be video editing and content support, including:



- Editing TikToks, Reels, and YouTube Shorts

- Occasionally editing longer YouTube/podcast content

- Adding captions, text, music, graphics, transitions, sound effects, etc.

- Keeping edits current with social media trends

- Repurposing footage into multiple pieces of content

- Helping brainstorm hooks, captions, scripts, and content ideas

- Organizing and transferring videos/files through Google Drive, Dropbox, WeTransfer, or similar tools



You Might Be a Great Fit If You:



- Understand TikTok and short-form content

- Have a creative eye and know how to make content feel cute, fun, and engaging

- Use CapCut

- Are comfortable handling and transferring large files

- Have good written English and communicate reliably

- Can follow direction but are also comfortable suggesting your own ideas

- Have some experience or interest in storytelling/scriptwriting

- Pay attention to detail and meet agreed-upon deadlines



You **do not** need 10 years of experience. I care much more about creativity, communication, reliability, and whether we work well together.



Hours



This will begin as a part-time role, with the possibility of growing over time.



I’m located in the United States, but I’m flexible about when you complete your work. What matters most to me is communication and meeting agreed-upon deadlines.



To apply, please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Examples of videos you’ve edited

3. The editing software you use

4. Your experience with TikTok/Reels/Shorts

5. Your desired hourly or monthly rate

6. Your general weekly availability



**And so I know you read the full listing:**  

Start your application by telling me your favorite TikTok creator, trend, video style, or type of content right now and why you like it. 😊



Some of my content may be funny, lifestyle-focused, educational, mental-health-related, cute, relatable, or just based on random ideas I come up with.



If you’re creative, organized, reliable, and think we’d make a good team, I’d love to hear from you!

title: Clean-Up Bookkeeper (Contract/Part-Time)
description:
Role Summary 



Clean up and bring the books up to date in QuickBooks Online by correcting transaction coding, reconciling bank/credit card accounts, and producing an audit-ready monthly Close Pack with clear documentation. 



 



Key Responsibilities 



Review current setup (chart of accounts, vendors/customers, bank feeds) and identify gaps. 



Clean up/catch up transaction coding (bank feed + manual entries): categorize, add payees/memos, and fix mis-postings. 



Resolve common issues: duplicates, missing transactions (fees/interest), incorrect transfers, personal vs business items, and unmatched payments. 



Reconcile bank and credit card accounts for the scoped months; tie exactly to statements. 



Clean up AR/AP as scoped (apply payments, resolve unapplied cash/credits, validate aging). 



Maintain an audit trail: change log + notes explaining what changed and why. 



Provide weekly status updates and a running questions list; escalate blockers early. 



 



Deliverables 



Reconciliation reports for all scoped accounts/months. 



Clean P&L and Balance Sheet for the scoped period. 



Close Pack (PDF or folder) including: 



P&L + Balance Sheet 



Reconciliation summaries 



List of fixes/adjustments made 



Open questions / items needing client decision 



Clean-up tracker (issues found ­ action taken ­ date resolved ­ evidence link). 



 



Requirements 



2+ years bookkeeping experience, including clean-up/catch-up projects. 



Strong bank reconciliation skills and solid QBO knowledge. 



High attention to detail; comfortable working with messy/incomplete records. 



Clear written communication and documentation habits. 



 

Working Style 



Integrity + confidentiality. 



No guessing on ambiguous items, ask questions and document assumptions. 



Proactive: surfaces issues early and keeps work organized for review. 



 



Scope to Confirm Before Start 



Months/date range to clean up 



Accounts included (bank/credit cards) 



AR/AP scope (included/excluded) 



Payroll scope (if any) 



Access to statements, receipts, and prior filings 



Approval process for reclasses/journal entries

title: MMO Gaming Video Editor
description:
Sure — here’s the more general version with the channel name removed and the wording kept as a gaming channel role.



# Hiring: MMO Gaming Video Editor & Gameplay Recorder — Monthly Salary + Bonuses + Sponsorship Revenue Share



**Type of work:** Part-time / Long-term  

**Location:** Remote



## ABOUT THE ROLE



We’re looking for a skilled **gaming video editor with strong MMO/MMORPG experience** to join our gaming content team.



You’ll mainly cover **PC and mobile games**, with a strong focus on **MMOs/MMORPGs**, including upcoming releases, betas, updates, guides, class content, reviews, news, and other gaming topics.



This is **not just an editing position**.



You’ll be expected to understand the games you’re covering, research them properly, follow their updates, play when required, and record original gameplay that accurately supports the video.



You’ll work with our content team to turn video concepts and briefs into complete YouTube videos.



## WHAT YOU’LL DO



- Edit long-form YouTube gaming videos with strong openings, storytelling, pacing, visuals, and clean audio.

- Cover **PC and mobile games**, primarily MMOs/MMORPGs.

- Research games, systems, updates, classes, events, patches, and other relevant topics.

- Play games when needed to properly understand the content.

- Record original gameplay using OBS or similar software.

- Collect relevant official footage, screenshots, trailers, gameplay, and other media when required.

- Use AI tools to assist with research, scripting, and voice generation.

- Review scripts and research before editing and catch factual mistakes instead of blindly trusting AI output.

- Make sure gameplay, terminology, characters, classes, systems, and on-screen information match the correct game/version.

- Follow official announcements, patch notes, developer updates, and community discussions.

- Keep project files, footage, research, and assets organized.

- Meet deadlines and communicate progress, questions, or problems early.

- Work together with the other editors as **one team**, sharing useful information, research, footage, and knowledge when needed.



Playing, researching, collecting media, and recording gameplay are considered part of the job — not only the final editing.



## WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



- **MMO/MMORPG gaming experience is highly important.**

- You should actively play or have good knowledge of MMO/MMORPG games.

- Comfortable covering both **PC and mobile games**.

- Strong gaming or YouTube editing portfolio.

- Experience editing long-form YouTube videos.

- Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut Pro, or comparable editing software.

- Experience recording gameplay with OBS or similar software.

- A PC capable of playing and recording modern games at good quality.

- Reliable internet for transferring large video/project files.

- Good English comprehension.

- Strong communication.

- Good research skills and attention to detail.

- Reliable with deadlines and long-term commitments.

- Willing to learn new games rather than only working on games you already know.



## AI SKILLS & TOOLS



Experience using tools such as:



- **ChatGPT**

- **Claude**

- **Perplexity**

- **ElevenLabs**



is strongly preferred.



We provide the required **AI subscriptions, software/licenses, and game access/subscriptions needed for assigned projects**.



You need to know how to use AI as a tool — **not blindly copy whatever AI generates**.



## ACCURACY IS A CORE REQUIREMENT



Our audience understands these games, and inaccurate information can damage the channel’s credibility.



You’ll be expected to verify important information using:



- The game itself

- Official websites and announcements

- Patch notes

- Developer information

- Reliable community sources

- Multiple sources when necessary



If something is unclear or cannot be confirmed, **ask the team instead of guessing**.



We value editors who catch problems **before the video is published**, accept feedback, and avoid repeating the same mistakes.



## WHAT WE OFFER



Compensation includes **three parts**:



- **Monthly Salary** — fixed monthly salary clearly stated in your contract.

- **Monthly Performance Bonus** — additional earnings based on agreed video-performance targets.

- **Sponsorship Revenue Share** — percentage of sponsorship revenue from eligible sponsored videos/projects you work on.



We also provide the necessary **AI tools, software subscriptions, licenses, and game access/subscriptions** required for assigned work.



This is intended to be a **long-term position** for the right person.



## HOW TO APPLY



- Your name and location

- Your **best 2–3 gaming editing samples**

- MMO/MMORPG games you currently play or have played

- PC and mobile games you’re familiar with

- Editing software you use

- Gameplay recording experience

- Your PC specifications

- Your availability

- Any experience with ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, ElevenLabs, or similar AI tools



*
 subject:**  

**MMO Video Editor Application – [Your Name]**



Please don’t send a generic application. Tell us a little about your actual **gaming/MMO experience** and which games you know well.

Responsibilities:



Read Between the Lines: You don't just read the text; you understand the context. Is the customer actually angry, or just confused? Is this a VIP wholesale opportunity, or a scammer?



Inbox Management: Handling daily inquiries about shipping, tracking, and product usage with warmth and speed.



Commercial Logic: You treat the company's money like it is your own. You know when to offer a refund to save a relationship, and when to offer a solution to save the sale.





Requirements:



Hyper-Attention to Detail: If you skim
s, this job is not for you.



High Emotional Intelligence (EQ): You know how to de-escalate an angry customer without using a robotic template.



Perfect Written English: Native-level reading comprehension is mandatory.



Tech Savvy: Familiarity with Shopify and helpdesks is a big plus.

title: Short-Form Video Editor for TikTok Shop (Part-Time, Ongoing)
description:
I run a TikTok Shop affiliate business and film my own product videos. I'm looking for an editor to turn my raw footage into fast, native-feeling TikTok videos so I can spend more time filming and selling.

This is an ongoing, remote, part-time editing role.



HOW WE MAKE VIDEOS



I film separate pieces: 5-8 short hooks, 2 body sections and 2-3 calls to action. You assemble different hook + body + CTA combinations so we can test what works. Videos open on a real pain point, not a sales pitch. Formats include product demos, talking head, skits and split-screen comparisons.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Assemble multiple hook + body + CTA combinations from each filming batch.

Edit vertical 9:16 videos with tight pacing and no dead air.

Add accurate, easy-to-read captions and on-screen hook text.

Use sound effects, zooms and b-roll where they help. Use only music cleared for commercial use in the intended videos.

Create split-screen comparisons and simple graphics, such as spec callouts and price tags.

Name and organize exports so I can see which hook, body and CTA each file uses.

Turn longer live-stream recordings into short clips when needed.



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



Proven short-form editing experience for TikTok, Reels or Shorts. Portfolio required.

Comfortable with CapCut, Premiere Pro or Final Cut.

Understands how to earn attention in the first 3 seconds.

Reliable with deadlines and quick to flag problems.

Can read feedback and apply it carefully.

Bonus: experience with TikTok Shop, e-commerce or product videos.



HOURS, VOLUME AND PAY



Hours may vary from week to week; there is no fixed weekly schedule. Pay is $3-5 per hour, and I'm open to an hourly or monthly arrangement, not per-video pay. We'll agree on video volume, batch turnaround and payment details.

If it's a good fit, there may be more volume and a long-term role.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:

Links to 2-3 short-form videos you personally edited.

The editing software you use.

Your rate and usual turnaround for a batch of 10 videos.

One thing you'd change about the hook of a video you've seen recently.



PAID TEST



Shortlisted applicants may complete a paid test. Applicants can choose their own style; there is no required format. Agree on the scope and fee before the test starts.

title: Virtual Assistant for Review Outreach
description:
# Part-Time Virtual Assistant – B2B Research, CRM & RFP Monitoring



**Company:** Bream IT Solutions  

**Position:** Virtual Assistant – Business Development & Research  

**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Employment:** Part-Time Independent Contractor  

**Hours:** 15 hours per week  

**Starting Rate:** **$6.00 USD/hour**  

**Schedule:** Flexible, with some overlap with Arizona business hours preferred



## About Bream IT Solutions



Bream IT Solutions is a U.S.-based technology company located in Arizona. We help businesses improve their technology, cybersecurity, compliance, cloud infrastructure, and IT operations.



We work primarily with organizations in industries such as healthcare, financial services, legal, manufacturing, and government.



We are looking for a reliable, highly organized, and resourceful **Virtual Assistant** to support our business development and operations.



This is **not primarily a calendar-management or personal-assistant position**.



The role is focused on:



**Prospect Research • Contact Enrichment • CRM Management • RFP Monitoring • Business Research • Content Support**



You should enjoy researching companies, finding information online, organizing data, and working independently.



---



# What You'll Be Doing



## 1. Prospect Research



Research companies that could potentially become Bream customers.



You will:



- Research companies based on criteria provided by Bream.

- Identify companies within target industries.

- Research company size, locations, industry, website, and other business information.

- Identify potential technology, cybersecurity, compliance, and IT needs.

- Build organized prospect lists.

- Research healthcare, financial, legal, manufacturing, and other organizations.

- Research Arizona businesses and organizations initially, with other U.S. markets added later.



You will be given specific criteria for determining which companies are good prospects.



---



## 2. Contact Enrichment



Once a company is identified, you will research the appropriate decision-makers.



Typical contacts include:



- CIO

- CTO

- CISO

- IT Director

- IT Manager

- COO

- CFO

- Operations Director

- Practice Administrator

- Managing Partner

- Business Owner



You will:



- Find decision-maker names.

- Verify job titles.

- Locate LinkedIn profiles.

- Research professional
 addresses.

- Find company phone numbers.

- Verify company information.

- Add missing information to prospect records.

- Flag information that cannot be confidently verified.



**Accuracy is more important than volume.**



We do not want databases filled with inaccurate contact information.



---



# 3. HubSpot CRM Management



You will help maintain Bream's HubSpot CRM.



Responsibilities include:



- Adding new contacts and companies.

- Updating existing records.

- Removing or identifying duplicates.

- Correcting inaccurate information.

- Completing missing fields.

- Categorizing prospects by industry.

- Updating prospect classifications.

- Maintaining prospect lists.

- Adding research notes.

- Keeping company and contact records organized.

- Preparing clean prospect lists for sales campaigns.



Experience with **HubSpot is strongly preferred**.



Experience with another CRM such as Salesforce, Zoho, Pipedrive, or similar systems is also valuable.



---



# 4. RFP & Government Contract Monitoring



Bream is expanding its government contracting activities.



You will help identify potential IT and cybersecurity contract opportunities.



You may research:



- SAM.gov

- State procurement websites

- Arizona government procurement portals

- City and county procurement websites

- School and university opportunities

- Healthcare organizations

- Tribal procurement opportunities

- Other public-sector contracting sources



You will search for opportunities involving areas such as:



- Information Technology

- Cybersecurity

- Managed IT Services

- IT Consulting

- Cloud Services

- Network Engineering

- Technology Modernization

- Compliance

- Risk Assessments

- Help Desk Services

- Infrastructure

- AI and technology consulting



Your responsibility will be to **identify and organize opportunities—not write complete government proposals.**



For each relevant opportunity, you may be asked to record:



- Agency

- Solicitation number

- Opportunity title

- Description

- Due date

- Pre-bid meeting date

- Contract value, if available

- Scope

- Important requirements

- Website/source

- Documents

- Notes



Bream leadership will determine whether we pursue the opportunity.



Previous RFP or government-contracting experience is helpful but **not required**.



We can train a strong researcher.



---



# 5. Content & Research Support



You may occasionally assist with:



- LinkedIn content research

- Blog research

- First drafts of business content

- Competitor research

- Industry research

- Cybersecurity news research

- Technology trends

- Organizing existing Bream content

- Repurposing existing content

- Drafting simple social-media content

- Using AI tools to assist with first drafts



Experience using **ChatGPT or other AI productivity tools** is preferred.



You must still review AI-generated information for accuracy.



---



# Ideal Candidate



You may be a strong fit if you are:



- An excellent online researcher.

- Very detail-oriented.

- Comfortable working independently.

- Organized.

- Good at following written processes.

- Comfortable working with spreadsheets.

- Comfortable learning new software.

- Able to communicate clearly in written English.

- Comfortable researching U.S. businesses.

- Comfortable using LinkedIn for research.

- Able to recognize when information may be inaccurate.

- Willing to ask questions instead of guessing.

- Interested in technology and cybersecurity.

- Reliable with deadlines.



We value **accuracy, reliability, curiosity, and consistency**.



---



# Preferred Skills



Experience with any of the following is valuable:



**HubSpot**



**LinkedIn / LinkedIn Sales Navigator**



**Google Search**



**Microsoft Excel**



**Google Sheets**



**Apollo**



**ZoomInfo**



**Hunter**



**SAM.gov**



**Government procurement research**



**B2B lead generation**



**Contact enrichment**



**CRM management**



**ChatGPT**



**Cybersecurity or IT companies**



You do NOT need experience with every tool listed above.



---



# Compensation & Schedule



**Starting Rate: $6.00 USD/hour**



**Schedule: 15 hours per week**



This equals approximately **60–65 hours per month**.



The schedule can be flexible, although some availability during Arizona business hours may occasionally be necessary for meetings or training.



This position will begin part-time.



There is potential for:



- Additional weekly hours

- Increased responsibility

- Increased compensation

- Long-term work



These opportunities will depend on performance and Bream's growth.



---



# What Success Looks Like



During the first several weeks, we will focus heavily on training and accuracy.



Once trained, your weekly responsibilities may include:



- Researching qualified target companies.

- Identifying and enriching decision-makers.

- Maintaining accurate CRM records.

- Monitoring assigned RFP/procurement sources.

- Entering relevant opportunities into our tracker.

- Cleaning and organizing HubSpot records.

- Completing assigned business research.

- Assisting with occasional content research.



We do **not** expect you to know everything immediately.



We do expect you to be willing to learn, follow instructions, document your work, and ask questions when something is unclear.



---



# How to Apply



Please do **not** send a generic application.



Start your application with the words:



**"BREAM RESEARCH VA"**



Applications that do not include this phrase may not be reviewed.



Then answer the following questions.



## Screening Questions



### 1. Research Experience



Describe your experience researching companies and business decision-makers.



What information were you responsible for finding?



### 2. Contact Enrichment



Suppose we give you the name of a healthcare company in Arizona.



Explain step-by-step how you would identify the person responsible for technology, IT, cybersecurity, or business operations.



What tools would you use?



### 3. CRM Experience



Have you used HubSpot?



If yes, explain what you have done inside HubSpot.



If not, tell us which CRM systems you have used.



### 4. Lead Generation Tools



Which of the following have you used?



- LinkedIn

- LinkedIn Sales Navigator

- Apollo

- ZoomInfo

- Hunter

- HubSpot

- Google

- Other lead-generation tools



Briefly describe your experience with each tool you have used.



### 5. Government/RFP Research



Have you ever researched:



- RFPs

- RFQs

- Government contracts

- SAM.gov

- State procurement websites



If yes, describe your experience.



**Previous experience is not required.**



If you have never done this before, explain how you would approach learning it.



### 6. AI Tools



How do you currently use ChatGPT or other AI tools in your work?



Give us one specific example.



### 7. Quality Control



You find an
 address for a prospect, but you are only 60% confident that it is correct.



What would you do before entering it into our CRM?



### 8. Availability



Please provide:



- Your current location in the Philippines.

- Your normal working hours.

- Your availability Monday through Friday.

- Whether you can work approximately 15 hours per week.

- Whether you currently work for other clients.

- Your preferred long-term working schedule.



---



# Paid Test Assignment



Final candidates will be invited to complete a **paid test assignment**.



You will be compensated for the test.



The assignment is designed to evaluate your research process, accuracy, organization, judgment, and written communication.



## Test Assignment



### Part 1 – Prospect Research



Identify **5 Arizona healthcare organizations** that could potentially need outsourced IT, cybersecurity, compliance, or technology consulting services.



For each organization provide:



- Company name

- Website

- Location

- Industry/sub-industry

- Estimated company size if available

- Why you believe the company could be a potential prospect



### Part 2 – Decision-Maker Research



Identify at least one relevant decision-maker for each organization.



Provide:



- Full name

- Job title

- LinkedIn profile

- Professional
 address, if verifiable

- Source used to verify the information

- Confidence level: High / Medium / Low



**Do not invent missing information.**



If something cannot be verified, clearly state that.



### Part 3 – RFP Research



Find **one current Arizona government/public-sector opportunity** related to information technology or cybersecurity.



Provide:



- Agency

- Solicitation title

- Solicitation number

- Due date

- Brief description

- Link/source

- Why you believe the opportunity could be relevant to an IT company



### Part 4 – Content



Write a short LinkedIn post of approximately **100–150 words** explaining why cybersecurity should be viewed as a business risk rather than simply an IT problem.



### Part 5 – Summary



Write a short summary explaining:



1. How you conducted your research.

2. Which tools you used.

3. What information was difficult to verify.

4. How long the entire assignment took you.



---



# Important



We are not looking for someone who simply copies information from Google or generates everything through ChatGPT.



We are looking for someone who can:



**Research → Verify → Organize → Document → Communicate**



If you enjoy researching businesses, finding hard-to-locate information, maintaining organized data, and learning about technology and cybersecurity, we would like to hear from you.

title: Land Appraisal Analyst
description:
Summary

We're a high-volume land flipping business looking for a sharp Land Appraisal Analyst to join our team.



You'll be analyzing and pricing vacant land properties (mostly rural/desert parcels) using comparable sales and our established criteria.



The work is process-driven and steady — ideal for someone who enjoys focused analytical work.



You don't need a real estate background — if you're analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable doing focused solo work, we'll teach you the rest.

What you'll do:



Analyze and price a high volume of vacant land properties

Select and evaluate comparable sales, adjusting for differences in size, access, utilities, terrain, and location

Cross-reference data from county records, GIS/parcel maps, and assessor sites

Follow a structured process for pricing and basic due diligence

Flag unusual or higher-risk properties for review rather than forcing a number

Keep clean, organized records of your work



Skills we're looking for:



Strong comp selection judgment — knowing which sales are truly comparable and which to discard

Sound adjustment reasoning — understanding that price per acre isn't linear and adjusting accordingly

Data fluency — fast and accurate with spreadsheets and pulling data from multiple sources

Consistency — applying the same logic the same way across high volume

Attention to detail — catching access issues, easements, flood zones, and landlocked parcels

Good judgment — knowing the limits of the analysis and when to escalate



Who you are:



Analytical and detail-oriented

Some technical or analytical background is a plus (data, finance, engineering, CS, or similar), but not required

Comfortable with focused, heads-down work for long stretches

Self-directed and reliable

Able to communicate clearly

Solid internet connection



This is high-volume work, so consistency and accuracy both matter. If you take pride in clean, careful analysis, you'll fit in well here.



Please submit a short voice sample why you would be a good fit for this job.

title: TikTok Video Editor – Beauty & Personal Care
description:

Compensation: $350 USD per month

This is intended as a long-term position for the right editor.



Workload:

Approximately 100 short-form videos per month, averaging around 25 videos per week.



Most videos will be approximately 15–45 seconds long.



The workload may vary from week to week. Some days may require more videos or faster turnaround, while other days may be lighter and more relaxed.



We will provide raw footage, creator/UGC content, product footage, reference videos, and/or editing directions.



Many videos may involve creating different hooks, angles, captions, or variations from the same footage, rather than producing every video completely from scratch.



What You’ll Do



- Edit TikTok and other short-form vertical videos

- Create strong hooks in the first few seconds

- Turn raw product and creator footage into engaging content

- Add captions, text overlays, music, sound effects, zooms, cuts, and transitions where appropriate

- Remove unnecessary pauses and maintain good pacing

- Create multiple video variations from the same footage

- Repurpose UGC and creator footage into different concepts and angles

- Follow current TikTok editing styles and trends

- Highlight product benefits, demonstrations, problems/solutions, and before/after results

- Edit content designed to generate views, clicks, and product sales



Products

You will primarily edit content for:



- Beauty

- Skincare

- Body care

- Hair care

- Fashion/body adhesive products

- Personal care products



Who We’re Looking For

You should:



- Have experience editing TikTok, Reels, or other short-form videos

- Understand TikTok pacing, hooks, captions, and viewer retention

- Be comfortable working with beauty and e-commerce content

- Be able to create multiple creative variations from the same footage

- Work efficiently and meet deadlines

- Follow instructions and reference videos closely

- Have good creative instincts and attention to detail

- Be reliable and communicative



Experience with TikTok Shop, UGC, beauty, skincare, or e-commerce videos is strongly preferred.





To Apply



Please send:



1. Links to 3–5 of your best short-form/TikTok videos, including any examples of beauty, skincare, UGC, TikTok Shop, or e-commerce videos you have edited.

2. The editing software you use.

3. Be prepared to complete an editing test of 1–2 videos. This will help us evaluate your editing speed, TikTok instincts, and ability to create multiple angles from the same footage.



Please start your application with “BEAUTY TIKTOK” so we know you read the full job description.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with our team and work with us long term.

title: B2B Sales Development Representative (SDR) – IT & Cybersecurity
description:
# B2B Sales Development Representative (SDR) – IT & Cybersecurity



**Company:** Bream IT Solutions  

**Position:** Sales Development Representative (SDR)  

**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Employment:** Part-Time Independent Contractor  

**Hours:** 15–20 hours per week  

**Industry:** IT Services / Cybersecurity / Technology Consulting  

**Compensation:** Hourly base pay + performance bonuses



## About Bream IT Solutions



Bream IT Solutions is a U.S.-based Managed Business Provider headquartered in Arizona.



We help businesses improve their technology, cybersecurity, compliance, cloud infrastructure, and overall IT operations.



Our primary markets include healthcare, financial services, legal, and manufacturing organizations.



We are building our outbound sales operation and are looking for a motivated **Sales Development Representative (SDR)** who can help turn qualified target accounts into conversations and sales meetings.



This is not a customer service or general virtual assistant position.



Your primary responsibility is to **create qualified sales conversations and book meetings with potential customers.**



## What You Will Do



You will receive target companies and contacts from Bream's CRM and prospect research process.



You will research the account before outreach, identify the appropriate decision-maker, personalize outreach when appropriate, contact prospects through approved channels, conduct follow-ups, qualify interested prospects, schedule discovery meetings, and maintain accurate activity records in HubSpot.



Outreach may include
, LinkedIn, telephone calls, and other approved B2B prospecting methods.



You will primarily communicate with business owners and executives such as CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, IT Directors, IT Managers, CFOs, COOs, Practice Administrators, Operations Directors, Managing Partners, and other business decision-makers.



## What You Will Be Selling



You will introduce qualified organizations to Bream's business and technology services.



These may include Managed IT, Co-Managed IT, Cybersecurity, Compliance Readiness, Cloud Services, Backup and Disaster Recovery, Network Engineering, Technology Modernization, AI Readiness, Virtual CIO services, and technology consulting.



You are **not expected to be a technical engineer**.



Your responsibility is to understand the business problem well enough to create interest and schedule a conversation with Bream leadership.



## Target Customers



Bream primarily targets U.S. organizations in:



**Healthcare**



**Financial Services**



**Legal**



**Manufacturing**



Our initial outbound efforts will be highly targeted rather than mass cold
 campaigns.



Quality conversations are more important than sending thousands of generic messages.



## SDR Responsibilities



You will be responsible for working assigned target accounts, researching prospects before contacting them, conducting outbound prospecting, sending personalized
s, performing telephone outreach, connecting with prospects through LinkedIn, following up consistently, identifying potential business needs, qualifying interested prospects, scheduling discovery meetings, recording activities in HubSpot, updating account and contact statuses, and providing Bream with regular pipeline updates.



The SDR is responsible for **creating qualified opportunities—not closing the sale**.



Bream leadership will handle discovery meetings, technical discussions, proposals, pricing, negotiations, and closing.



## What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is confident communicating with U.S. business professionals and comfortable initiating conversations with people they have never spoken with before.



You should have strong spoken and written English, professional telephone communication skills, B2B prospecting experience, strong follow-up habits, good organizational skills, and the ability to work independently.



You should also be comfortable hearing "no" and continuing to prospect professionally.



Experience selling technology is helpful but not required if you are willing to learn.



## Preferred Experience



We prefer candidates with previous experience in B2B appointment setting, SDR/BDR work, outbound sales, cold calling, LinkedIn prospecting,
 prospecting, lead qualification, HubSpot or another CRM, U.S.-based clients, IT services, cybersecurity, SaaS, MSPs, or technology companies.



Experience with tools such as HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, ZoomInfo, or similar prospecting platforms is helpful.



## Working Hours



This position will begin at approximately **15–20 hours per week**.



Because you will be contacting U.S. businesses, you must be willing to work during an agreed-upon window that overlaps with U.S. business hours.



The initial market will include Arizona and other U.S. markets as Bream expands.



Consistent availability during the agreed calling window is important.



## Compensation



This position will use a combination of:



**Hourly base compensation**



plus



**Performance bonuses for qualified meetings and sales opportunities**



We want to reward SDRs for creating legitimate sales opportunities—not simply generating large numbers of low-quality appointments.



Additional hours and increased compensation may become available based on performance and Bream's growth.



## How Performance Will Be Measured



We will evaluate performance based on outbound activity, conversations with decision-makers, follow-up consistency, qualified meetings scheduled, meeting attendance, qualified opportunities created, CRM accuracy, and ultimately the quality of pipeline generated.



Meeting quality matters.



A meeting with an organization that has no realistic need, authority, budget, or fit for Bream will not be considered equivalent to a properly qualified opportunity.



## How to Apply



Begin your application with:



**"BREAM SDR"**



Applications that do not include this phrase may not be reviewed.



Please answer the following screening questions.



### Screening Question 1

title: Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage Product Sourcing VA
description:
Pay: $2/hour + Performance Bonuses

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8 hours per day (40 hours/week)

Position: Full-Time Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage Product Sourcing VA



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED.



Do NOT apply if you have never sourced profitable products for Amazon FBA before. I am specifically looking for someone who already understands Amazon product sourcing and can work independently.



You should already know how to analyze Amazon listings, research suppliers, verify websites, check sellers and competition, calculate profit, and determine whether a product is actually worth purchasing.



YOUR MAIN JOB



You must provide 5 VALID ASINs per day.



That equals 25 valid ASINs per week.



Finding 5 random products does NOT count. Products must meet ALL of my requirements and pass my review.



If some of your daily ASINs are rejected, you have until the end of the week/payday to replace them and reach the required 25 valid ASINs.



25 approved ASINs per week is the minimum requirement — not just 25 submissions.



BONUSES 💰



I reward VAs who consistently provide good leads and help me grow the business.



You can earn additional bonuses for:



Consistently finding valid ASINs: If your leads regularly pass my review and meet all requirements, you can receive performance bonuses.



More than 25 approved ASINs: If you finish your required 25 valid ASINs early and continue finding additional approved products, you can receive a bonus for exceeding your weekly target.



Finding profitable Amazon seller storefronts: If you discover a strong Online Arbitrage seller storefront that I can use for further product research, submit the storefront to me. If I review it and approve it as a good sourcing opportunity, you can receive a bonus.



High-quality sourcing: VAs who consistently find products that I actually purchase and successfully sell will have opportunities for additional bonuses and higher pay over time.



Quality still matters. Adding random ASINs just to go above 25 will NOT earn a bonus. Extra ASINs must meet the same requirements as your normal submissions and pass my review.



PRODUCT REQUIREMENTS



Every product you submit must:



Be a brand I am already approved/ungated to sell. 



Make at least $2 profit per unit



Have at least 100 estimated sales per month



NOT be a generic brand



Have realistic competition where I can actually get sales



Have enough room for me to enter the listing without immediately destroying the price



Come from a REAL, TRUSTWORTHY SOURCE



Be in stock and actually available to purchase



Match the EXACT Amazon product/variation



Include the correct source link



Include the correct Amazon ASIN/listing



Not already have been submitted by another VA on my team



ROI is NOT my main requirement. I care more about actual dollar profit, sales volume, competition, and whether I can realistically sell the inventory.



QUANTITY MATTERS



Do NOT submit deals that only become profitable when purchasing an unrealistic quantity.



Example:



If a product only meets my requirements when buying 25 units, but the Amazon listing only sells around 50 units per month and has 20 competing sellers, I am obviously not going to purchase 25 units.



Use common sense.



Look at:



Monthly sales + number of sellers + competition + minimum purchase quantity.



The deal needs to make sense for MY business, not just look profitable on a spreadsheet.



SOURCE VERIFICATION IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



You MUST verify every website before submitting it.



I recently had a VA provide a fake website that looked like a major retailer. A purchase was made from the website and the card information was compromised.



That cannot happen again.



Before submitting ANY unfamiliar website, verify that it is legitimate.



Do NOT submit:



Fake retailer websites



Scam websites



Copycat websites



Suspicious Shopify stores



Random websites with no established reputation



Sources you have not properly researched



A retailer/distributor different from the one you put in the spreadsheet



If you are unsure whether a source is legitimate, DO NOT SUBMIT IT. Ask me first.



QUALITY > RANDOM LEADS



I would rather receive 5 strong ASINs than 20 bad ones.



Do not fill the spreadsheet just to hit your number.



Repeatedly submitting products that clearly violate the requirements will result in termination.



YOU SHOULD ALREADY KNOW



You should have previous experience with:



Amazon Seller Central



Amazon FBA



Online Arbitrage



Product sourcing



Keepa



SellerAmp SAS or similar tools



Buy Box analysis



Sales rank / estimated monthly sales



Amazon fees



Profit calculations



Seller/competition analysis



Variation matching



Source verification



Checking whether Amazon is on the listing



Identifying dangerous price drops or listings with too much competition



Amazon seller storefront sourcing / storefront stalking



You should NOT need me to teach you the basics of Amazon sourcing.



HOURS



Monday–Friday

8 hours per day

40 hours per week



This is a long-term position for the right person.



Starting pay is $2/hour, but strong performance can earn you bonuses and opportunities for increased pay.



The better the products you find and the more value you bring to the business, the more opportunity you have to earn.



HOW TO APPLY



Do NOT send me a generic copy-and-paste application.



Start your application with:



“I HAVE AMAZON SOURCING EXPERIENCE”



Then answer these questions:



How long have you been sourcing products for Amazon?



Have you done Online Arbitrage before?



What sourcing tools have you used?



Do you know how to use Keepa? Explain what you normally check on a Keepa chart.



Do you know how to use SellerAmp SAS?



How do you determine whether there are too many sellers on a listing?



How do you verify that a sourcing website is legitimate?



How do you determine how many units of a product you would recommend buying?



What is the difference between profit and ROI?



Have you used Amazon seller storefronts to find additional profitable products? Explain your process.



Send an example of an Amazon sourcing spreadsheet you have worked with before, with any confidential client information removed.



FINAL TEST: Include one example ASIN + source link that you believe would be worth researching for Online Arbitrage. Briefly explain why you chose it.



If you cannot answer these questions, please do not apply.



I am looking for someone who already knows what they are doing, pays attention to details, follows instructions, verifies their sources, and can consistently find products that I can actually buy and sell.

title: Google / YouTube Ads Manager
description:
# YouTube / Google Ads Manager — Performance & Optimization



We are looking for an experienced **YouTube / Google Ads Manager** to join our team and help us bring our paid advertising management in-house.



We currently work with an outside advertising agency and have **active campaigns already running**. Our goal is to transition the management and optimization of these campaigns to an internal team member who can take ownership of performance and help us achieve the strongest possible ROI.



## What You'll Be Doing



Your first priority will be to step into our **existing Google and YouTube advertising campaigns**, analyze their performance, and identify opportunities for improvement.



You will be responsible for:



- Reviewing and auditing our current Google/YouTube Ads account and campaigns

- Optimizing existing campaigns for better performance and ROI

- Monitoring budgets, spend, conversions, CPA/CAC, ROAS, and other key performance metrics

- Identifying underperforming campaigns, audiences, placements, keywords, and creative

- Scaling campaigns and ad sets that are performing well

- Testing audiences, targeting, bidding strategies, creatives, hooks, and offers

- Setting up and launching new YouTube and Google campaigns

- Developing ongoing testing and optimization strategies

- Ensuring conversion tracking and attribution are set up correctly

- Creating clear reports showing what is working, what isn't, and what should be changed

- Making proactive recommendations instead of simply monitoring campaigns

- Staying current on Google Ads and YouTube advertising best practices



## Transition & Training



Because we currently have an outside agency managing our advertising, this role will include a **transition and knowledge-transfer period**.



Our team will be receiving training on our current advertising strategy and processes. We want the person in this role to combine that training and historical knowledge with their **existing Google and YouTube Ads expertise**.



We are not looking for someone who needs to learn Google Ads from the beginning. We are looking for someone who already understands paid advertising and can use the additional training and information we provide to quickly take ownership of our campaigns.



## What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate has:



- Proven experience managing **Google Ads and YouTube Ads**

- Strong experience optimizing existing campaigns—not just launching new ones

- Experience managing meaningful advertising budgets

- A strong understanding of conversion tracking, attribution, remarketing, audiences, and funnels

- Experience with performance marketing and direct-response campaigns

- Strong analytical skills and the ability to make decisions based on campaign data

- Experience improving CPA/CAC and ROAS

- Knowledge of YouTube creative strategy and what makes video ads convert

- Ability to identify when the problem is the campaign, targeting, creative, landing page, offer, or funnel

- Strong communication and reporting skills

- A proactive, testing-focused mindset



## Our Goal



Our goal is simple: **continuously improve the performance and profitability of our advertising.**



We want someone who will treat our ad spend as if it were their own money—carefully monitoring performance, finding opportunities, testing strategically, cutting waste, and scaling what works.



Initially, the focus will be on **optimizing and improving the campaigns we already have running**. Once you understand our data, audiences, offers, and funnels, you'll help us develop and launch new campaigns and testing strategies.



## To Apply



Please include:



1. A brief description of your experience managing Google and YouTube Ads

2. Examples of campaign budgets you've managed

3. Examples of results you've achieved, including CPA/CAC and ROAS improvements when possible

4. Your approach to auditing and optimizing an existing Google Ads account

5. Your experience specifically with **YouTube video advertising**

6. The tools you use for tracking, reporting, and optimization

7. Your availability and preferred working arrangement
