Finding 5 random products does NOT count. Products must meet ALL of my requirements and pass my review.



If some of your daily ASINs are rejected, you have until the end of the week/payday to replace them and reach the required 25 valid ASINs.



25 approved ASINs per week is the minimum requirement — not just 25 submissions.



BONUSES 💰



I reward VAs who consistently provide good leads and help me grow the business.



You can earn additional bonuses for:



Consistently finding valid ASINs: If your leads regularly pass my review and meet all requirements, you can receive performance bonuses.



More than 25 approved ASINs: If you finish your required 25 valid ASINs early and continue finding additional approved products, you can receive a bonus for exceeding your weekly target.



Finding profitable Amazon seller storefronts: If you discover a strong Online Arbitrage seller storefront that I can use for further product research, submit the storefront to me. If I review it and approve it as a good sourcing opportunity, you can receive a bonus.



High-quality sourcing: VAs who consistently find products that I actually purchase and successfully sell will have opportunities for additional bonuses and higher pay over time.



Quality still matters. Adding random ASINs just to go above 25 will NOT earn a bonus. Extra ASINs must meet the same requirements as your normal submissions and pass my review.



PRODUCT REQUIREMENTS



Every product you submit must:



Be a brand I am already approved/ungated to sell



Make at least $2 profit per unit



Have at least 50 estimated sales per month



NOT be a generic brand



Have realistic competition where I can actually get sales



Have enough room for me to enter the listing without immediately destroying the price



Come from a REAL, TRUSTWORTHY SOURCE



Be in stock and actually available to purchase



Match the EXACT Amazon product/variation



Include the correct source link



Include the correct Amazon ASIN/listing



Not already have been submitted by another VA on my team



ROI is NOT my main requirement. I care more about actual dollar profit, sales volume, competition, and whether I can realistically sell the inventory.



QUANTITY MATTERS



Do NOT submit deals that only become profitable when purchasing an unrealistic quantity.



Example:



If a product only meets my requirements when buying 25 units, but the Amazon listing only sells around 50 units per month and has 20 competing sellers, I am obviously not going to purchase 25 units.



Use common sense.



Look at:



Monthly sales + number of sellers + competition + minimum purchase quantity.



The deal needs to make sense for MY business, not just look profitable on a spreadsheet.



SOURCE VERIFICATION IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



You MUST verify every website before submitting it.



I recently had a VA provide a fake website that looked like a major retailer. A purchase was made from the website and the card information was compromised.



That cannot happen again.



Before submitting ANY unfamiliar website, verify that it is legitimate.



Do NOT submit:



Fake retailer websites



Scam websites

- Need a live quote mid-call? Connect me on the phone and I'll run the quotes with you right there.



How you get paid:

- $50 for every closed sale. No cap. Close 10 in a week, that's $500.

- Effort pay on top: you earn points for real production (quality calls, presentations, follow-ups, completed apps handed off). Every 10 points = an extra $25. Action and production get you money even while you're building momentum.

- This is a performance role. The more you close, the more you earn.



Hours: Monday through Saturday, 9:30 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern. Full-time or part-time within those hours.



What you MUST have (non-negotiable):

- Your OWN paid calling tool that dials into the USA reliably. Free apps and workarounds don't cut it for this role.

- A 352 area code phone number on that tool. (Don't have one yet? Get one before you apply.)

- Steady internet, a quiet workspace, and a proper headset.

- If you prove yourself and become a longer-term hire, I may reimburse your tool cost monthly. Earn it first.



To apply, you MUST include ALL of the following or your application will be skipped:

1. Your
 address

2. Your WhatsApp number

3. A voice recording (1-2 minutes) answering these:

   - What have you closed before, and what was your close rate?

   - Why final expense / life insurance?

   - A prospect says "I need to think about it" — what do you say next?

   - What paid tool do you use to call the USA, and do you have a 352 number on it?

4. Your related sales/closing experience (what you sold, how long, results)



Who this is for: confident phone closers who don't need hand-holding, follow a process, and want their income tied directly to their skill. If you're the kind of person who hears "no" as "not yet," you'll do well here.



Who this is NOT for: anyone looking for guaranteed hourly pay regardless of results, anyone without their own dialer, anyone who can't get a 352 number, anyone unavailable Mon–Sat 9:30–5 Eastern.

title: Lead Generation & Sales Operations VA (AI-Assisted): Full-time
description:
TOK AI Consulting · Remote, Philippines-based · Full-time (40 hrs/week) · USD $600/month base plus performance bonuses (about USD $950 a month once you hit target)



About the role

I'm hiring a Philippines-based VA to build my sales pipeline. The work covers researching the right prospects, keeping my CRM clean, preparing personalised outreach and booking discovery calls.



This is not a general admin role. It suits someone who researches accurately, keeps systems tidy, uses AI tools well, and checks AI output rather than trusting the first draft.



We start with Australia. Europe is added later, as you grow into the role.



About the business

TOK AI Consulting helps founder-led and CEO-led businesses adopt AI in practical, commercially sound ways. That includes AI strategy, AI policy, team training and implementation support. My clients are business owners and senior leaders who value evidence, clarity and doing what we say we'll do. Your work d
 which of them I get to speak with.





What you'll do

• Build and update lead lists in 
 and LinkedIn Sales Navigator from our ideal client profiles, micro-segments and current campaigns.

• Research LinkedIn profiles, company websites and public signals (hiring, funding, leadership changes, public comments on AI) to judge fit.

• Apply our lead-scoring rules and offer-matching logic to d
 who gets outreach first.

• Draft first-pass LinkedIn messages and cold
s with templates and Claude (provided by TOK).

• Personalise every message with real company, buyer and trigger-event context. No generic "I came across your profile".

• Keep HubSpot records accurate: contacts, tags, notes, deal stages and follow-up tasks.

• Manage inbox follow-ups and book discovery calls into my calendar.

• Maintain structured files for messaging, offers, objections, signals and sales materials. These are the knowledge files our AI workflows run on.

• Review AI output carefully, and improve prompts or workflows when quality drops.

• Flag patterns, objections and messaging insights that would improve the system.





Must-haves

• 3+ years of VA or sales-support work in at least two of: B2B lead generation, LinkedIn prospecting, CRM administration, outreach support, research, or executive assistance.

• Strong written English. Australian founders notice a sloppy sentence immediately.

• Hands-on use of a CRM (HubSpot preferred), Google Workspace and at least one AI assistant (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar).

• Careful research: you can tell a good-fit company from a bad one and explain why.

• High accuracy in CRM work, documentation and follow-up.

• Proof that you have taught yourself a new tool or process and used it in real work.

• A computer, a mobile phone, reliable internet, a backup power or internet plan, and a quiet place to work.

Nice-to-haves

• 
 or LinkedIn Sales Navigator experience.

• Experience supporting Australian clients or professional-services firms.

• Experience writing or refining AI prompts.





You'll fit well if you are

• Highly conscientious. You check your own work before anyone else sees it.

• Calm and sceptical. You treat AI output as a first draft, not a final answer.

• Commercially curious. You want to understand why a buyer says yes, not just follow the template.

• Coachable. You take direct feedback as information, not as a personal attack, and you improve quickly.

• Independent. You work well once priorities and standards are clear.





What success looks like in 90 days

• You reach Proficient by delivering 25 qualified leads a month for 3 months in a row.

    ◦ A qualified lead meets our scoring threshold, with the evidence logged in HubSpot.

    ◦ My weekly spot-check must find fewer than 10% errors.

    ◦ Reaching Proficient earns a USD $200 bonus.



• Your outreach drafts need only light edits before I approve them (target: [confirm: 8 in 10] approved with minor changes).

• HubSpot is current: every active lead has a stage, a next step and a follow-up date.

• Discovery calls are being booked from warm outreach.

• You have learned at least one new skill on your own (from a course, YouTube or similar) and applied it to the work.

• Our knowledge files are organised and ready for the next campaign.





Working style

• Remote and flexible. Work around family and other commitments.

• Overlap with Australian business hours is preferred, for example 2 hours a day. Perth is on Manila time. Sydney is 2 hours ahead of Manila under AEST and 3 hours ahead under AEDT (October to April).

• Time zones. I travel across APAC and Europe, so I'll sometimes message outside your hours. Reply in your next working session unless I mark the message urgent.

• Deadlines. Occasionally a client deadline needs extra hours or a weekend. It isn't often, and I'll give as much notice as I can.

• Confidentiality. Handling client and prospect data carefully is essential.





Pay and growth [$950 a month once you hit target]

• Base: USD $600/month, full-time (40 hrs/week).

• Call bonus: USD $10 for each qualified discovery call you book. A qualified call means the prospect fits our ideal client profile and attends the call. [target 25 = $250+/month]

• Proficient bonus: USD $200 the first time you deliver 25 qualified leads a month for 3 months in a row.

• Monthly target bonus: USD $100 for every month after that in which you keep hitting 25 a month and quality holds.



• Pay review: your base pay is reviewed at 6 months.



• After 6 months: USD $20/month for an internet upgrade and USD $20/month for an AI tool upgrade.

• After 12 months: a year-end bonus of one month's pay.

• After 2 years: HMO health insurance, and a cash bonus from a share of profits, paid every 6 months.

• After 3 years: HMO for dependents, and 10–15 days of paid time off. [confirm wording: see Section 6]





How fast you earn the bonuses depends on the effort you put into self learning. The fastest VA I've worked with reached full productivity in 3 months. Most take 4–5 months.



The role starts as an independent contractor engagement, paid against agreed outputs. Once the role is stable and closely managed, we may move to an employee or Employer-of-Record arrangement.





How to apply

Start your message with the subject line "Pipeline Builder: [Your Name]". Applications without it won't be read. 



Then send:

1. A short introduction in clear English, written by you (no more than 150 words).

2. A summary of your experience in lead research, CRM management or outreach support, with the tools you used.

3. A personalised LinkedIn message (no more than 80 words) to the Managing Director of an Australian professional-services firm who has started speaking publicly about AI. Name a real firm, and tell us where you found the signal.

4. Three sentences on how you use AI tools and how you check their output.



Shortlisted applicants complete a paid 2-hour trial task (USD $15) before an interview.
salary: $950 a month once you hit target

title: International Growth Marketer
description:
International Growth Marketer



CoolHed Pty Ltd

Remote – International Applicants Welcome

Full-Time | Contractor or Employee

Start: Immediate

Location: Remote, with Gold Coast hybrid welcome



About CoolHed



CoolHed is an Australian company developing reusable cooling solutions for heat stress, athletic recovery, workplace safety, and everyday thermoregulation.



We are growing across Australia and expanding into the United States, Japan, and B2B workplace markets.



We're looking for an experienced Growth Marketer who can take ownership of our online marketing and help turn traffic into measurable sales.



This is a hands-on role. We're looking for someone who enjoys running campaigns, testing ideas, improving conversions, and seeing measurable results.



The Role



As our International Growth Marketer, you'll be responsible for growing CoolHed through:



Paid advertising

Amazon

SEO

 & CRM

Website conversion

Lead generation

B2B sales support

Creative testing



You'll work directly with the Founder/CEO and have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact as we expand into international markets.



Key Responsibilities

Paid Advertising

Plan, launch, manage, and optimise Meta, Google, and TikTok campaigns.

Test different creative concepts, hooks, offers, and audiences.

Manage advertising budgets based on performance.

Identify underperforming campaigns and improve or replace them.

Develop campaigns for Australia initially, followed by the US and other markets.

Amazon

Manage and improve Amazon listings.

Work with Amazon PPC campaigns and keyword targeting.

Improve product titles, bullet points, images, A+ Content, and backend keywords.

Monitor advertising performance, rankings, reviews, and inventory.

Help expand CoolHed across Amazon Australia, the US, and eventually Japan.

SEO & Content

Identify valuable commercial search opportunities.

Improve website pages, product pages, titles, internal linking, and SEO structure.

Create or coordinate useful content that can generate traffic and sales.

Use Google Search Console and other tools to monitor performance.

 & CRM

Manage email marketing and customer flows.

Build and improve welcome, abandoned-cart, post-purchase, win-back, and other automated campaigns.

Segment customers and leads.

Monitor email performance and revenue.

Maintain good email deliverability and list hygiene.

Sales & Business Development

Support B2B lead generation and outreach.

Help create sales materials, email sequences, and LinkedIn outreach campaigns.

Support follow-up with workplace, safety, mining, construction, healthcare, and other potential business customers.

Assist with affiliate and ambassador opportunities.

Help develop campaigns around seasonal opportunities and key markets.

Website & Conversion

Identify ways to improve the customer journey and checkout experience.

Develop landing pages for advertising campaigns.

Improve product pages, bundles, FAQs, offers, and trust elements.

Test different approaches to increase conversion rates.

What We're Looking For



We're looking for a hands-on marketer, not someone who simply manages an agency or delegates everything.



You should have experience with several of the following:



Meta Ads Manager

Google Ads

TikTok Ads

Amazon Seller Central

Amazon PPC

Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar

Klaviyo or another email marketing platform

Google Analytics 4

Google Search Console

Shopify

Canva / CapCut

CRM and marketing automation tools



Experience marketing physical products, e-commerce, Amazon, wellness, sports, outdoor products, workplace safety, or similar products is highly valued.



Qualifications & Skills

3+ years of hands-on digital marketing experience is preferred.

Experience managing paid advertising for a physical product or e-commerce brand.

Strong understanding of performance marketing and conversion.

Experience with Amazon Seller Central and PPC is highly preferred.

Good understanding of email marketing and CRM.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Excellent written English.

Able to work independently and take ownership of projects.

Comfortable testing, learning, and making decisions based on data.

Strong commercial mindset — you care about sales and profitable growth, not just likes and impressions.

Comfortable working remotely and providing regular updates.



You don't need to be an expert in every area. However, we are looking for someone who is capable of getting hands-on and making things happen.



What Success Looks Like



Your goal is simple: help CoolHed generate more profitable sales.



Over your first 90 days, you'll be expected to:



Audit our existing website, advertising, Amazon, email, and tracking.

Develop a clear growth plan.

Launch and optimise paid campaigns.

Improve our Amazon listings and PPC.

Establish effective email flows.

Build reliable reporting and tracking.

Identify what is working and scale it.

Create repeatable marketing processes that the company can continue to use as we grow.

Compensation



Base: AUD $1,600 per month



Performance Bonus: 8% of Net Attributable Profit generated through the channels you manage.



The bonus is designed to reward profitable growth and is not capped during the first six months.



CoolHed also covers approved marketing software and tools required for the role.



First 60 days: Base compensation applies, with an additional one-off $400 kick-start bonus when the required Week-2 audit and Week-4 campaign setup are completed on time.



Working Arrangement

Remote / international applicants welcome.

Minimum 3 hours of overlap with Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST) on campaign days.

Full-time commitment.

Contractor or employee arrangement depending on location and circumstances.

Immediate start available.

How to Apply



Please don't send a generic marketing CV alone.



We'd like to see evidence of what you've actually achieved.



Please provide:



Your CV.

A short case study showing a product or e-commerce brand you helped grow.

The channels you managed and the results you achieved.

Your experience with Amazon, paid advertising, and email marketing.

A short audit of CoolHed's website or Amazon listing with 5 improvements you would make.

Examples of campaigns, listings, or marketing work you've personally worked on where possible.



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a paid 4-hour practical task ($150 AUD) involving a CoolHed channel audit and a 14-day growth plan.



Who We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who is hungry, practical, commercially minded, and willing to take ownership.



If you enjoy looking at numbers, testing new ideas, improving campaigns, and turning marketing into actual sales, we'd love to hear from you.



Join CoolHed and help us build an international brand from Australia.

title: Short-Form Video Editor & Content Creator
description:
Summary:

We're looking for a creative and dependable Short-Form Video Editor & Content Creator to help grow a personal brand focused on business, entrepreneurship, training, and education.

This isn't a traditional hourly position.

We pay for results, not hours.

There is no time tracking or requirement to sit at your computer for a certain number of hours. If you can create a great piece of content efficiently, that's a good thing. We care about quality, consistency, meeting deadlines, and creating content people actually want to watch.

We're looking for someone who can eventually do more than simply follow editing instructions. We want someone who can understand the content, recognize engaging moments, and help turn raw ideas and footage into great social media content.





Job Description



Key Responsibilities

Your primary responsibility will be turning raw footage and existing content into engaging short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and other platforms.

This includes editing raw talking-head footage; creating strong pacing and clean cuts; adding engaging captions, graphics, B-roll, music, sound effects, zooms, and transitions when appropriate; and maintaining consistent branding and quality.

You'll also help repurpose long-form content. You may receive a training, webinar, interview, podcast, or longer video and be expected to identify the strongest moments that could become individual short-form videos.



Some assignments may be simpler than others. More advanced projects that fall substantially outside the scope of a standard short-form edit may be priced separately before work begins.



B-Roll & Visual Storytelling

We're specifically looking for someone who understands good B-roll, not someone who just adds random stock footage.

You should understand how to use visuals to reinforce what's being said, maintain attention, illustrate an idea, create emotion, and make videos more visually interesting without over-editing it.



Content Development

Depending on your skills, you may also help with:

 • Creating graphics/carousels 

 • Brainstorming hooks and content ideas 

 • Repurposing one piece of content into multiple posts 

 • Researching trends within our niche 

 • Identifying successful editing styles and formats 

 • Creating thumbnails/covers 

 • Helping organize and maintain a content library/calendar 

 • Scheduling/publishing content 



Qualifications

You should have demonstrated experience editing engaging short-form content and a strong understanding of Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

We're looking for someone with:

 • Strong short-form editing skills 

 • Good judgment about pacing and viewer retention 

 • An eye for engaging B-roll 

 • Strong attention to detail 

 • Creativity without unnecessary over-editing 

 • Ability to follow a brand/style guide 

 • Ability to accept feedback and improve quickly 

 • Ability to work independently 

 • Reliable communication 

 • Consistent ability to meet deadlines 

 • Understanding of current short-form trends, hooks, and editing styles 

Experience with CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or comparable professional editing software is welcome. We're more interested in the quality of your finished work than which software you use.



Equipment Requirements

You must have:

 • A reliable computer capable of handling video editing 

 • Reliable internet 

 • Enough storage and performance to download, edit, and upload video files consistently 

 • Your own editing software/tools 



What We Offer

 • Complete work independence, no time tracking 

 • Work from anywhere 

 • Flexible schedule as long as deadlines are met 

 • Consistent ongoing work for the right person 

 • Clear expectations and feedback 

 • Opportunity for increased volume and responsibilities 

 • Opportunity for higher-paying/advanced projects as skills and responsibilities grow 

We want this to become a long-term working relationship with someone who learns our brand and becomes increasingly capable of turning raw content into finished posts independently.



How to Apply

Please submit:

 1. Your resume

 2. Your portfolio that includes 3–5 examples of short-form videos you've personally edited. 

 3. A brief explanation of what you believe makes a short-form video engaging.

THE ROLE

• “My
 isn't working.”

title: AI Shopify Dropshipping Operator - Product Research, Store Management & Organic TikTok/Reels
description:
I am looking for one hands-on e-commerce operator who can personally build and manage a Shopify dropshipping business from product research through organic customer acquisition.



You must be strong in both Shopify execution and original short-form video. This is not a programming role, an Amazon/eBay role or a paid-ads-only role. Initial growth will come from organic TikTok and Instagram Reels. I provide strategic input and can provide copy direction, but you are responsible for daily execution and measurable progress.



RESPONSIBILITIES

- Research products using current demand, competition, margin, shipping and creative-potential evidence.

- Verify suppliers, product quality signals, delivery times and unit economics.

- Build or improve the Shopify store, product pages, navigation, variants, apps and conversion flow.

- Create original TikTok and Instagram Reels using strong hooks, demonstrations, captions and calls to action.

- Publish consistently, review organic performance and improve products and creative based on data.

- Provide a weekly report covering work completed, content output, views, engagement, traffic, conversion signals, costs and next actions.



INITIAL PAID TEST

- 10 tracked hours at $8 per hour, maximum $80 total.

- Deliver one evidence-based product analysis.

- Identify and verify one suitable supplier.

- Build one complete conversion-focused Shopify product page.

- Produce one original vertical Reel suitable for both TikTok and Instagram.

- Deliver editable project/source files and a video walkthrough of the completed work.



If your verified evidence and experience are exceptional, I may consider up to $10 per hour for the test. If the test succeeds, the role can continue initially at a maximum of eight hours per week. Strong profitable performance can lead to a higher rate and a long-term or full-time position.



WORKING CONDITIONS

- You must personally perform all work. No delegation, agency staff or subcontractors without my written approval.

- Do not claim guaranteed sales or viral results. I want evidence, disciplined testing and accountable execution.



REQUIRED PROOF

Send 2-3 exact Shopify store URLs and 3-5 TikTok or Instagram Reels you personally created. For each example, state your exact role, dates, what you personally completed and the measurable organic result. Provide dated evidence for traffic, views or conversions and explain how the result can be connected to your work.



Also answer:

1. Which AI tools and exact models do you use for product research, product-page creation, images/video and editing? What is AI-generated versus manually completed?

2. Describe one product you selected: why you selected it, supplier, landed cost, selling price, delivery time and organic content angle.

3. How would you turn one product into seven different organic TikTok/Reels concepts?

4. What are your computer specifications: CPU, GPU, RAM, storage and operating system?

5. What are your normal upload/download speeds, and what backup internet and power do you have?



Start your proposal with ORGANIC so I know you read the full description.

title: CRM Manager (Hubspot)
description:
ABOUT THE JOB



Our client is a dual-badged official TikTok agency. They're a technology-driven social commerce partner for growth-minded consumer brands, combining senior human expertise with an agentic commerce stack that connects creators, brands, and platforms in one unified layer.



Their team has generated $80 Million in GMV through creator partnerships, helping 8-10 figure e-commerce brands scale through social commerce strategies. They orchestrate the full journey from discovery to checkout, transforming social from a brand channel into a primary revenue storefront.



THE ROLE



Our client gets around 500 inbound leads a month and is onboarding new enterprise clients every week. HubSpot is where all of that lives, and right now it doesn't keep up.



You own it. You'll keep the data clean, build the workflows that move leads through the pipeline without anyone chasing them, and fix what's broken before it costs a deal.



This isn't a data entry role. You d
 how the system should work and you build it.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Own HubSpot: Properties, pipelines, deal stages, lifecycle stages, permissions, and integrations. You're the person who knows how it's set up and why.



- Keep the data clean: Deduplicate records, enforce required fields, fix bad imports, and make sure what leadership sees in a report is actually true.



- Build the workflows: Lead routing and assignment, follow-up sequences, task automation, and internal notifications. Cut the manual steps out of the sales and onboarding process.



- Connect the stack: Keep HubSpot talking to the other tools the team runs on, including forms, calendars,
, and Slack. Fix sync issues before anyone notices them.



- Report on what matters: Build dashboards leadership actually uses for pipeline, conversion, lead source performance, and client onboarding status. No vanity metrics.



- Fix things and keep them fixed: When something breaks or someone asks why a lead fell through, you find the cause, fix it, and document it so it doesn't happen again.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- 2+ years working hands-on in HubSpot (Sales Hub and Marketing Hub), agency or brand side

- Proven experience building workflows, automations, and custom reports, not just using someone else's setup

- Comfortable with integrations, data imports, and troubleshooting sync issues

- Detail-obsessed about data quality, because you know a dirty CRM makes every report a guess

- Clear, direct writing, since most of this job happens in Slack



NICE TO HAVE



- HubSpot certifications

- Experience at a fast-growing agency or e-commerce company

- Experience with other CRMs such as Salesforce or Pipedrive

- Light scripting or API work

- Comfort using AI tools to move faster



HOW WE KNOW YOU'LL BE GOOD AT THIS



- You fix a broken workflow before anyone reports it

- You tell leadership when a request would make the system worse, and propose something better

- You ask one sharp question, then build, instead of waiting for a full spec

- You'd rather ship a working automation this week than a perfect system next quarter



WHY THIS ROLE



- Above-market base pay, plus commission tied to company performance

- Work with well-known enterprise consumer brands

- Hypergrowth: around 500 inbound leads a month and new enterprise clients every week

- A flat structure with minimal red tape and real room to grow as the company scales



PROCESS



Intro call > Skills screen > Live assignment on a real account scenario > Final call with leadership

Who We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:

- Reliable and dependable

- Resilient and able to stay calm in a fast-paced healthcare environment

- Comfortable communicating with patients about sensitive health and social needs

- Strong in written communication

- Patient, compassionate, and solution-focused

Healthcare, care coordination, CCM, medical assisting, virtual assisting, customer service, or patient-support experience is preferred, but we are willing to train the right candidate who demonstrates strong judgment, professionalism, and a willingness to learn.

Training Commitment

This position includes a structured six-week training and onboarding period.

Because training is comprehensive and each week builds on the previous week, full attendance during the first six weeks is extremely important. Candidates should only apply if they are able to commit to the entire training period without planned call-outs, vacations, or avoidable absences.

We are investing significant time and resources into training, and in return, we are looking for someone who is ready to make the same commitment to learning the role.

title: Short-Form Video Editor / Content Tastemaker (US Humor, Meme-Fluent) – Instagram Reels
description:
About us: We run several fast-growing Instagram accounts for a fitness and lifestyle creator. Together they get millions of reel views a month. We already have a team of editors for volume. This hire is for taste: someone who knows meme culture and spots new formats before they peak.



What you'll do:

- Turn raw footage of the creator into Reels and Trial Reels that feel native to US internet culture

- Spot trends, sounds and meme formats early and adapt them before they peak

- Write short, punchy on-screen captions and hooks in natural American English (POV, ironic, absurdist, relatable)

- Make new formats for the other editors to copy, and give feedback on their edits

- Edit in CapCut (or better)



You're a fit if:

- You're chronically online. You know what's funny on TikTok, 
 and
/X this week, not last year

- You understand American humor, irony and slang, and your captions don't read as translated

- You have an eye for pacing, first-second hooks and music choice

- You're comfortable working with a lifestyle creator's content (fitness, fashion, swimwear)

- You have a stable internet connection



Nice to have:

- Clean face and skin retouching without default presets



Pay and benefits:

- Starts at $700/mo, up to $950/mo after 30 days based on performance

- Bi-weekly payment

- Flexible schedule: work whenever you want, as long as it's done on time with 40 hours a week

- Flexible time off if requested



APPLICATION TEST (required, about 15 minutes)



Part 1 - Rank these 5 reels from most viral to least viral, based on how you think a US audience reacted:



Reel A: 

Reel B: 

Reel C: 

Reel D: 

Reel E: 



Write your ranking as letters from best to worst (for example: C, A, E, B, D), with one sentence for each on why you put it there. There's a right answer, since we know how each one performed. Your reasoning counts as much as the order.



Part 2 - Send us 3 memes you find funny right now that would be good references for this creator. Send links (TikTok, Instagram, X or YouTube) to memes posted in the last 30 days. For each one, write one sentence on how you'd adapt it for a fitness and lifestyle creator.



HOW TO APPLY

1. The first line of your message must be MEME LORD (putting it only in the subject line doesn't count)

2. Send 5+ links to short-form videos you made. Public TikTok or Instagram links are best. If you send Drive files, add a screenshot of the views or insights

3. Put your answers to Parts 1 and 2 in the message itself



We don't review applications that skip any of these steps.



NEXT STEP: We'll invite the top 3-5 applicants to a short paid trial (about 1 hour, paid even if we don't hire you): write caption and hook options for 2 of our raw clips and edit one into a meme format.

20 hours/week | €500 guaranteed base + up to €100/month bonus | Paid test | Long-term 

 

You do not need to write scripts, come up with concepts or create marketing strategy. We provide the raw footage, script/voice-over, structure and reference videos. Your job is to turn them into fast-paced, highly engaging short-form videos.

- Clean cuts, punch-ins, zooms and visual changes

- 20 hours/week

- Paid editing test for shortlisted candidates

- Weekly payments during the first weeks

- Long-term position

- Opportunity to grow toward 40 hours/week

HOW TO APPLY

BLUE MANGO



For example:

BLUE MANGO – Video Editor Application



Applications without BLUE MANGO at the beginning of the application title may not be reviewed.



Please include:



1. Attach your CV/resume.



2. Send links to your 3 BEST short-form video edits.

9. Briefly describe your internet/power reliability and backup setup.



10. Confirm that €500/month base + up to €100/month performance bonus works for you. If your expected compensation is higher, you may state it.



11. Have you applied to another position from our company? If yes, which role would be your first choice?



Shortlisted candidates will complete a PAID editing test using real footage from our workflow.

We look forward to reviewing your application and learning more about your experience.

• Proven experience in short-form video editing

• Skilled in CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or similar editing tools

• Deep understanding of TikTok and Instagram trends, algorithms, and formats

• Strong knowledge of US public figures, especially TikTokers, YouTubers, and internet culture

• Ability to work quickly and meet tight deadlines

• Good English communication skills

• Reliable, organized, and able to work with minimal supervision

• Must have a portfolio or samples of short-form content



Nice to Have

• Meme editing skills

• Motion graphics or basic animation

• Thumbnail design experience

• Experience with YouTube Shorts growth



How to Apply

Send your:

1. Resume

2. Portfolio or sample videos

Application Twist

To prove you read this whole post, start your application with the word SLIMEGO EDITOR as your subject.

Applications without this word will not be prioritized.

title: Wholesale real estate
description:
Summary

Virtual Assistant Role

Role: Inbound SMS Lead Screener

Primary Objective

Your only responsibility is to qualify fresh inbound SMS leads generated through our marketing campaigns.

You are not responsible for negotiating or closing deals. Your job is simply to identify motivated sellers and gather basic information before handing the lead off.

Daily Responsibilities

Monitor GoHighLevel

Stay logged into GoHighLevel during your scheduled shift.

Watch for all new inbound SMS responses.

Response Time (Most Important KPI)

Every positive response must receive a phone call within 5-15 minutes.

If you cannot reach the seller:

Call 3x

Leave a voi
 (when appropriate)

Send a follow-up text

Place In Redial (redial x2 if on the second batch)

Filter Leads

No Motivation

Examples:

Not interested

Wrong number

Already sold

Just asking random question

No interest in selling

Action:

Mark conversation as Read

No further action needed

Positive Responses

Examples:

"Yes"

"Maybe"

"Thinking about selling"

"What's your offer?"

"Call me"

"I'm interested"

A number below or near market value

Action:

Call immediately (within 5 minutes)

Gather surface-level information (price, condition, motivation, timeline)

Mark the lead appropriately

Notify acquisitions if qualified

Information to Gather

Do not overcomplicate the call.

Simply collect:

Seller Name

Property Address

Is this the property they're selling?

Asking Price (if any)

Condition of the property

Confirm Bed/Bath/Sqft

Reason for selling

Timeline to sell

Best callback number

Best time to reach them for an offer call.

Keep the conversation natural.

Qualified Lead

A lead is considered Qualified if:

✅ They own (or control) the property

✅ They are willing to sell

✅ They show some level of motivation

If they meet those three criteria, they should be passed to acquisitions.

End of Shift Requirements

Metrics to track:

Hours Worked

Positive Responses

Qualified Leads

Goal: Turn every interested SMS response into a qualified lead for the acquisitions team.

title: Short-Form Video Editor — UGC, Overlays & Transitions (HIGH VOLUME 200-300 Videos / Month)
description:
Short-Form Video Editor — UGC, Overlays & Transitions



Location: New York City, NY | Remote Position | Philippines or Similar Time Zone Preferred



We’re looking for a talented short-form video editor to work directly with me on a high-performing social media page. We create content designed to capture attention immediately, maintain viewer retention, and perform exceptionally well on TikTok and Instagram Reels.



This is not a basic video-cutting role. I’m looking for someone who understands how to transform raw footage into polished, engaging UGC videos through creative hooks, high-level overlays, seamless transitions, and professional visual storytelling.



What You’ll Be Doing



Hook optimization: Make the first 1–3 seconds compelling through strong opening cuts, text, visuals, and creative editing that immediately captures attention.



High-level overlays: Incorporate relevant images, screenshots, graphics, headlines, pop-ups, and other visual elements that reinforce the message and keep viewers engaged.



Professional transitions: Create smooth, intentional transitions between clips, images, and scenes. The goal is a polished, dynamic flow—not basic cuts between talking-head footage.



Dynamic editing: Use punch-ins, zooms, reframing, motion effects, speed adjustments, and creative visual techniques to maintain attention.



B-roll and visual storytelling: Understand the dialogue, identify the key points, and pair the audio with relevant supporting footage and imagery.



Retention-focused pacing: Remove dead space, emphasize important moments, and keep the content moving without sacrificing clarity.



Creative independence: Bring your own ideas and editing style to the content while following the general direction and quality standards of the page.



My biggest priorities are hooks, overlays, images, and transitions. I want someone who knows how to make a video feel visually rich, professional, and engaging. Simply adding captions and cutting out pauses is not enough.



Application Process — Required Editing Test



To apply, you must complete the following test. Your three edited videos will be the primary factor in our hiring decision. We want to evaluate the actual quality of your work, not just your résumé or previous experience.



Step 1: Download the Raw Footage



Use the footage linked below to create three separate short-form UGC videos.



Raw footage: 
 



Your goal is to break the footage into three compelling videos, each with its own strong hook, clear narrative, and professional editing.



Pay particular attention to:



Strong opening hooks that immediately grab attention.



Creative, relevant image overlays and on-screen visual elements.



Smooth transitions between footage, images, and scenes.



Dynamic pacing, strategic zooms, and engaging visual changes.



Relevant B-roll and supporting visuals that complement the dialogue.



Overall polish, professionalism, and suitability for TikTok and Instagram Reels.



Step 2: Review My Editing Example




 



Use my edit as a reference for the general direction and quality I’m looking for. However, I also want to see your own professional judgment, creativity, and editing style.



Don't simply copy my video. Show me how you would elevate the content using your own ideas, particularly when it comes to hooks, overlays, transitions, and visual storytelling.



Step 3: Submit Your Application and Videos



CLICK HERE TO APPLY AND UPLOAD YOUR THREE VIDEOS: 
 



Please submit your application and all three completed videos through the form above.



Important: The professionalism and quality of these three videos will be the primary basis of our hiring decision. Take the time to demonstrate what you can do.



Requirements



Strong experience with CapCut or comparable video editing software.



Previous experience editing TikTok videos, Instagram Reels, or short-form UGC content.



Excellent understanding of hooks, overlays, transitions, pacing, and audience retention.



Strong English comprehension and attention to detail.



Ability to independently interpret dialogue and select appropriate supporting visuals.

Ability to work collaboratively, take constructive feedback, and improve quickly.



Availability for approximately 3–4 hours per day, 5–6 days per week. Days off are flexible, provided your schedule remains consistent.



Ability to receive payments through Wise.



Based in the Philippines or a similar time zone.



Compensation & Growth Opportunity



You’ll work directly with me on a high-performing social media page with significant growth potential.



There is room for performance-based bonuses when deadlines are met and content performs well. As the workload grows, there is also potential for additional hours and increased compensation.



I’m looking for someone reliable, creative, and detail-oriented who wants to develop a long-term working relationship and help produce consistently excellent content.

description:
Job Summary



We are looking for a highly organized, proactive and dependable Senior Virtual Assistant to join the core remote team of a Hong Kong-based company.

This is not a basic task-based VA position. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of recurring workflows, work independently, maintain accurate records and ensure responsibilities are completed without repeated follow-up.

You will work across different departments based on company requirements and your strongest skills. Areas may include Operations, Supply Chain, Government Documentation and Administration.

title: Video Editor
description:
A client and I are looking for a reliable, creative Video Editor VA to support edits of long form video content.



This role is ideal for someone who understands how to turn raw talking-head footage, B-roll, podcasts, or educational content into polished, engaging videos for platforms like Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and potentially longer-form YouTube content. We also have lots of very long videos that can be repurposed into content. 



You should have a strong eye for pacing, clean design, and storytelling. We’re looking for someone who can follow an established brand style while also recognizing opportunities to make content more engaging.



You’ll help with:



- Editing short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

- Cutting longer videos into multiple usable social media clips

- Removing pauses, filler, mistakes, and unnecessary footage

- Adding clean captions and on-screen text

- Incorporating B-roll, graphics, screenshots, or other visual elements where appropriate

- Selecting music and sound effects when needed

- Creating strong pacing and visual movement without over-editing

- Formatting content correctly for each platform

- Following existing brand guidelines and editing styles

- Organizing completed files and maintaining a clear editing workflow

- Making revisions based on feedback

- Meeting agreed-upon turnaround times



Depending on experience, there may also be opportunities to help identify strong clips or hooks within longer-form content.



You’re likely a good fit if you:



- Have experience editing social media video content

- Understand short-form pacing and viewer retention

- Can create polished videos without relying on excessive effects or trendy editing

- Have strong attention to detail

- Can follow creative direction while using good judgment independently

- Communicate clearly and reliably

- Are comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions

- Can maintain consistency across multiple pieces of content

- Have experience setting up a YouTube account and managing it.



Experience with tools such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar editing software is welcome.



## Application Questions



Please include:



1. Tell us about your video editing experience.  

How long have you been editing professionally, and what types of content do you edit most often?



2. Which editing software do you use most frequently?



3. Share 3–5 examples of videos you personally edited.  

Please specify exactly what you were responsible for on each project.



4. How would you describe your experience level?



- Beginner: I understand editing software and have completed personal or practice projects.

- Developing: I have edited content for clients or businesses but still typically work from detailed instructions.

- Intermediate: I regularly edit client content and can independently make decisions about pacing, cuts, captions, B-roll, and visual storytelling.

- Advanced: I have extensive client experience, understand retention and platform-specific editing, and can take raw footage through the full editing process with minimal direction.



5. Experience Check:  

Imagine you receive a 10-minute talking-head video and are asked to turn it into three short-form videos.



Briefly explain how you would decide:



- Which sections to turn into clips

- Where each video should begin

- What you would remove

- Where you would add B-roll or text

- How you would keep the viewer engaged



There is no single correct answer. We want to understand how you think as an editor.



6. If a speaker takes 15 seconds to get to the main point of a video, how would you handle the opening? Why?



7. What is your typical turnaround time for a 30–90 second social video?



8. Approximately how many short-form videos could you comfortably edit each week?



9. What is your hourly rate or preferred project/retainer rate?



10. What time zone are you in, and what hours are you typically available?



Bonus Experience



Not required, but let us know if you also have experience with:



- Identifying clips from long-form content

- YouTube editing

- Podcast editing and management

- Content repurposing

- Motion graphics

- Canva

- Thumbnail creation

- Basic social media management

- Organizing content libraries or digital assets

title: QA Clinical Note Reviewer (Offshore)
description:
QA Clinical Note Reviewer (Offshore)



Department: Clinical Quality & Compliance

Company location: California, USA

Work location: Remote (Offshore)

Reports to: Director of Clinical Operations

Employment type: Full-time

Rate: $5/hr

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Time (PT), aligned with our California-based clinical and compliance teams



Position Summary

We are a California-based organization seeking a detail-oriented Registered Nurse to serve as a QA Note Reviewer for wound care. You will review provider encounter notes for accuracy, completeness, and compliance, and make sure documentation supports medical necessity, meets payer and regulatory requirements, and is ready for billing and audit. You will work closely with the US-based clinical and compliance teams.



Key Responsibilities

Review wound care encounter notes (initial evaluations, follow-up visits, debridements, and advanced wound therapies) for completeness and accuracy.

Verify required clinical elements are documented, including:

Wound location, etiology, and type (e.g., diabetic foot ulcer, venous leg ulcer, pressure injury, arterial ulcer, surgical wound)

Measurements (length, width, depth), tissue type, drainage, odor, undermining and tunneling

Staging or classification (e.g., NPUAP/NPIAP stage, Wagner grade)

Wound progress and healing trajectory compared to prior visits

Treatment plan, offloading, compression, infection control, and patient education

Confirm that documentation supports medical necessity and aligns with applicable CMS guidelines, LCD/NCD requirements, and payer policies, particularly for debridement and skin substitute/cellular tissue product (CTP) applications.

Audit wound care notes against Billing and Coding Article A58565 (Wound and Ulcer Care), its parent LCD L38902, and LCD L36690 (Wound Application of CTPs, Lower Extremities) where applicable, and flag documentation that does not support coverage or correct coding.

Verify that CTP/skin substitute notes show:

Failed response to at least 4 weeks of documented standard wound care, including the specific interventions that were tried

Wound measurements at baseline, at the end of the 4-week period, and before each application

The other coverage criteria: wound size, clean granular base, adequate circulation, infection and osteomyelitis ruled out or resolved, diabetes diagnosis and management for DFUs, offloading or compression, and smoking cessation counseling where applicable

Check application limits and exclusions, including the cap on applications per wound episode, no simultaneous use of multiple products, retreatment restrictions, and contraindications such as uncontrolled diabetes or active infection.

Verify that debridement documentation matches the code billed (97597/97598/97602 vs.
), based on the deepest tissue level actually removed rather than the depth of the ulcer, and that procedure notes include the elements required by A58565.

Flag billing and coding errors covered by A58565, such as separately billing dressings, incorrect modifier use for multiple wounds, billing E/M with debridement without a separately identifiable service, and billing 97610 with other wound care codes on the same day.

Check consistency between the note, diagnosis codes (ICD-10), and procedure codes (CPT/HCPCS), and flag discrepancies.

Identify missing or contradictory information, copy-forward or cloned documentation, and unsupported conclusions.

Document findings in the QA tracking system using standardized scoring rubrics and error categories.

Return notes to providers or the clinical team with clear, professional, actionable feedback and follow up on corrections.

Meet daily and weekly productivity and accuracy targets.

Track error trends and contribute to regular reports on common documentation gaps and provider-level patterns.

Support internal and external audit preparation as needed.

Maintain strict confidentiality and follow HIPAA and company data security policies at all times.



Required Qualifications

Registered Nurse (RN) with a current, valid license.

At least 2 years of experience in clinical documentation and note review.

Strong working knowledge of wound care terminology, wound classification, and standard treatment protocols.

Familiarity with Medicare documentation requirements and medical necessity criteria.

Working proficiency in Billing and Coding Article A58565 (Wound and Ulcer Care) and its parent LCD L38902, including debridement coding rules, documentation requirements, covered diagnosis code groups, and utilization guidelines.

Ability to find and apply the current version of LCDs and billing articles through the CMS Medicare Coverage Database, and to stay current on revisions. Familiarity with other MAC wound care and skin substitute policies as applicable to the states we serve.

Availability to work 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Time, Monday to Friday.

Proficiency with EHR systems and Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.

Reliable high-speed internet, a secure home workspace, and a company-compliant computer setup.



Preferred Qualifications

Working knowledge of LCD L36690 and skin substitute/CTP documentation requirements across multiple MACs.

Certification such as WCC, CWS, CPC, CCS, or CDIP.

Working knowledge of ICD-10-CM and CPT/HCPCS coding, including NCCI edits and modifiers.

Experience performing pre-bill or post-payment reviews on wound care services.

Experience with mobile wound care, home health, skilled nursing, or outpatient wound clinics.

Experience with RCM, audit, or compliance functions.

Prior experience working with US-based healthcare teams.



Skills and Competencies

Analytical thinking and sound clinical judgment

Clear, diplomatic communication when giving feedback to providers

Self-directed, dependable, and comfortable in a remote environment

Ability to learn changing payer rules and apply them consistently

Strong time management and prioritization

Performance Metrics

Notes reviewed per day or week

QA accuracy rate, measured through calibration and second-level audits

Turnaround time on reviews

Quality and clarity of feedback

Reduction in recurring documentation errors over time



What We Offer

Competitive salary, with performance incentives

Training in our documentation standards, tools, and compliance policies

Growth opportunities into senior QA, auditor, or clinical compliance roles

Collaborative, mission-driven team supporting wound care patients



Compliance Notice

This role involves access to protected health information (PHI). All employees must complete HIPAA training, sign confidentiality agreements, and pass a background check before starting.

title: SEO Coordinator / Specialist
description:
About us

Midstream Digital Marketing gets financial advisory firms to the top of local search and keeps them there. One of our clients has held the #1 Google map pack position in Houston — one of the most competitive advisor markets in the US — since 2015.

We already have a full team of SEO specialists, writers, and web people doing the work. What we don't have is one person whose entire job is making sure all of it is actually happening, and actually working.

This is not a task-execution role. You won't be writing the content or building the citations. You'll be the person who catches it when a ranking slips, when a Google Business Profile post didn't go out, when a page got published with broken schema, or when a client account has quietly gone three weeks without anything shipping.





What you'll own

• Monitor rankings, traffic, and Search Console across all client accounts — daily on key terms, weekly on the full set

• Spot and escalate problems early: ranking drops, traffic declines, indexing issues, crawl errors, site outages, review-rating dips

• Audit the team's completed work against our standards before it reaches the client — titles, metas, schema, internal links, citation accuracy, GBP posts

• Track that every recurring deliverable actually shipped, on every account, every month

• Keep ClickUp honest: flag tasks that are stalled, overdue, or marked complete without the work being done

• Run competitor monitoring — know when someone is moving on our clients' positions before our clients do

• Build the monthly performance report for each account: what moved, what didn't, what's at risk

• Give the team specific, documented feedback on what needs rework and why





What we need from you

• 5+ years of hands-on SEO, with significant local SEO and Google Business Profile experience. You must have done this work yourself to be able to judge it

• You've been through multiple Google algorithm updates and know the difference between a real ranking problem and normal volatility

• The ability to look at someone else's finished page and tell whether it was done properly

• Fluent in Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and a rank tracker (Ahrefs, SEMrush, or similar)

• Comfortable in WordPress — you'll be inspecting live client sites, not just dashboards

• Strong written English. Your reports and your feedback both need to be clear and professional

• Genuinely detail-oriented. This role is 80% noticing things

• Willing to raise problems directly, including when the answer is "this was done wrong, it needs redoing." If you avoid difficult conversations, this isn't your role

• Reliable internet with a backup connection





Nice to have

• Experience overseeing or QA-ing other SEO people's work

• Financial services, wealth management, or other regulated/YMYL experience

• Looker Studio or automated reporting

• Schema markup you can read and write by hand

• Elementor





Why this role is worth your time

• Long-term, stable position. Our people stay for years, not months

• Paid on time, every time, no exceptions

• 13th month pay

• Real authority — your findings drive what the team works on

• You work directly with the owner, not through layers of account managers

• You'll see your work hold rankings for firms managing hundreds of millions in assets



How to apply

Apply through this job posting. If you have trouble applying here,
 your application to

title: Sales Operations Coordinator
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

THE ROLE

You are the Revenue Director's right hand on the backend of the sales team. You handle data collection, make sure closers and setters complete their end-of-day (EOD) reporting, validate data accuracy across the dashboards, and manage the spreadsheets that run the sales function.



You do not manage or discipline reps. You collect, verify, and report. If something is late, missing, or does not add up, it goes straight to the Revenue Director, and he handles it.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



1. Data collection and EOD accountability



- Confirm every closer and setter has submitted their EOD by the deadline

- Log EOD numbers into the manual tracking sheets, accurately and the same day

- Report misses and late submissions to the Revenue Director each day



2. Data validation (HubSpot and dashboards)



- Cross-check reported EOD numbers against HubSpot activity, call logs, recordings, and reporting dashboards

- Confirm deals, stages, notes, and next steps are logged correctly

- Log every discrepancy (reported vs. actual) and send a short daily summary to the Revenue Director

- Do not confront reps. Document and escalate



3. Spreadsheet management



- Build and maintain trackers, spreadsheets, dashboards, and reporting templates

- Keep sheets clean, organized, and consistent so anyone on the team can find what they need

- Update weekly and monthly performance reports for the Revenue Director

- Spot recurring issues in the data and suggest better ways to track them



4. Backend support



- Handle ad hoc operational tasks from the Revenue Director

- Light Zapier and integration work to remove repetitive admin where it is safe to do so

- Document processes so they can be handed off



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- 2+ years in sales ops, admin, or a support role for a sales team

- Strong Google Sheets and Google Workspace skills

- Working knowledge of HubSpot (views, properties, reports)

- Comfortable with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) and basic Zapier

- Strong written English and complete discretion (you will see sensitive performance and revenue data)

- Must work Eastern Standard Time (EST) hours. Core shift: 9am to 4pm EST. Please confirm you can commit to this before applying



NICE TO HAVE



- Agency, e-commerce, or social commerce background

- Canva or Google Slides design sense

- Familiarity with Slack, Fathom, or Loom



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



First 30 days: 100% of closer and setter EODs collected and logged daily, validation routine running, and daily summary delivered on time.



First 60 days: Discrepancy log producing clear patterns by rep, and core trackers and dashboards shipped.



First 90 days: You run the data and accountability function with minimal direction and proactively flag issues to the Revenue Director.

Submit a 1-2 minute video describing why you'd be a good fit for this role.

The role

You take it, you handle it, and they hear about it only if they genuinely need to. The bar for this role is simple: we have to be able to hand you something and be completely confident it's done, without following up.

What you'll do

What we're looking for

Extremely organized, with nothing falling through the cracks across dozens of moving pieces

You fix things before anyone asks you to.

You tell us something's slipping the day you see it, not the day it breaks.

Early escalation: Raise discrepancies, cash-flow concerns, missing documents or compliance risks early.

title: Appointment Setter / Cold Caller
description:
Cold Caller / Outbound Appointment Setter



Location: Fully Remote (Ph) Schedule: Monday–Friday, 10:00 AM–6:00 PM EST (approximately 11:00 PM–7:00 AM Manila time — this is a night shift) Compensation: $850 USD per month base + $25 USD per qualified appointment that shows + $100 USD per client that signs



About T3 Tech Partners



T3 Tech Partners is the team MSPs rely on when challenges exceed Tier 2 or internal expertise. We operate as a Fractional Tier 3 partner, delivering advanced Systems Administration, Infrastructure, Networking cloud, and security expertise to MSPs supporting diverse client environments.



Our engineers are trusted technical partners — leading implementations, resolving complex escalations, and working directly with MSP clients to execute real-world solutions. Our outbound team is the first voice those partners hear, and that first impression matters.



Role Overview



We are seeking an experienced Cold Caller / Outbound Appointment Setter to drive outbound prospecting into Managed Service Providers and IT firms across the United States. You will own the top of the funnel — building call lists, making high-volume outbound calls, handling objections in real time, and booking qualified discovery meetings for our leadership team.



This is a voice-first, customer-facing role. Native-level spoken English is a hard requirement, not a preference. You will be speaking with US-based business owners, IT directors, and MSP principals every day. Applicants with a noticeable accent that impedes clarity, or with hesitant, scripted-sounding delivery, will not be advanced.



This role requires resilience, independence, and the ability to hold a confident business conversation with senior technical decision-makers without a script to hide behind.



Key Responsibilities

Outbound Calling & Prospecting

Make a high volume of outbound cold calls per day to MSPs, IT service firms, and internal IT departments across US time zones.

Open conversations confidently with owners, principals, and IT decision-makers.

Qualify prospects against our ideal-client profile (company size, service mix, existing Tier 3 gaps).

Handle gatekeepers professionally and consistently reach the decision-maker.

Book qualified discovery calls and appointments directly onto the sales calendar.

Objection Handling & Conversation Quality

Respond to objections in real time without reading verbatim from a script.

Adapt tone and pacing to the person on the other end of the line.

Communicate our value proposition clearly to a technical audience without overstating technical claims.

Know when to disqualify a prospect quickly and move on.

Follow-Up & Pipeline Management

Execute structured follow-up sequences by phone,
, and LinkedIn.

Log every call, outcome, and next step accurately in the CRM the same day.

Maintain and clean prospect lists, correcting bad data as you encounter it.

Nurture "not right now" prospects on a defined callback cadence.

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

Report daily and weekly on dials, connects, conversations, and appointments set.

Participate in call reviews and act on coaching feedback.

Test and report on messaging, opening lines, and list segments.

Flag recurring objections and market feedback to leadership.

Availability & Support Expectations

Standard working hours are 10:00 AM–6:00 PM EST, Monday through Friday.

This is a night shift in the Philippines — roughly 11:00 PM to 7:00 AM Manila time. Please only apply if you have worked a graveyard schedule before and can sustain it long term.

Some flexibility is required during active campaigns or event-driven outreach.

This role is not on-call, but consistent attendance during US business hours is essential.

Qualifications

Required Experience

2+ years of outbound cold calling, appointment setting, or SDR experience into the US market.

Native-level or near-native English, spoken and written, with a neutral or American accent. Clear articulation, natural pacing, and confident phone presence are non-negotiable.

Proven ability to hold unscripted business conversations with senior decision-makers.

Demonstrated track record of hitting dial, conversation, and appointment-set targets.

Experience with CRM and dialer platforms (HubSpot, Go High Level, Close, Aircall, or similar).

Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet dedicated workspace, a backup power source, and a quality noise-cancelling headset.

Comfortable with rejection and high call volume; self-directed with minimal supervision.

Preferred Experience

Prior outbound experience selling into MSPs, IT services, or B2B technology.

Working familiarity with Microsoft 365, cloud, or managed IT terminology.

Experience building or sourcing prospect lists (Apollo, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).

Compensation

Base: $1,000 USD per month, paid twice monthly.

Appointment commission: $25 USD for every qualified appointment that shows.

Conversion bonus: $100 USD for every prospect who signs on for services after a meeting you booked.

No minimum threshold. Commission is paid from the first qualified appointment.



What counts as a qualified appointment:



The meeting must actually take place, and the person on the call must be a decision-maker or a decision-influencer — an owner, principal, partner, CEO, CTO, IT director, IT manager, service manager, or operations manager. A help desk technician, receptionist, or office administrator does not count, even if they agreed to the meeting.



Commission is paid on the meeting that actually happens. Reschedules do not affect the commission — if the meeting eventually takes place with a qualifying contact, it is paid. Appointments that are never held are not paid.



Conversion bonus:



If a prospect you booked signs a services agreement with T3 Tech Partners, you receive an additional $100 USD. The bonus is paid on signature, and it applies for 90 days from the date of your booked meeting, so you are still credited when a deal takes time to close.



What this adds up to:



At a normal pace of 15 to 20 held appointments per month, base plus appointment commission lands between $1,375 and $1,500. Two signed clients in a month brings that to roughly $1,600 to $1,700. There is no cap on the conversion bonus.



HOW TO APPLY — AUDIO SAMPLE REQUIRED



Applications without an audio sample will not be reviewed. This is the first thing we check.



Because this role is judged on how you sound on the phone, every applicant must submit a voice recording of 60 to 90 seconds. Record it yourself, in your own voice, in one take.



In your recording, please cover:



Your name and where you are based.

A brief summary of your outbound calling experience and the markets you have called into.

A live mock cold call opener: imagine you have just reached the owner of a US-based MSP who did not expect your call. Deliver your opening 20 to 30 seconds exactly as you would on a real dial.

How you would respond if that owner said, "We already have an internal engineer for that."



How to send it:



Record using any free app or tool you like, then paste the shareable link directly into the job post chat here on OnlineJobs.ph. Free options that work well:



Vocaroo (
) — record in your browser, no account needed, gives you an instant link.

Voice Spice (
) — browser-based recorder with a shareable link.

Clyp (
) — free hosting with a direct link.

Google Drive or Dropbox — record on your phone, upload, and share the link.



Make sure your link is set so that anyone with the link can listen. We cannot chase down permission requests, and locked links will be treated as no submission.



Along with your audio link, please include in the chat:



Your resume or a link to it.

The number of outbound dials you typically made per day in your last role.

Confirmation that you can work 10:00 AM–6:00 PM EST (11:00 PM–7:00 AM Manila time), and whether you have held a night shift role before.



We review every submission that includes an audio sample. Strong candidates will be invited to a short live phone screen — where, again, how you sound will matter most.

title: Video Editing Assistant (CapCut) – Instagram Reels Variations
description:
I am looking for a reliable video editing assistant to create variations of completed short-form videos for Instagram Trial Reels, and to edit simple talking videos with image overlays.



This is a part-time, straightforward, repeatable editing job — approximately 1–2 hours per day, 6 days a week. You will work inside a shared CapCut space and a shared Google Drive. Most videos are one minute long or shorter.



TASK 1: STORYTELLING VARIATIONS (6 PER DAY)



You'll create new variations of completed storytelling videos by swapping clips, using the swap clips provided. The number of swaps will vary depending on the video and will be specified in the guide or your daily instructions.



Depending on the video, you may also make small changes such as:

- Horizontally flipping sections of the video that do not contain text

- Slightly zooming in or changing the framing

- Adding a 0.1-second black screen at the beginning

- Changing the font or text style

- Making minor adjustments to saturation, exposure, brightness, or filters

- Slightly shifting the audio volume up or down



The goal of these edits is to make each variation look "fresh" to the algorithm.



TASK 2: "LET ME GUESS" VIDEOS (4–5 PER DAY)



You'll receive raw talking videos (usually around 1 minute or less) that all follow the same simple format. You'll cut out all dead space and pauses, then add the provided image overlays at the moment each point is said. Images will be numbered in order in Google Drive. The pacing and style are the same every time, so once you've done a few, these are quick.



For both tasks, you'll export each video, name it correctly, and upload it to the correct Google Drive folder.



This is not advanced video editing. You'll be swapping clips, making small adjustments, and doing simple cuts and overlays following a set format.



A full guide with exact instructions and examples will be provided. Attention to detail matters, so include the word "Trial" somewhere in the middle of your application when describing your editing experience.



REQUIREMENTS:

- Experience using CapCut (desktop preferred)

- Strong attention to detail

- Ability to follow instructions exactly

- Reliable communication

- Fast internet and the ability to upload video files

- Organized file management

- Consistent daily availability (about 1–2 hours/day, 6 days/week)



TO APPLY, PLEASE INCLUDE:

1. The editing software you use

2. Your daily availability

3. Your experience editing short-form videos

4. A link to previous editing work

5. Confirmation that you are comfortable with pay of $180 USD per month for this role (approx. 1–2 hours/day, 6 days a week), increasing to $220 USD per month after a successful first month



Selected applicants will be asked to complete a short paid test.

Responsible for architecting scalable, cloud-native, and real-time data ecosystems to support advanced analytics, AI/ML, and digital transformation initiatives. This role requires strong leadership, deep technical expertise, and experience across modern data architectures and platforms.



Design, develop and maintain data solutions for data generation, collection, and processing. Create data pipelines, ensure data quality, and implement ETL (extract, transform and load) processes to migrate and deploy data across systems.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:



• Lead end-to-end data architecture for large-scale modernization and digital transformation programs.

• Design and implement modern data platforms using cloud-native services (Azure, AWS, GCP) including lakehouses, streaming pipelines, and orchestration frameworks.

• Define and drive adoption of modern architecture patterns such as data mesh, data fabric, data virtualization, and knowledge graphs.

• Drive the adoption of modern data stacks: Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, Synapse, BigQuery, Kafka, dbt, Delta Lake, etc.

• Develop logical and physical data models to support structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data.

• Collaborate with data engineers, product owners, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable data solutions.

• Define and implement strategies for data governance, metadata management, master data management, data security, and access controls.

• Evaluate and recommend tools, platforms, and frameworks aligned with enterprise data strategy.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:



• 10+ years of experience in data architecture and engineering roles.

• Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, GCP) or emerging platforms like IOMETE.

• Expertise in modern data warehousing and lakehouse platforms: Snowflake, Databricks, Synapse, Redshift, BigQuery.

• Deep knowledge of data integration, ETL/ELT tools (e.g., dbt, Azure Data Factory, Glue, Airflow).

• Experience with streaming and real-time data platforms like Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming.

• Strong understanding of data modeling, data quality frameworks, and metadata management.

• Familiarity with data mesh, data fabric, and data product concepts.

• Experience with data cataloging and discovery tools: Collibra, Alation, Purview, etc.

• Knowledge of DevOps, DataOps, and CI/CD for data pipelines.

• Experience with AI/ML platform integration.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to engage with technical and business stakeholders effectively.

• Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required.
