title: Operations and Sales Director
description:
Full-Time | Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time



About the Role



We are looking for a highly motivated, organized, and experienced Director of Sales & Operations to join our team.



This is a hands-on, high-accountability position responsible for managing our seller and buyer leads from initial contact through the preparation of businesses for sale.



You will personally contact leads, book and conduct discovery calls, gather financial and business information, manage follow-up, coordinate documentation, and use our AI-powered systems to help prepare business valuations and Confidential Information Memorandums (CIMs).



This is NOT an entry-level position.



We are looking for someone who is confident speaking with business owners, understands sales, is relentless about follow-up, stays extremely organized, and can leverage technology and AI to move quickly and efficiently.



Schedule

Full-time

Monday–Friday

8:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time

Must be available and responsive during these hours

Core Responsibilities

Seller Lead Management



You will manage seller leads from their first inquiry through the initial stages of preparing their business for sale.



Responsibilities include:



Contact every new seller lead promptly.

Call, text, and follow up consistently until contact is made.

Schedule seller appointments.

Conduct initial discovery and qualification calls.

Ask detailed questions about the seller and their business.

Gather information regarding revenue, profit, expenses, employees, owner involvement, assets, leases, customers, growth opportunities, reason for selling, timeline, and other relevant information.

Request and collect financial statements and required documentation.

Keep sellers moving through the process.

Identify missing information and follow up until it is received.

Make sure no seller lead falls through the cracks.

Buyer Lead Management



You will also manage and qualify prospective buyers.



Responsibilities include:



Contact every buyer lead.

Schedule buyer appointments.

Conduct buyer qualification calls.

Evaluate buyer experience, financial ability, available cash, financing options, industry preferences, location preferences, acquisition criteria, and timeline.

Determine what type of business the buyer is looking to acquire.

Ensure NDAs and required documentation are completed before confidential information is released.

Match qualified buyers with appropriate listings.

Maintain consistent follow-up with active buyers.

Track buyers who may be a fit for future listings.

Maintain an organized database of qualified buyers and acquisition criteria.

Business Valuations



You will use our established systems and AI tools to assist in preparing business valuations.



Responsibilities include:



Review seller financial information.

Identify potential add-backs.

Calculate and review SDE and EBITDA when appropriate.

Research applicable industry multiples.

Use our AI systems to assist with valuation analysis.

Identify missing, inconsistent, or questionable financial information.

Prepare valuations for internal review.

Make sure the final valuation is logical, complete, accurate, and professional.



AI will do much of the heavy lifting, but you are responsible for the quality, accuracy, and completeness of the information being entered and reviewed.



CIM Preparation



You will use our AI systems to prepare Confidential Information Memorandums (CIMs) for businesses being marketed for sale.



This includes:



Gathering information from sellers.

Reviewing financial information.

Preparing company overviews.

Documenting products and services.

Identifying competitive advantages.

Outlining staffing and owner responsibilities.

Identifying growth opportunities.

Organizing financial information.

Reviewing AI-generated CIMs.

Correcting errors and missing information.

Improving the final document.

Following up with sellers when information is missing.



You are responsible for making sure every CIM is accurate, professional, complete, and ready to be presented to qualified buyers.



Sales & Operations



This position plays a critical role in managing the day-to-day operations surrounding our sales pipeline.



You will:



Maintain and update the CRM daily.

Track every buyer and seller lead.

Make sure every lead has a clear status and next action.

Track appointments and follow-ups.

Make sure required documents are collected.

Keep files and deal information organized.

Identify stalled leads and deals.

Coordinate with brokers, administrative staff, and management.

Make sure deadlines and next steps are completed.

Help improve systems, processes, and AI workflows.

Identify problems before they become bigger problems.

Keep management informed about pipeline activity and operational issues.

Take ownership of getting tasks completed without constant supervision.

Required Experience

This is NOT an entry-level position.



Applicants MUST have previous sales experience.



You should have experience with:



Calling and communicating with leads.

Qualifying prospects.

Booking appointments.

Conducting sales or discovery calls.

Following up with prospects.

Managing a sales pipeline.

Working inside a CRM or similar system.

Managing multiple prospects at different stages of a sales process.

Working toward measurable sales goals.



Experience in any of the following is a major plus:



Business brokerage

Real estate

B2B sales

Financial services

M&A

Business acquisitions

High-ticket sales

Consulting

Entrepreneurship



If you do not have previous sales experience, please do not apply.



Technology Requirements



You must be comfortable working in a technology-driven environment.



Required:



Must have an iPhone.

Must be comfortable calling and texting leads from an iPhone.

Must be comfortable using AI tools.

Must be comfortable working inside a CRM.

Must be able to learn new software and technology quickly.

Must be comfortable using multiple systems simultaneously.

Must be able to use technology to increase productivity and speed.

Who We're Looking For



The right person is:



Extremely organized

Confident and professional on the phone

Comfortable speaking with business owners

Persistent and consistent with follow-up

Motivated by results

Comfortable with sales

Detail-oriented

Comfortable working with numbers and financial information

Quick to learn new technology

Comfortable using AI

Able to manage multiple priorities

Independent and self-motivated

Solution-oriented

Accountable for results

Someone who takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do



You should be the type of person who sees a problem and thinks:



"How do I fix this?"



—not—



"Someone should tell me what to do."



How Success Will Be Measured



Your performance will be measured using clear activity and performance metrics, including:



Speed to lead

Percentage of leads contacted

Seller appointments booked

Buyer appointments booked

Appointment show rate

Seller conversion rate

Buyer qualification rate

Follow-up completion

Valuations completed

CIMs completed

Turnaround time

CRM accuracy

Qualified opportunities moved forward

Overall organization of the buyer and seller pipeline

The Bottom Line



Your job is to make sure nothing falls through the cracks.



Every seller lead gets contacted.



Every buyer lead gets contacted.



Every qualified prospect gets an appointment.



Every appointment gets followed up with.



Every qualified seller gets moved toward a valuation and CIM.



Every qualified buyer gets matched with the right opportunities.



You will use AI, automation, and technology to work faster, but you are ultimately responsible for making sure the work gets done correctly, completely, and on time.



If you are a strong salesperson who is highly organized, loves follow-up, is comfortable with technology and AI, and knows how to take ownership of a sales and operations pipeline, we want to hear from you.



To Apply



Please submit your resume and include a brief explanation of:



Your previous sales experience

Why you believe you are qualified for this position

Your experience using CRMs and technology

Your experience using AI tools

Your availability to work Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time

About the Role



Shah Equity is hiring Inside Sales Representatives to conduct scheduled interviews with individuals who have already expressed interest in our Nominee Director and/or AI Innovation Fellowship programs.



This is not a cold-calling or lead-generation position. All interviews are with interested candidates. Your role is to explain the program, answer questions, determine whether the candidate wants to proceed, and guide them through the onboarding and contract-signing process.



What You'll Do

Explain the Nominee Director and/or AI Innovation Fellowship programs.

Answer candidate questions using approved company information.

Explain responsibilities and requirements.

Confirm the candidate understands the opportunity.

Guide candidates through the onboarding and contract process.

Update candidate status after each interview.

Preferred hours

Up to 250 successful onboardings

Paid weekly

Commission-based; no salary or hourly base pay

Interview Volume

Schedule



Flexible full-time or part-time schedule.



Candidates should provide their preferred working days and hours in Central Time (CST/CDT).



Requirements

Excellent spoken and written English required

Sales or interviewing experience required

Strong communication and presentation skills

Professional and confident presence

Ability to explain information clearly

Ability to follow company materials and onboarding procedures

Sales, recruiting, admissions, customer service, or candidate onboarding experience preferred

Applicants must submit a short recording introducing themselves and explaining their relevant experience.

title: Creative Brand & Social Media Assistant
description:
Pay: $2.50 USD/hour

Hours: 30 hours per week

Schedule: Remote and flexible, but Pacific Time availability is required

Communication: WhatsApp

Position: Long-term



About the Position



I am looking for a creative, reliable, and independent Brand & Social Media Assistant to join my small ecommerce business long term.



This role combines graphic design, social media content creation, and brand development. I already have an established brand identity, professional brand guidelines, logos, colors, fonts, and visual direction in place.



I am not looking for someone to completely rebrand the business. Instead, I need someone who can understand the existing brand and help expand it into a stronger, more polished, and recognizable identity across social media, packaging, marketing materials, events, and other customer touchpoints.



I am especially interested in someone who can bring fresh ideas and creative suggestions rather than simply waiting for detailed instructions for every project.



Pay & Schedule



The position pays $2.50 USD per hour for approximately 30 hours per week.



The schedule can be somewhat flexible, but you must have consistent availability during Pacific Time (PST/PDT).



You do not necessarily need to work all of your hours in one continuous block. However, your schedule should overlap enough with Pacific Time that we can communicate efficiently, review work, make revisions, and handle time sensitive requests when needed.



There may occasionally be product launches, announcements, events, or other projects that require quicker communication and turnaround.



Communication



WhatsApp is required for this position.



WhatsApp will be used for daily communication, assignments, feedback, questions, revisions, and updates.



I am looking for someone who:



• Checks messages regularly during working hours

• Responds within a reasonable amount of time

• Communicates clearly when something is unclear

• Lets me know if there will be a delay

• Provides progress updates without requiring constant follow up

• Is reliable and easy to communicate with



Strong communication is extremely important for this role.



Required Design Skills



Canva



Strong Canva experience is required.



Canva is a major part of my workflow because many recurring designs need to remain editable by myself and other members of the team.



You should be comfortable:



• Designing professionally from scratch in Canva

• Editing existing Canva files

• Creating reusable templates

• Following an established brand guide

• Organizing Canva projects and files

• Working with product photography

• Creating social media layouts

• Resizing and adapting designs

• Creating designs that can easily be updated later



I am specifically looking for someone who genuinely knows how to design within Canva rather than someone who only uses it occasionally.



Adobe Illustrator



Experience with Adobe Illustrator is also important.



You should be comfortable using Illustrator for:



• Vector artwork

• Packaging layouts

• Print materials

• Brand assets

• Product collateral

• Professional print files

• Editing and preparing existing design assets



Adobe Express



Experience with Adobe Express is also preferred for social media content, quick edits, resizing, and digital marketing materials.



Social Media Responsibilities



A major part of this position will involve helping improve and maintain the business's social media presence.



You may be responsible for creating:



• Instagram feed posts

• Instagram Stories

• Reel covers

• Product launch graphics

• New release announcements

• Presale posts

• Restock announcements

• Coming soon posts

• Giveaway graphics

• Event announcements

• Informational graphics

• Product spotlights

• Collection features

• Promotional content



I am looking for someone who understands how individual posts contribute to an overall feed.



The goal is to create social media that feels consistent and recognizable without making every post look identical.



You should also be comfortable suggesting:



• New content ideas

• Recurring content series

• Ways to improve engagement

• Creative launch concepts

• Different post formats

• Ways to strengthen brand recognition



Brand Development



I want someone who can help continue expanding an already established brand.



This may include creating or improving:



• Social media templates

• Packaging

• Business cards

• Thank you cards

• Product backing cards

• Order inserts

• Website graphics

•
 graphics

• Event signage

• Vendor materials

• Promotional cards

• Customer experience materials

• Marketing campaigns

• Other branded materials



You should understand how to take an existing brand guide and creatively apply it to new situations.



The goal is for everything a customer sees to feel connected to the same business.



Creative Independence



I am looking for someone who can work independently and does not require constant micromanagement.



I will provide direction, product information, brand guidelines, examples, and feedback.



However, I do not want to have to explain every small design decision.



If I provide a product image and tell you that I need a launch graphic, I want you to be able to review the branding, understand the information that needs to be communicated, and create a strong concept.



As you work with me longer, I expect you to learn:



• The types of designs I prefer

• What I like and dislike visually

• How I prefer information presented

• What fits the brand

• What does not fit the brand

• How different types of launches are normally handled



I want someone who becomes easier to work with over time because they understand the brand and remember previous feedback.



AI Usage



I am not looking for someone who relies heavily on AI to complete their creative work.



AI may be used occasionally as a supporting tool when appropriate, but it should not replace your own design ability, creativity, judgment, or original thinking.



I want to see your actual design skills.



The majority of your layouts, concepts, branding decisions, and creative direction should come from you.



If your normal workflow depends heavily on AI generated designs or content, this position will likely not be the right fit.



Ideal Candidate



You may be a great fit if you are:



• Experienced with Canva

• Experienced with Adobe Illustrator

• Familiar with Adobe Express

• Strong in graphic design

• Comfortable with Instagram and social media

• Familiar with branding and visual identity

• Creative and able to generate your own ideas

• Detail oriented

• Organized

• Responsive

• Reliable

• Able to manage multiple assignments

• Comfortable receiving feedback

• Able to work without constant supervision

• Available during Pacific Time

• Interested in a long term role



Experience working with ecommerce brands, collectibles, product based businesses, packaging, stationery, fandom products, or boutique brands is a plus.



What I Will Provide



You will receive access to existing materials such as:



• Brand guidelines

• Logos

• Brand colors

• Brand fonts

• Graphic elements and patterns

• Existing Canva files

• Previous social media posts

• Product photography

• Packaging examples

• Marketing materials

• Examples of designs I like and dislike



You will have an established creative foundation to work from.



How to Apply



You must submit a portfolio to be considered.



Please include:



• A link to your design portfolio

• Examples of social media graphics

• Canva work, if available

• Branding or brand development examples

• Your experience with Adobe Illustrator

• Your experience with Adobe Express

• Your availability during Pacific Time



Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.



Please submit work that represents your actual design ability and creative style.



I am looking for someone who wants to become a reliable creative part of the business, learn the brand over time, contribute ideas, and help take the overall branding and social media presence to the next level.

title: Content Creator & Social Media Specialist

Applicants must include a portfolio or links to previous work. We are especially interested in seeing examples of Reels, TikToks, UGC-style videos, short-form video editing, and social media content you have personally created.

description:
Who We Are & What We Do**

Our US-based enterprise spans several distinct and rapidly growing industries, including B2B SaaS (Software as a Service), Luxury Weddings & Event Venues, Alternative Wellness & Hypnosis Retreats, Real Estate Acquisitions, Property Management, and Roofing/Construction. Because we are visionary founders who move at a rapid pace, we require a highly capable "Right-Hand" Executive Assistant to seamlessly connect and manage the operational moving parts across all of our brands.



 The Role

This is not a passive, data-entry position where you wait for step-by-step guidance. You will act as a true Integrator, working directly alongside ownership. Expect rapid-fire communication: you will frequently receive audio notes or short text directives from us on the fly (e.g., "Confirm the schedule with this roofing client," "Onboard this new SaaS client into their CRM package," or "Update the contract for our September wedding couple"). Your job is to take those raw instructions, pick up the phone, and execute them perfectly across whichever business requires your attention that day.



 Core Duties & Daily Execution**



 Portfolio-Wide Operational Support:** Serve as the central hub across all our entities. You must be highly adaptable, shifting effortlessly from coordinating a creative wellness retreat, to managing structured roofing logistics, to tracking high-volume B2B SaaS sales pipelines.

* **Rapid Execution & Outbound Calling:** Transform our voice memos and texts into immediate action. You must possess the confidence to call American business owners, homeowners, vendors, corporate clients, and brides to secure confirmations, provide updates, and follow through on agreements.

* **SaaS & GHL Sub-Account Coordination:** Partner closely with our dedicated GoHighLevel Specialist. Because we sell software automation packages, you will submit requests for new workflows, communicate system updates, and assist in configuring new GHL sub-accounts as our software client base scales.

* **Active Pipeline Management:** Live inside GoHighLevel daily to update sales opportunities, manage client profiles, tag correctly, monitor calendar bookings, and ensure every lead across our diverse portfolio is progressing through the right communication sequence.

* **Property Management (Hospitable):** Oversee our short-term rental platforms by managing guest communications, adjusting bookings, and maintaining automated rules within Hospitable.

* **Inbox & Task Triage:** Filter incoming communications, route critical information to the proper profiles, and ensure zero tasks slip through the cracks.



 Availability & Time Commitments**



 Hours:** 30 to 35 hours per week.

 Mandatory Weekend Availability:** Our event venues, corporate rentals, and retreats operate heavily over the weekend. Saturday and Sunday availability is an absolute requirement to address urgent guest and client matters.

* **Daily Video Scrums:** You must attend a mandatory 1 to 2-hour daily alignment meeting via video (typically scheduled between 10:00 AM and 12:00 PM US Central Time).



**Pay Structure & Performance Incentives**

We reward total reliability, extreme adaptability, and proactive communication. Your hourly rate is strictly tied to the schedule below; the base pay comprehensively covers all ad-hoc tasks across the entire business portfolio and is non-negotiable.



 Guaranteed Escalating Base:**

* Month 1 (Trial/Onboarding): $4.00 / Hour

* Month 2: $5.00 / Hour

* After 90 Days: $7.00 / Hour





Monthly KPI Bonuses (Earn up to $75 extra per month):

Speed to Lead ($25/mo):* Consistently responding to all messages and calls within 15 minutes.Zero unexcused absences and perfect punctuality for all weekend shifts and daily video meetings.

* *Flawless Implementation ($25/mo):* Taking precise meeting notes and executing those action items accurately in our systems.

* *Zero-Leakage Pipeline ($25/mo):* Maintaining impeccable pipelines with no unresolved tasks, untagged
s, or lingering issues at the end of your shift.

s.





Long-Term Loyalty Benefits:**

Health Stipend:* After 6 months, you receive a $30/month stipend dedicated to your local HMO costs.

13th-Month Pay:* A full month of extra baseline salary paid every December to reward your long-term commitment.







Ideal Candidate Profile**



Exceptional English:** You possess a flawless, neutral spoken English accent and are completely confident handling outbound phone calls to US-based clients and contractors.

* **Context-Switching Master:** You excel in dynamic environments and are entirely unphased by jumping from B2B software sales support to hospitality management in the same hour.

* **Tech Proficiency:** You have hands-on, user-level experience with GoHighLevel pipelines/tagging and can collaborate with developers. Familiarity with Hospitable (or similar property management software) is a major advantage.

* **Background:** Proven prior experience as an Operations Assistant, Executive VA, or Project Manager.



**Application Instructions**

If you have the speed, skills, and confidence to be our Integrator, apply by submitting:



1. A short summary detailing your experience with multi-industry support, outbound phone handling, and administrative operations.

2. A link to a 1-minute voice/video recording (via Loom or Vocaroo) introducing yourself, specifically so we can evaluate your spoken English.

3. Include the exact phrase **"Team Operations Integrator"** in your subject line so we know you possess the attention to detail required for this role.

title: Research Assistant – U.S. Public Records Requests (Bodycam Footage for YouTube)
description:

I run a YouTube channel focused on bodycam footage and need help sourcing it via U.S. public records requests (FOIA / state equivalents). No prior FOIA experience needed — I'll provide a template and process guide once you're past the initial screen. I need someone organized, research-savvy, and honest about realistic timelines.



What You'll Do



Find suitable i

File public records requests (template provided)

Track deadlines and follow up with agencies

Deliver footage along with case details (agency name, case number, dates, confirmation number)



Original Footage Only

Footage must come directly from the agency's official release process — not re-uploads from YouTube,
, news sites, etc. Each delivery must include the agency name, case/i
 number, filing date, release date, and any confirmation or reference number provided by the agency.



Requirements



Strong written English and attention to detail

Comfortable with independent online research

Highly organized, able to track multiple open requests at once

Honest communicator — realistic timelines, not what sounds good



Nice to Have (not required)



Prior experience with FOIA or public records requests

Pay:

How to Apply

Your availability (hours per week)

title: Amazon  / E-com Sourcing Specialist
description:
We’re looking for an experienced Amazon Product Sourcing Specialist to help our growing e-commerce business find profitable products for the US Amazon marketplace.



You should be confident researching products, analyzing Keepa charts, and identifying buying opportunities backed by accurate data.



In this role, you will:



Find profitable products through online arbitrage, brand research, and wholesale sourcing.



Use manual sourcing, reverse sourcing, and storefront research to discover opportunities.



Analyze price history, sales trends, competition, Amazon’s presence, and potential profitability.



Verify exact product matches, including model numbers, sizes, colors, and pack quantities.



Calculate purchase costs accurately, including discounts, shipping, and applicable taxes.



Research supplier reliability and flag potential sourcing risks.



Submit organized leads with purchase links, ASINs, costs, estimated profit, ROI, and supporting notes.



Meet daily and weekly sourcing goals and use feedback to improve lead quality.



You should have:



1–2 years of hands-on Amazon product sourcing experience, preferably in the US marketplace.



Strong working knowledge of Keepa and SellerAmp.



Experience using Google Sheets or similar tools to track leads.



A clear understanding of Amazon fees, ROI, profit margins, sales estimates, and listing variations.



Strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently.



Reliable internet access, your own computer, and clear written English.



Experience sourcing tools, hardware, home improvement products, or wholesale catalogs is a plus.



We value accurate, actionable leads and consistent communication. We’re looking for someone who can explain why a product is a good buying opportunity and identify the risks.



To apply, send:



Your resume and a brief summary of your Amazon sourcing experience.



The sourcing tools and methods you use.



Two sample product leads with a short explanation of your analysis.



Your availability, time zone, and expected hourly rate.



Please use “Amazon Sourcing Specialist” as your application subject line.

title: OA sourcing Agent
description:

You will NOT have access to our Amazon Seller Central account and you will NOT be responsible for purchasing inventory.



Responsibilities

Find potential profitable products from approved online retailers

Match retailer products to the exact Amazon ASIN

Verify product size, quantity, variation, packaging, and UPC/model information

Analyze Keepa price, Buy Box, sales-rank, and seller-count history

Research competition and seller activity

Calculate estimated profit and ROI

Check for potential restrictions, IP concerns, expiration issues, bundles, and other sourcing risks

Record complete product information in our sourcing spreadsheet

Clearly explain anything unusual or requiring further review

Avoid submitting duplicate or incomplete leads

Has experience with Keepa

Understands ROI, profit margins, sales rank, Buy Box, and seller count

You will not:

Contact Amazon on our behalf

Change account settings

Submit complete leads

Have you worked with a Keepa-based sourcing system before?

provide 2 examples of a product you sourced successfully, including the ASIN, source, cost, Amazon price, estimated profit, and ROI.

title: Senior Direct-Response Copywriter (Email, SMS & High-Ticket Funnels)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



Launch OS helps high-ticket businesses turn attention into qualified sales conversations. We are looking for a senior copywriter who can make the reader feel understood, communicate a believable transformation, build trust, and move them toward the right next step.



You will own
, SMS, webinar, VSL, and funnel copy for 6-8 clients at a time. Each client has a different audience, offer, and voice. Your writing should sound specific, natural, and credible while serving a clear conversion objective.



PAY & SCHEDULE



• Pay: $2,000-$3,000 USD/month, based on demonstrated skills and experience.



• Engagement: Remote contractor, based in the Philippines; 40 working hours/week.



• Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. Mountain Standard Time (MST, UTC-7), including a one-hour unpaid break each day.



• Time zone: Fixed MST year-round. In the Philippines, this is 11:00 p.m.-8:00 a.m. the following day.



WHAT YOU WILL WRITE



•
: Client newsletters, promotional campaigns, welcome and new-subscriber sequences, lead magnet follow-up, and nurture sequences.



• Booking and pre-call nurture: Application-started, qualified-but-not-booked, booked-call, reminder, and no-show follow-up copy that addresses hesitation and helps qualified leads take the next step.



• SMS: Short, conversational messages that invite replies, support bookings, and improve follow-through across call funnels, webinars, and challenges.



• Webinar and challenge campaigns: Registration pages, invitations, reminders, replay
s, follow-up, and genuine deadline-driven sales messaging.



• Funnel and landing-page copy: Complete pages for VSL, book-a-call, webinar, lead magnet, squeeze, challenge, sales letter, and high-ticket ascension funnels.



• VSL scripts: Clear, persuasive scripts that connect the audience's problem, desired outcome, offer, proof, objections, and next step.



FULL-PAGE COPY IS A CORE RESPONSIBILITY



We have established funnel templates. The developer may build a page using placeholders or an initial AI draft. You own the final copy and should be comfortable rewriting it completely when needed.



• Nail the cold-traffic hero: Make it immediately clear who the offer is for, what meaningful outcome it helps them achieve, why it is credible, and what to do next.



• Write the entire page: Headlines, subheads, body copy, benefits, proof, objections, FAQs, calls to action, form instructions, and confirmation messaging.



• Match the message across the traffic source, page,
s, SMS, and sales conversation.



• Review your copy in the actual page layout. Check mobile readability, awkward line breaks, button copy, and consistency before handoff.



HOW YOU APPROACH THE WORK



• Research before writing. Use client materials, customer language, interviews, reviews, sales-call insights, and available performance data to understand the audience and offer.



• Maintain a voice guide for each client: their tone, customer language, offers, proof, objections, and messaging boundaries.



• Connect transformation and nurture with sales. Help readers see a credible before-and-after, address uncertainty, build belief, and understand the next step.



• Use real proof and accurate offer details. Verify claims, testimonials, dates, links, pricing, and deadlines; flag missing evidence instead of inventing it.



• Give the developer clear copy, sequence order, audience conditions, and timing intent. Coordinate loading and in-platform copy revisions; the developer owns the technical automation.



• Maintain campaign calendars and priorities across 6-8 clients. Flag capacity conflicts early and deliver complete, self-edited work on time.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



• Proven direct-response and conversion copywriting experience for high-ticket offers, supported by complete landing pages and multi-message sequences you personally wrote.



• Strong understanding of transformational copy, nurture, and sales psychology: customer awareness, motivation, objections, proof, positioning, and calls to action.



• Ability to write both a strong cold-traffic hero and the full page beneath it. You can explain the purpose of each section and how it supports the conversion goal.



• Demonstrated
 and SMS experience. You understand the different formats and can write concise, natural messages without making every interaction feel like a sales pitch.



• Excellent written English and the ability to capture several distinct client voices. Your copy is clear, human, specific, and free of generic filler or inflated promises.



• Strong self-editing and quality control. You catch weak logic, repetition, unclear claims, factual errors, and mismatched calls to action before review.



• Proactive communication, reliable deadline management, and the ability to explain your decisions and act on feedback.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



• Agency or multi-client experience with high-ticket coaches, consultants, or service businesses.



• CRO and copy testing across landing pages,
 sequences, webinar campaigns, and sales-call funnels.



• Familiarity with GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and
 platforms for reviewing copy in context. ManyChat conversation writing is also valuable.



HOW WE MEASURE STRONG WORK



• Each client sounds like themselves, and the copy reflects their audience and offer.



• Pages and sequences arrive complete, accurate, and ready for final review; revision needs decrease as you learn each client.



• Campaigns ship on schedule, with clear communication and no avoidable copy bottlenecks.



• You use clicks, replies, opt-ins, qualified bookings, show rates, and downstream sales feedback to recommend focused tests and improve the message.



AI & ORIGINAL THINKING



AI can support research, ideation, and editing. You remain accountable for the strategy, accuracy, voice, originality, and finished copy.



You must understand the audience and offer yourself, develop your own ideas, explain your writing choices, and write or revise effectively without depending on AI to supply the thinking. An AI-generated first draft is an input for you to evaluate and improve.



HOW TO APPLY



1. Share one complete landing page and one
 or nurture sequence you personally wrote. Explain the audience, objective, and your exact contribution. Use samples you have permission to share or redact confidential details.



2. Explain one major copy decision in those samples and share performance results where available, with context about your contribution.



3. Describe how you would keep the voices, priorities, and deadlines of 6-8 clients organized.



4. Tell us how you use AI in your process and how you check the final work.



5. Include your availability and expected monthly USD compensation.

title: Senior WordPress Developer — Website Rebuild, Mobile UX and Technical SEO
description:
We’re looking for an experienced, hands-on WordPress developer who can take ownership of improving our website: 
.



Our current website needs substantial work. It has unfinished templates, mobile usability problems, broken links and calls to action, slow pages, inconsistent SEO settings, and unresolved issues from a previous Shopify website.



We have a detailed audit. We need someone who can assess what should be repaired or rebuilt, recommend a practical approach, and implement it.



What you’ll do



Assess the current WordPress setup and recommend a repair or rebuild plan.



Create a clean, consistent, mobile-first website that clearly explains our software.



Fix navigation, page layouts, placeholders, broken links and demo/contact paths.



Build product and audience pages using content and product information we provide.



Improve page speed and basic accessibility.



Correct page titles, descriptions, structured data, sitemaps, redirects and other technical SEO issues.



Help resolve old Shopify URLs and search results through proper migration cleanup and Google Search Console.



Set up or repair GA4/GTM tracking and verify that forms and bookings work.



Use staging, backups and testing, and document your work so the site remains maintainable.



We will pause the chatbot while the website is being improved. Chatbot redevelopment is outside this initial project.



What we’re looking for



Strong hands-on WordPress development experience.



Good HTML, CSS, JavaScript and PHP skills.



Experience building responsive websites that work well on phones.



Ability to troubleshoot beyond the page-builder interface.



Practical technical SEO and website migration experience.



Experience improving speed using PageSpeed Insights or Lighthouse.



Working knowledge of Google Search Console, GA4 and Google Tag Manager.



Clear written English, dependable communication and the ability to work independently.



Willingness to explain your recommendations in straightforward business terms.



Our current setup includes Elementor, Avada/Fusion, WooCommerce, Rank Math, Contact Form 7, Calendly and a custom plugin. You do not need experience with every tool, but please tell us which you know well.



Experience with B2B software websites or Shopify-to-WordPress migrations is a plus.



How we’ll work



You’ll work directly with a small-business owner. We will provide product knowledge, content approval and access needed for the agreed work.



We’ll begin with a small paid engagement to assess the site and confirm the approach. We’ll then agree on deliverables, milestones, hours and timeline before committing to the larger project.



Please tell us your realistic weekly availability. We expect one short weekly call at a mutually convenient time with a US Pacific time contact, plus brief written updates. Daily overnight availability is not required.



Successful completion may lead to ongoing website maintenance work.



This role does not include paid advertising, backlink campaigns, extensive original copywriting or development of our core software product.



How to apply



Please use this application subject:



iPersonalyze WordPress Developer — [Your Name]



Include:



Two relevant website examples, with a short explanation of what you personally built or fixed.



One specific technical problem you solved involving mobile usability, speed, SEO, redirects or tracking. This can be from the same examples.



Your experience with our current WordPress tools, including any gaps.



Your expected hourly rate and currency, weekly availability and earliest start date.



A few sentences explaining how you would approach your first week.



Please keep your response concise. No free audit or lengthy proposal is required.



We’ll invite a small shortlist to a 30-minute conversation, followed by a small paid trial with the strongest candidate.



We value clear communication, practical judgment and work that is tested and finished.

title: amazon/online arbitrage sourcing
description:
EXPERIENCE REQUIRED.



Do NOT apply if you have never sourced profitable products for Amazon FBA before. I am specifically looking for someone who already understands Amazon product sourcing and can work independently.



You should already know how to analyze Amazon listings, research suppliers, verify websites, check sellers and competition, calculate profit, and determine whether a product is actually worth purchasing.



YOUR MAIN JOB



You must provide 5 VALID ASINs per day.



That equals 25 valid ASINs per week.



Finding 5 random products does NOT count. Products must meet ALL of my requirements and pass my review.



If some of your daily ASINs are rejected, you have until the end of the week/payday to replace them and reach the required 25 valid ASINs.



25 approved ASINs per week is the minimum requirement — not just 25 submissions.



BONUSES 💰



I reward VAs who consistently provide good leads and help me grow the business.



You can earn additional bonuses for:



Consistently finding valid ASINs: If your leads regularly pass my review and meet all requirements, you can receive performance bonuses.



More than 25 approved ASINs: If you finish your required 25 valid ASINs early and continue finding additional approved products, you can receive a bonus for exceeding your weekly target.



Finding profitable Amazon seller storefronts: If you discover a strong Online Arbitrage seller storefront that I can use for further product research, submit the storefront to me. If I review it and approve it as a good sourcing opportunity, you can receive a bonus.



High-quality sourcing: VAs who consistently find products that I actually purchase and successfully sell will have opportunities for additional bonuses and higher pay over time.



Quality still matters. Adding random ASINs just to go above 25 will NOT earn a bonus. Extra ASINs must meet the same requirements as your normal submissions and pass my review.



PRODUCT REQUIREMENTS



Every product you submit must:



Be a brand I am already approved/ungated to sell



Make at least $2 profit per unit



Have at least 50 estimated sales per month



NOT be a generic brand



Have realistic competition where I can actually get sales



Have enough room for me to enter the listing without immediately destroying the price



Come from a REAL, TRUSTWORTHY SOURCE



Be in stock and actually available to purchase



Match the EXACT Amazon product/variation



Include the correct source link



Include the correct Amazon ASIN/listing



Not already have been submitted by another VA on my team



ROI is NOT my main requirement. I care more about actual dollar profit, sales volume, competition, and whether I can realistically sell the inventory.



QUANTITY MATTERS



Do NOT submit deals that only become profitable when purchasing an unrealistic quantity.



Example:



If a product only meets my requirements when buying 25 units, but the Amazon listing only sells around 50 units per month and has 20 competing sellers, I am obviously not going to purchase 25 units.



Use common sense.



Look at:



Monthly sales + number of sellers + competition + minimum purchase quantity.



The deal needs to make sense for MY business, not just look profitable on a spreadsheet.



SOURCE VERIFICATION IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



You MUST verify every website before submitting it.



I recently had a VA provide a fake website that looked like a major retailer. A purchase was made from the website and the card information was compromised.



That cannot happen again.



Before submitting ANY unfamiliar website, verify that it is legitimate.



Do NOT submit:



Fake retailer websites



Scam websitesCopycat websites



Suspicious Shopify stores



Random websites with no established reputation



Sources you have not properly researched



A retailer/distributor different from the one you put in the spreadsheet



If you are unsure whether a source is legitimate, DO NOT SUBMIT IT. Ask me first.



QUALITY > RANDOM LEADS



I would rather receive 5 strong ASINs than 20 bad ones.



Do not fill the spreadsheet just to hit your number.



Repeatedly submitting products that clearly violate the requirements will result in termination.



YOU SHOULD ALREADY KNOW



You should have previous experience with:



Amazon Seller Central



Amazon FBA



Online Arbitrage



Product sourcing



Keepa



SellerAmp SAS or similar tools



Buy Box analysis



Sales rank / estimated monthly sales



Amazon fees



Profit calculations



Seller/competition analysis



Variation matching



Source verification



Checking whether Amazon is on the listing



Identifying dangerous price drops or listings with too much competition



Amazon seller storefront sourcing / storefront stalking



You should NOT need me to teach you the basics of Amazon sourcing.



HOURS



Monday–Friday

8 hours per day

40 hours per week



This is a long-term position for the right person.



Starting pay is $2/hour, but strong performance can earn you bonuses and opportunities for increased pay.



The better the products you find and the more value you bring to the business, the more opportunity you have to earn.



HOW TO APPLY



Do NOT send me a generic copy-and-paste application.



Start your application with:



“I HAVE AMAZON SOURCING EXPERIENCE”



Then answer these questions:



How long have you been sourcing products for Amazon?



Have you done Online Arbitrage before?



What sourcing tools have you used?



Do you know how to use Keepa? Explain what you normally check on a Keepa chart.



Do you know how to use SellerAmp SAS?



How do you determine whether there are too many sellers on a listing?



How do you verify that a sourcing website is legitimate?



How do you determine how many units of a product you would recommend buying?



What is the difference between profit and ROI?



Have you used Amazon seller storefronts to find additional profitable products? Explain your process.



Send an example of an Amazon sourcing spreadsheet you have worked with before, with any confidential client information removed.



FINAL TEST: Include one example ASIN + source link that you believe would be worth researching for Online Arbitrage. Briefly explain why you chose it.



If you cannot answer these questions, please do not apply.



I am looking for someone who already knows what they are doing, pays attention to details, follows instructions, verifies their sources, and can consistently find products that I can actually buy and sell.

title: SEO Manager & Content Creator
description:
SEO Manager & Content Creator

Working Hours: Australian Business Hours (Starting at 7:00 AM PHT)



Commitment: 30 to 35 hours per week



Job Type: Substantial Part-Time / Flexible Full-Time



We are looking for a forward-thinking SEO Manager & Content Creator who understands that the search landscape has evolved. If you know how to balance the art of high-quality human writing with the efficiency of AI-assisted workflows—and you're ready for the era of AI search—we want you on our team.



At our core, we deeply value loyalty and efficient work. We don't believe in clock-watching or stretching out tasks just to look busy; we reward smart, impactful execution, accountability, and long-term commitment. Working remotely from the Philippines during Australian business hours, you will collaborate closely with our graphic designers to create, optimize, and maintain websites that don’t just look good, but actively convert traffic into sales.



What You’ll Be Doing

Create & Optimize Content: Craft high-converting, deeply engaging content. Using AI for brainstorms and initial ideas is perfectly fine, provided articles are human-edited, refined, and expanded far beyond basic AI outputs. Every article must pass AI content detectors.



Drive Accountability & Growth: Take full responsibility for performance. Your efforts need to directly result in measurable increases in both organic traffic and conversions.



Build Websites That Sell: Partner with our graphic design team to co-create high-performing web pages. You bring the SEO blueprints and data; they bring the visuals.



Manage the Google Ecosystem: Take full ownership of our Google stack (GTM, GA4, GSC, Google Ads, PageSpeed Insights) to track user journeys, monitor site health, and run targeted visibility campaigns.



Audit & Revamp: Use advanced crawling and keyword tools (Search Atlas, Ubersuggest, or equivalent) to audit existing pages and product listings, fixing technical bottlenecks and breathing new life into older content.



Future-Proof Search Presence: Optimize our digital footprint for modern search algorithms as well as GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and AIO (AI Optimization).



Essential Skills & Qualifications

Core Experience & Proven Track Record (Mandatory)



3+ Years in the Trenches: Minimum of 3 years of dedicated experience successfully managing both SEO strategy and content creation.



Proven Results: You must be able to clearly demonstrate a history of significantly increasing website traffic and conversions. Data-backed proof of your abilities is mandatory to be shortlisted. We are after an established professional—if you are just beginning your SEO journey, you will not have the required experience for this role.



Content & Strategy



Authentic Content Creation: Exceptional copywriting skills focused on human-first content that builds trust and drives action.



AI Balance & Strict Quality Control: Smart use of AI frameworks for research and ideas, paired with the human polish required to add depth, originality, and ensure 100% pass rates on AI checkers.



Next-Gen SEO: A solid working understanding of GEO and AIO to ensure our brand shows up in AI overviews and LLM responses.



Technical & Analytics Stack



Mastery of Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics (GA4), Google Search Console (GSC), Google Ads, and PageSpeed Insights.



Daily hands-on experience with Search Atlas and Ubersuggest (or equivalent keyword tools).



Logistics & Work Ethic



A reliable, long-term team player who works efficiently, respects deadlines, and takes accountability for metrics.



Ability to commit to 30 to 35 hours per week, working reliably during Australian business hours with a sharp 7:00 AM PHT start.



What’s in It for You?

Generous Performance Bonuses: We heavily reward impact. Successful execution of SEO strategies and high-performing campaigns tie directly into a generous bonus scheme.



100% Remote Flexibility: Work entirely from home while collaborating with an international, fast-moving team.



Cutting-Edge Environment: Work with a team that embraces modern tech, AI tools, and forward-looking SEO strategies rather than outdated, rigid playbooks.



How to Apply (Please Read Carefully)

Please do not reply with an AI-generated answer. Keep your response brief, personalized, and to the point.



To be considered for the shortlist, your application must include:



Resume & Portfolio: Links to your written content or ranked websites.



The Proof: A snapshot, case study, or clear data demonstrating how your efforts previously resulted in direct increases to website traffic and conversions.



AI Framework: A brief, personalized explanation of how you use AI for ideas while ensuring content is deeply edited, expanded, and compliant with AI detectors.



Note: Apologies in advance if we don't reply to your application. It isn't that we don't value your time—we simply don't have the resources to reply to every applicant.

title: AI-Assisted Full-Stack Builder – German Voice Agents, Mobile Apps & Client Websites
description:
nüll is a German digital agency building websites, applications, and AI-powered customer-acquisition systems for tradespeople, consultants, law firms, and local businesses across Germany.



We are looking for a resourceful AI-assisted full-stack builder who can figure things out, learn unfamiliar tools quickly, debug problems, and ship complete working products. We actively use Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, ChatGPT, and other AI development tools. You do not need to know every platform before starting, but you must understand code well enough to review, test, secure, and improve AI-generated work.



This is not a role for someone who waits for detailed step-by-step instructions. You should be comfortable reading documentation, testing APIs, solving blockers independently, and taking a project from idea to production.



THE THREE TYPES OF WORK



1. German AI Call Agents

You will build German-speaking AI telephone agents for tradespeople and local-business owners. Use cases may include inbound call answering, lead qualification, appointment booking, missed-call recovery, FAQs, follow-up, call transfers, and CRM updates.



You should be able to research and work with platforms such as Vapi, Retell AI, Twilio, ElevenLabs, OpenAI Realtime, or comparable tools. You must be able to connect telephony, speech recognition, German text-to-speech, webhooks, calendars, CRMs, databases, and analytics.



The call experience must work naturally in German. You should be able to test pronunciation, latency, interruptions, silence, dates, phone numbers, names, addresses, appointment flows, transfers, and failure handling. Perfect German fluency is helpful but not mandatory if you can work accurately with supplied German scripts and our German-speaking reviewer. GDPR-aware implementation and safe handling of recordings, transcripts, and customer data are required.



2. Real Mobile Applications

You must have contributed to at least one real mobile application currently available on the Apple App Store. Live App Store links are mandatory.



We need proof of what you personally built. For every app you submit, explain your exact role, technologies used, features implemented, and whether you handled TestFlight, App Store Connect, signing, release management, or production maintenance.



Relevant experience may include React Native, Flutter, native iOS, authentication, APIs, databases, push notifications, subscriptions, payments, analytics, and crash reporting. Screenshots, Figma designs, tutorials, local demos, and unfinished prototypes do not replace a live App Store application.



3. Client Websites

You will build polished, conversion-focused websites for our German clients, similar in quality to the work our current developer Raemer produces.



You should be comfortable with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, APIs, GitHub, and Vercel. Typical projects include responsive 5–10 page business websites, landing pages, lead forms, booking flows,
 notifications, CRM integrations, analytics, conversion tracking, technical SEO, and performance optimization.



You must have enough visual judgment to turn a brief or reference into an original, professional design without always receiving a complete Figma file. The result must be responsive, tested, maintainable, and ready for a real client—not an unfinished AI-generated prototype.



HOW WE WORK

• Use AI coding tools to increase speed while remaining responsible for the final result

• Research unfamiliar APIs and platforms independently

• Communicate blockers early and provide concise progress updates

• Connect billed hours to visible tasks and deliverables

• Test your own work before requesting review

• Deliver source code to agency-owned GitHub repositories

• Document setup, environment variables, integrations, and deployment

• Protect client information and credentials

• Do not subcontract work without approval



WHO SHOULD APPLY

We care more about shipped products, practical judgment, and problem-solving ability than formal titles. You should apply if you can demonstrate that you have built real products, understand the code you produce, and can figure out unfamiliar technical problems as you go.



Do not apply if your experience consists mainly of tutorials, certificates, school projects, copied templates, WordPress page building, or AI-generated demos that were never used in production.



APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS

Begin your application with the word BERLIN. Answer every question directly and number your answers. Generic applications without proof will be skipped.



1. Attach or link your current résumé/CV.

2. Provide direct links to all Apple App Store applications you personally helped build. For each app, state your exact contribution and the technologies used.

3. Did you personally handle TestFlight, App Store Connect, signing, releases, or production maintenance? Explain.

4. Provide a live demo, recording, or case study of an AI voice or telephone agent you built. State the telephony, voice, model, and integration stack.

5. Have you built a German-speaking call agent? If yes, provide evidence. If not, explain exactly how you would build and test one.

6. Explain how you would test German pronunciation, interruptions, dates, phone numbers, addresses, appointment booking, call transfers, and failure handling.

7. Provide at least five live websites you personally developed. Explain what you built on each website.

8. Describe your experience with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, Supabase, APIs, GitHub, and Vercel.

9. Which AI coding tools do you use, and describe one difficult problem you solved with them.

10. Give an example of a technology you did not know beforehand but successfully learned and shipped.

11. Confirm your time zone, weekly availability, expected compensation, and earliest starting date.



Portfolio ownership and technical claims will be verified during a live interview using hypothetical scenarios and discussion of your existing work. There is no paid trial task.

description:

The videos should look as if the person is sitting in front of a computer and being recorded through a normal webcam. I do NOT want a cinematic or overly polished camera look — the goal is realistic webcam-style footage.

In each video, the person should initially be looking naturally at the computer/screen and then suddenly react with a very surprised and happy/excited expression, as if they have just seen something amazing on their computer.



The most important requirements are:

• Strong experience with Higgsfield

• Experience creating realistic AI humans

• Excellent character consistency across many videos

• Ability to create natural facial expressions and believable reactions

• Ability to control camera angle, framing, lighting and movement

• Ability to reproduce a realistic webcam / computer-camera look

• Experience with AI video prompting and iteration

• Ability to mass-produce videos efficiently while maintaining consistent quality

title: Marketing and Data Specialist
description:
ABOUT INTERCEPTLY



Interceptly helps B2B companies find and start conversations with buyers who are already showing intent. We run signal-driven outbound campaigns for our clients and our partners' clients, and we build our own intent products, including LeadIntercept, which tracks competitor engagement at the individual level.



We are a small team that runs on AI. Most of our processes live as Claude Code skills in a shared Git repo, and our data lives in Airtable and GoHighLevel. You will be one of the people who keeps that machine running and makes it better.



THE ROLE



This is a hands-on role split across 2 areas:



1. Marketing in GoHighLevel and on our website. You own our GHL marketing setup, our blog and help center content, and our site's SEO health.

2. Data. You own the prospect data and intent signal data that feeds our clients' campaigns, from sourcing and cleaning it to classifying it in Airtable and loading it into live campaigns.



Claude Code sits across both. You will use it every day to write content, process data, and run our internal skills, and you will maintain and improve those skills as our processes change.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



GoHighLevel marketing and operations

- Own our GoHighLevel workspaces: contacts, custom fields, pipelines, tasks,
 templates, snippets, and workflows

- Complete our platform consolidation into GHL, including rebuilding onboarding and partner forms as GHL surveys and forms from existing build specs

- Build and maintain
 campaigns, broadcasts, and automation workflows (onboarding flows, check-ins, billing reminders, re-engagement)

- Publish and maintain help center articles in GHL and keep the support bot's knowledge base current

- Keep contact data clean and segmentable so marketing and client success can rely on it



Website, content, and SEO

- Write and publish blog posts on our WordPress site (Elementor), following our content calendar and brand voice

- Set Yoast meta titles and descriptions, featured images, categories, and internal links on every post

- Write and schedule company page social posts and share new content across the team's accounts

- Run regular Ahrefs site audits and fix what they find: broken links, redirects, canonicals, meta length, orphan pages, missing OG images

- Monitor Google Search Console for indexing problems and work through the fix list

- Keep product naming and brand rules consistent everywhere we publish



Data and intent signal operations

- Source and qualify prospect lists using sales intelligence tools against each client's ICP and campaign angles

- Clean, dedupe, and sense-check lists before they go anywhere near a live campaign

- Load qualified prospects into client campaigns in the Interceptly platform and track volumes per campaign

- Run our weekly intent signal cycle: assign and classify competitor engagement signals in Airtable, maintain signal views for each client, and share weekly signal reviews with clients

- Coordinate tracked profiles with our external platform team

- Investigate data quality problems (low match rates, excluded signals, missing records) and recommend filter or ICP changes

- Maintain our Airtable bases: views, fields, linked records, and campaign options



Claude Code and automation

- Use Claude Code daily to draft content, process data, update client files, and run our internal skills (blog publishing, signal classification, campaign content, presentation decks)

- Maintain and improve skills as processes change, commit changes to GitHub, and tell the team what changed

- Feed call transcripts and onboarding responses into our client knowledge base so client files stay current

- Spot manual, repeated work and turn it into a skill or workflow



Campaign support

- Help our campaign manager build and launch client campaigns, update campaign content and sequences, and format Gamma decks for client review

- Send routine client updates (new data added, signal summaries, campaign launches) when asked



A TYPICAL WEEK



- Every day: share your priorities in the morning and an end-of-day update with the team. Load new data into campaigns, handle GHL tasks, and push content forward.

- Midweek: intent signal assignment and weekly signal reviews for every active client.

- Weekly: at least one blog post published and shared, plus company page posts.

- Every 2 to 4 weeks: Ahrefs site audit and fixes.

- As needed: client calls alongside the campaign manager, new client onboarding data, skill updates.



WHAT YOU WILL NEED



Must have

- 2+ years in a marketing operations, data, or growth role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company or agency

- Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel, or a similar CRM and marketing automation platform such as HubSpot, with a willingness to get deep into GHL quickly

- Strong Airtable skills: views, filters, linked records, field types, and keeping a base tidy

- Regular use of Claude or another AI assistant for real work, not just casual prompts. You should be comfortable writing clear instructions, reviewing output critically, and catching mistakes

- WordPress experience, including publishing posts, working with a page builder (Elementor preferred), and handling SEO fields

- Working knowledge of technical SEO and a tool like Ahrefs or Semrush: you know what a canonical, a 301, and an orphan page are, and how to fix them

- Excellent written English. You will write content that goes out under our name

- Real attention to detail with data. Putting 500 wrong prospects into a campaign is worse than putting in none



Nice to have

- Experience with Claude Code, GitHub, or working from the command line

- Experience with B2B prospecting tools and building lists against an ICP

- Familiarity with intent data or outbound campaigns

- Gamma, Google Search Console, or Slack automation experience

- Some client-facing experience, or confidence to build it



HOW WE WORK



- We document everything. If you do something twice, it should end up in our knowledge base or a skill.

- We are async-first, but we expect daily overlap with UK hours for the team meeting and client work.

- You will get a structured handover, plus access to our SOPs, playbooks, and skills repo.

title: Real Estate Compliance & Transaction Support Virtual Assistant
description:
# Real Estate Compliance & Transaction Support Virtual Assistant



**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Industry:** U.S. Real Estate Brokerage  

**Position Type:** Virtual Assistant / Long-Term Opportunity



We are a growing U.S.-based real estate brokerage looking for an experienced **Virtual Assistant with real estate compliance and transaction-management experience** to join our team.



This is **not a general administrative VA position**. We are specifically looking for someone who has worked with U.S. real estate contracts, transaction files, brokerage compliance, or transaction coordination.



## Our #1 Differentiator: Maryland REALTORS® Forms Experience



The strongest candidates will have previous experience working with **Maryland REALTORS® forms, Maryland real estate contracts, disclosures, addenda, and transaction-compliance requirements**.



If you have worked with Maryland real estate transactions before, please make that very clear in your application and describe exactly what you handled.



Candidates with strong U.S. real estate compliance or transaction-coordination experience but no Maryland experience may still apply, but **Maryland REALTORS® forms experience will be given priority**.



## Primary Responsibilities



You will assist our brokerage and management team with transaction and compliance-related work, including:



- Reviewing real estate transaction files for completeness

- Reviewing contracts, addenda, disclosures, and brokerage-required documents

- Identifying missing signatures, initials, dates, disclosures, or documentation

- Following transaction compliance checklists

- Organizing and maintaining digital transaction files

- Communicating with agents regarding missing or incomplete documentation

- Tracking outstanding compliance items

- Assisting with contract-to-close administrative workflows

- Maintaining accurate records and transaction status updates

- Uploading, organizing, and managing documents within our transaction-management systems

- Assisting brokerage staff with administrative and operational projects as needed



## Required Experience



We are especially interested in candidates who have previous experience with:



- Maryland REALTORS® forms

- Maryland residential real estate contracts

- U.S. residential real estate transactions

- Real estate contracts and transaction paperwork

- Brokerage compliance

- Transaction coordination

- Reviewing real estate files for completeness

- Working with real estate agents, brokers, transaction coordinators, or compliance departments



## Technology Experience



Experience with the following systems is helpful:



**Preferred:**

- Dotloop



**Bonus Experience:**

- Follow Up Boss

- Google Workspace / Google Drive

- Gmail

- CRM systems

- Transaction-management software

- Electronic signature platforms

- Real estate brokerage back-office systems



You do not need to know every system, but you should be comfortable learning new technology quickly.



## The Person We Are Looking For



You should be:



- Extremely detail-oriented

- Organized and process-driven

- Comfortable reviewing contracts and documents

- Able to follow detailed compliance checklists

- Comfortable communicating professionally with U.S.-based real estate agents

- Able to identify missing information and follow up until it is resolved

- Reliable and responsive

- Able to work independently

- Comfortable asking questions when something does not look correct

- Able to protect confidential client and transaction information



Strong written English and professional communication skills are important.



## Schedule



We are looking for someone interested in a **long-term position** with our organization.



Some overlap with **U.S. Eastern Time business hours** will be required.



Specific hours and schedule can be discussed based on experience and availability.



## How to Apply



Please do **not** send us a generic application.



**IMPORTANT: Put the phrase “Maryland Compliance” in the subject line or first sentence of your application.**



Applications that do not include this phrase may not be considered.



Please answer the following questions:



1. Have you worked with **Maryland REALTORS® forms or Maryland real estate contracts**? If yes, please explain which forms or transaction documents you worked with and what your responsibilities were.



2. How many years have you worked in U.S. real estate?



3. Have you previously worked for a U.S. real estate brokerage, real estate team, transaction coordinator, or compliance department? Please describe your role.



4. What experience do you have reviewing transaction files for compliance?



5. What types of real estate contracts, disclosures, addenda, or transaction documents have you reviewed?



6. Which real estate transaction-management systems have you used?



7. Have you used **Dotloop**? If yes, approximately how long and what did you use it for?



8. Have you used **Follow Up Boss**? If yes, what did you use it for?



9. What is your current work situation? Are you currently working for another employer or client? If so, approximately how many hours per week?



10. What hours are you available to work, and how much overlap can you provide with U.S. Eastern Time?



11. What monthly or hourly compensation are you seeking?



12. Please provide a brief paragraph explaining why your previous experience makes you a strong fit for this specific role.



## About the Opportunity



We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted member of our team—not simply complete occasional VA tasks.



The right person will have the opportunity to learn our brokerage systems, become deeply involved in our transaction and compliance processes, and take on increasing responsibility over time.



If you already understand U.S. real estate transactions—and especially if you have experience with **Maryland REALTORS® forms and Maryland compliance workflows**—we would like to hear from you.

title: Warehouse & Order Fulfillment VA / Client support
description:
Warehouse & Order Fulfillment VA  (Full-Time)



To apply, start your message with the word BAGUETTE. Messages without it are ignored.



THE JOB IN ONE LINE

Every item we sell has to be registered with our warehouse the same day, or the parcel never ships and we lose the sale. That is your number one job, every day, before anything else.



WHAT YOU'LL DO, IN PRIORITY ORDER

1. Register every order with our warehouse the day it comes in — SKU, size, product sheet. Nothing gets skipped. If one order cannot be registered, you tell me the same day instead of moving on.

2. Log incoming supplier parcels: tracking number, contents, SKU.

3. Process outgoing orders: download shipping labels from our dashboard (DOTB) and create the shipment requests in the warehouse system.

4. Answer buyer messages that our auto-responder escalates, using ready-made reply templates that you adapt.

5. Handle disputes and returns (item not received, not as described) by following a written procedure. Escalate only what the procedure says to escalate — the rest is yours to solve.

6. Track returns so parcels actually make it back to the warehouse. This is where we lose the most money today.

7. Clean up old listings: rename titles, delete the ones that never sell.

8. Keep everything logged in a Google Sheet, and send me a short daily review every evening.



ABOUT THE BUSINESS

I buy fashion items and resell them on Vinted (a French second-hand marketplace) across several shops, with a fulfillment warehouse in Europe. The listings and photos are already handled by another assistant you'll work with directly. I need someone reliable on the operations side so I can focus on growth.



YOU NEED

- Good written English—we work in English. Buyer replies are in French, but you write them with ChatGPT or something else. No French needed; you just check the output makes sense.

- Reliable internet, quiet setup; available in a daily window overlapping the European afternoon (~1-7pm Paris time).

- Detail-oriented; comfortable with Google Sheets, web dashboards, and using ChatGPT.

- Calm and polite with unhappy customers; good judgment on when to escalate.

- Honest when you don't know something. I would far rather you ask me than guess — guessing costs real money here.

- Bonus: experience with Vinted, Depop, Poshmark, or e-commerce support.



HOW I WORK

- You get a written guide covering every task, plus video tutorials. You are not expected to figure it out alone.

- I answer questions fast. Ask me anything.

- Short daily review every evening: what you did, what is blocked, what you could not finish.

- Paid monthly, on time.



PAY

$
/month, full-time, reviewed after 1 month. 

Over time your salary can grow to 150 if the buisness also grow

 authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and deliverability troubleshooting.

title: Head of Marketing
description:
Head of Marketing — Hüga Collective



**Location:** Remote

**Type:** Full-time



Why We Exist



Hüga Collective was built on a simple belief: home should feel like a place you exhale in. We design hygge-inspired lighting — paper lamps, floor lamps, table lamps, and candle warmers — for people who want their space to feel warmer, slower, and more like *them*. We're not selling light fixtures. We're selling the feeling of coming home.



We're a small, fast-moving DTC brand, and we're looking for a Head of Marketing to become the strategic force behind everything we do next.



The Role



You'll be the marketing strategist and operator for the entire brand — the person who connects the dots between what we make, how we talk about it, and how we grow. You'll set direction, lead a small creative team, and get hands-on with the channels that drive our growth:
 and performance.



This is a builder's role. You'll have real ownership and a direct line to the founder.



### What You'll Own



- **Marketing strategy** — Set the roadmap across acquisition, retention, and brand, and make the calls on where we invest our time and budget.

- **Team leadership** — Oversee and direct our video editors and content designer, keeping creative output aligned with strategy and on brand.

- *
 marketing** — Strategize and create flows and campaign strategy (we run on Klaviyo), working alongside our designer contractor to keep the calendar sharp and revenue-driving.

- **Performance & growth content** — Lead ideation for ad creative and performance content, working closely with our creative team to turn insights into content that converts.

- **Influencer marketing** — Oversee our influencer strategy, from identifying the right partners to managing relationships and turning collaborations into content that performs.

- **Brand stewardship** — Make sure everything we put into the world sounds and feels like Hüga — warm, intentional, never generic.



## What You Bring



- **6+ years** in digital marketing, with real ownership of strategy — not just execution

- Proven experience marketing for an **ecommerce brand** (DTC strongly preferred)

- A track record of **managing or directing a creative team** (video editors, designers, contractors)

- Fluency in *
 marketing** — flows, segmentation, campaign strategy (Klaviyo experience a plus)

- A sharp eye for **performance/growth ad content** — you can ideate concepts that are built to convert, not just look nice

- Experience running or overseeing **influencer marketing**, from partner sourcing to relationship management

- **Fluent English**, written and spoken — you'll be shaping our voice

- You think like an owner. You see the whole board — brand, growth, team — and you know how to move all three forward at once.



## Why Hüga



- A brand with a clear point of view and room for you to shape where it goes next

- Direct access to leadership — your strategy becomes the strategy

- A small team that moves fast and cares deeply about the craft

- The chance to build the marketing function from a real leadership seat, not inherit someone else's playbook



---



*Hüga Collective is a home lighting brand built on the idea that comfort is a form of care. If that resonates with you — and you're ready to lead — we'd love to hear from you.*
