title: Video Editor and Graphic Designer
description:
About us



Hüga Collective makes hygge-inspired home lighting, centered on paper lamps that turn any room into the coziest corner of the house. We're a small, scrappy DTC team on Shopify, and social is how most people discover us. We're looking for someone who can make warm light stop the scroll.



The role



You'll be our go-to creative for short-form video and design. Working closely with our Marketing Manager, you'll turn content plans into Reels, TikToks, and graphics that people watch, share, and save. Our goal is simple: create content that goes viral and grows the brand. This isn't a "wait for a brief" role. We want someone who brings ideas, owns the outcome, and is always chasing the next breakout video.



What you'll do



- Partner with the Marketing Manager to plan and execute content, from monthly calendars to quick-turn trend reactions

- Pitch original creative concepts and formats, not just edit what you're handed

- Edit short-form video for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and paid social, from raw footage to a polished, platform-native cut

- Write multiple hook variations for each idea so we can test what works

- Build ad variations (different hooks, captions, pacing, CTAs) from a single shoot

- Design static and motion graphics: social posts, carousels, ad creatives, story frames, and on-screen text

- Track how your content performs, learn from it, and double down on what's working

- Keep up with trends, sounds, and formats, and know which ones fit a cozy lighting brand and which don't



Who you are



- Creative first. You have a constant stream of ideas and a point of view. You see a paper lamp and think of ten ways to film it.

- Ownership mindset. You treat our channels like your own. You don't stop at "delivered." You care whether it worked, and you figure out why when it didn't.

- Social native. You speak the language: hooks, pattern interrupts, pacing, captions, trending audio, UGC-style edits.

- Collaborative. You take feedback well, push back with good reasons, and make the Marketing Manager's plans better.

- Fast and organized. You can juggle multiple projects without dropping the quality bar.



What you bring



- 3+ years editing short-form social video, ideally for DTC or e-commerce brands

- A portfolio of Reels/TikToks you've edited, with view counts or results if you have them

- Strong graphic design skills and a good eye for typography and layout

- Proficiency in Premiere Pro or CapCut (After Effects is a plus) and Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva

- Taste. You know the difference between cozy and cluttered.



Nice to have



- At least one video you've made that went viral (tell us about it)

- Experience making paid social ad creative and testing variations

- A love of interiors, lighting, or slow-living aesthetics



How we'll measure success

First 90 days



Publishing 5 short-form videos per week across TikTok and Reels

Every concept delivered with at least 3 hook variations

Average 3-second hook rate of 25%+ across organic videos

At least one video reaching 5K+ views



First 6 months



At least one video reaching 20k+ views

20% growth in TikTok and Instagram followers

At least 10% of your ad creatives become top performers in our paid campaigns

A repeatable content format or series that consistently outperforms our average

WHO I'M LOOKING FOR

, and TikTok.

Most importantly, you should actually care whether the brand grows.



Experience managing a personal brand, entrepreneur, coach, creator, or business personality is strongly preferred.



HOW TO APPLY

title: Level 3 Network Architect
description:
Network Engineer (Level 3) — On-Call / As-Needed



Location: Fully Remote (Ph) Schedule: As needed. You will be contacted via WhatsApp when advanced tickets requiring these skills come through. Hours: Availability during US East Coast business hours (EST) when engaged Engagement Type: Ongoing as-needed contractor — this is not a full-time salaried position Compensation: [RATE TO BE INSERTED]



About T3 Tech Partners



T3 Tech Partners is a US-based company and the team MSPs rely on when challenges exceed Tier 2 or internal expertise. We operate as a Fractional Tier 3 partner, delivering advanced Systems Administration, infrastructure, cloud, network, and security expertise to MSPs supporting diverse client environments.



Our engineers are trusted technical partners — leading implementations, resolving complex escalations, and working directly with MSP clients to execute real-world solutions.



Role Overview



We are seeking a senior-level Network Engineer to serve as an on-call escalation resource for complex networking issues across our MSP partners' client environments.



This is an as-needed engagement, not a scheduled full-time role. When an advanced network ticket comes through that requires this skill set, we will reach out to you directly via WhatsApp. You are expected to acknowledge quickly and, when you accept the work, engage during US East Coast business hours until the issue is resolved or handed back.



This structure suits someone who already has a primary role or an independent consulting practice and wants additional senior-level work on a flexible basis. It does not suit someone who needs guaranteed weekly hours or predictable income.



This role requires strong technical depth, independence, and the ability to step into an unfamiliar network with limited documentation and orient yourself quickly.



Key Responsibilities

Advanced Network Escalation Support

Take ownership of advanced and expert-level network escalations passed up from MSP Tier 1 and Tier 2 teams.

Diagnose complex connectivity, performance, latency, and packet loss issues across LAN, WAN, and hybrid environments.

Perform root-cause analysis and implement durable fixes rather than temporary workarounds.

Work directly with MSP technicians and, where required, end customers to execute resolutions.

Document findings, changes made, and recommendations at the close of every engagement.

Firewalls & Network Security

Configure, troubleshoot, and optimize enterprise firewalls including Fortinet FortiGate, SonicWall, Cisco, Meraki, Palo Alto, and similar platforms.

Design and troubleshoot site-to-site IPsec VPNs, SSL VPNs, and remote access solutions.

Implement network segmentation, VLAN isolation, and access control policies.

Configure and tune IDS/IPS, content filtering, geo-blocking, and threat protection features.

Review and remediate firewall rule bases for security and performance.

Routing, Switching & Wireless

Configure and troubleshoot managed switching including VLANs, trunking, spanning tree, link aggregation, QoS, and PoE.

Work with static routing, policy-based routing, and dynamic routing protocols (OSPF, BGP) as environments require.

Deploy, tune, and troubleshoot enterprise wireless environments (Meraki, Ubiquiti, Ruckus, Aruba, Cisco).

Perform wireless coverage, roaming, interference, and density troubleshooting.

Diagnose DNS, DHCP, NAT, and IP addressing issues.

WAN, Circuits & Cloud Connectivity

Troubleshoot ISP circuits, hand-offs, and carrier issues, and manage escalations with providers.

Configure and support SD-WAN deployments, failover, and multi-WAN load balancing.

Build and troubleshoot hybrid connectivity into Azure, including virtual networks, VPN gateways, and site-to-site tunnels.

Support network requirements for Microsoft 365 workloads, including QoS for Teams voice and video.

Assist with network cutovers, ISP migrations, and office relocations.

Analysis & Documentation

Perform packet captures and protocol analysis (Wireshark or equivalent) to isolate difficult issues.

Produce or update network diagrams, IP schemes, and configuration documentation as part of engagement close-out.

Provide clear written summaries that an MSP Tier 2 technician can act on and learn from.

Recommend standards and long-term improvements to MSP partners where appropriate.

Availability & Engagement Expectations

You will be contacted via WhatsApp when a qualifying ticket comes in. Acknowledgement is expected within a reasonable window during US East Coast business hours.

You are free to decline any individual engagement, but consistent unavailability will end the arrangement.

When you accept an engagement, you are expected to work it through to resolution or to a clean hand-off.

Some work may fall outside standard hours for maintenance windows, cutovers, or critical outages. These are scheduled in advance where possible.

Volume varies. Some weeks will bring multiple escalations, others none.

Qualifications

Required Experience

5+ years of hands-on network engineering experience, with significant time in an MSP or multi-client environment.

Expert-level proficiency with enterprise firewall platforms (Fortinet, SonicWall, Cisco, Meraki, Palo Alto, or comparable).

Strong command of routing and switching fundamentals, VLANs, VPN technologies, and network troubleshooting methodology.

Demonstrated ability to resolve issues that Tier 2 teams could not.

Experience with packet capture and protocol-level analysis.

Comfort working in unfamiliar environments with incomplete documentation.

Excellent native-level English communication, written and verbal. You will be speaking directly with US-based MSP technicians and client stakeholders, often under pressure during an outage.

Reliable high-speed internet, a backup power source, and a quiet workspace suitable for client calls.

Proven experience working in MSP environments (required).

Preferred Experience

Relevant certifications (Fortinet NSE, Cisco CCNP, Meraki CMNA, Palo Alto PCNSE, or similar).

Azure networking and hybrid cloud connectivity experience.

SD-WAN design and deployment experience.

VoIP and unified communications network troubleshooting.

Familiarity with Microsoft 365 network requirements and optimization.

Scripting or automation experience for network configuration and auditing.

HOW TO APPLY



Please reply in the job post chat here on OnlineJobs.ph with the following:



Your resume or a link to it.

A specific example of a network escalation you resolved that another team could not. Describe the symptoms, how you isolated the cause, and what you did to fix it. Two or three paragraphs is enough. This is the part we read most closely.

The firewall platforms you have the deepest experience with, and roughly how many deployments you have worked on for each.

Your hourly rate in USD.

Confirmation that you can be reached via WhatsApp and can engage during US East Coast business hours.

Any relevant certifications, with dates.



Candidates who move forward will complete a live technical conversation over video. Please be prepared to talk through your troubleshooting approach without notes.

title: Staff Accountant
description:
Role: Part-Time Staff Accountant (U.S. Accounting, Inventory & Compliance)

Company: Michaud CPAs  

Employment: Part-time, long-term  

Hours: Approximately 15 hours per week  

Schedule: Working hours between 7:00 AM and 12:00 noon U.S. Eastern Time (EST/EDT)



About Us



Michaud CPAs is an accounting and fractional CFO firm providing outsourced accounting, financial reporting, and financial management services to growing U.S. businesses.



We are looking for an experienced, detail-oriented accountant to join our remote accounting team.



You will primarily support an established U.S. brewery business, working closely with our Accounting Team Lead and another bookkeeper.



This is a hands-on accounting position involving inventory accounting, account reconciliations, specialized excise tax reporting, and month-end close procedures.



We are looking for someone with strong accounting fundamentals who can work independently, investigate discrepancies, and take responsibility for completing assigned tasks accurately and on schedule.



Key Responsibilities



1. Inventory and Operational Accounting

- Prepare and review inventory reconciliations.

- Reconcile inventory records between operational systems and accounting software.

- Investigate inventory discrepancies and recommend adjustments.

- Assist with cost-of-goods-sold calculations and reconciliations.

- Prepare supporting schedules and journal entries.

- Identify unusual transactions and resolve accounting discrepancies.



2. Excise Tax and Regulatory Reporting

- Prepare recurring federal TTB excise tax calculations and filings relating to malt beverages, spirits, and wine/cider, as applicable.

- Prepare applicable Virginia ABC tax reports and related regulatory reporting.

- Reconcile tax calculations with inventory, production, and accounting records.

- Maintain accurate supporting schedules and documentation.

- Track filing deadlines and ensure that reports are prepared on time.

- Submit completed calculations and filing documentation for review and approval.



Previous experience with brewery excise tax reporting is an advantage but is not required. Training and established procedures will be provided.



This position does not involve preparing U.S. federal or state income tax returns.



3. Month-End Close and General Accounting

- Prepare assigned balance sheet reconciliations.

- Investigate and resolve differences between subsidiary records and general ledger balances.

- Prepare adjusting journal entries and supporting schedules.

- Assist with month-end accruals, prepayments, and other accounting adjustments.

- Support the Accounting Team Lead with monthly financial reporting.

- Maintain accurate records and complete assigned tasks according to the month-end close calendar.



4. Accounting Systems and Team Support

- Help investigate and resolve complex accounting system integration issues.

- Provide backup support for bookkeeping activities when necessary.

- Assist with reviewing transactions, researching discrepancies, and improving accounting processes.

- Maintain organized workpapers and clear documentation.

- Communicate proactively with the Accounting Team Lead regarding outstanding issues and approaching deadlines.



Required Qualifications



- Bachelor's degree in accounting or a related field.

- At least three years of professional accounting experience.

- Strong understanding of accrual accounting and financial statement preparation.

- Experience working with U.S.-based businesses or accounting firms.

- Demonstrated experience preparing account reconciliations and month-end journal entries.

- Experience with QuickBooks Online or comparable accounting software.

- Strong Microsoft Excel skills.

- Ability to investigate and independently resolve accounting discrepancies.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- Excellent attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.



Preferred Qualifications

- Five or more years of relevant accounting experience.

- Experience with inventory accounting, manufacturing, or cost-of-goods-sold reconciliations.

- Experience preparing indirect tax, excise tax, or other recurring regulatory filings.

- Experience reconciling information between multiple accounting and operational systems.

- Experience working with breweries, manufacturers, or other inventory-intensive businesses.

- Philippine CPA qualification is an advantage but is not required.



Work Schedule and Compensation



- Approximately 15 hours per week.

- Working hours must fall between 7:00 AM and 12:00 noon U.S. Eastern Time.

- Some flexibility in the distribution of weekly hours may be required, particularly during month-end close and regulatory filing periods.

- Compensation: $9–$12 USD per hour, depending on experience.

- Long-term opportunity with an established accounting firm.



We are looking for someone who can commit to a consistent schedule and accommodate the heavier accounting workload that occurs during the first half of each month.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Your résumé and a summary of your accounting experience.

2. Your experience working with U.S. businesses or accounting firms.

3. A description of your month-end close and balance sheet reconciliation experience.

4. Any experience with inventory accounting, cost of goods sold, excise taxes, or regulatory reporting.

5. Your experience with accounting software and system integrations.

6. Your expected hourly rate and weekly availability.

7. Confirmation that you can work during the required U.S. Eastern Time hours.



**Please also answer the following questions:**



Question 1: During month-end close, the inventory balance in the general ledger does not agree with the inventory valuation report from an operational system. Explain how you would investigate the discrepancy.



Question 2: You are responsible for preparing a recurring excise tax filing. The current month's reported quantities are significantly different from the previous month. What steps would you take before finalizing the filing?



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to an interview and a technical accounting assessment.

title: Content Creator & Video Editor for a Growing Real Estate Brand
description:
Bouvier Real Estate Group helps buyers, sellers, investors, and relocation clients make smart moves in two markets Saskatoon, Saskatchewan and Kelowna / Central Okanagan, British Columbia. Our brand is built on trust, hyper local expertise, and helping people build financial freedom through real estate.



Content is a core engine of our business, and we're looking for someone who wants to own our short form video presence and help us take it to the next level.



The Role



You'll be responsible for our short form content from idea to published post. That means researching what's working, editing videos that stop the scroll, and publishing 5 short form videos per week across:



Instagram Reels

TikTok


 Reels

YouTube Shorts



This role is strictly short form. Our long form YouTube content is handled separately.



We'll meet once a week to review performance, plan upcoming content, and align on priorities. Between meetings, you run the process independently.



What You'll Do



Editing & Production



Edit raw footage into engaging, fast paced short form videos with strong hooks, captions, text overlays, music, and B roll

Use AI tools to speed up editing, generate visuals, create AI assisted content, and test new formats

Optimize every video for retention, watch time, and each platform's best practices



Research & Ideation



Research top performing real estate and local content creators, and identify what's driving views

Track competitors in the Saskatoon and Kelowna markets

Research market updates, new real estate developments, city development projects, and local news worth covering

Bring fresh content ideas, hooks, and trends to each weekly meeting



Publishing & Management



Write captions, hashtags, and on screen text tailored to each platform

Schedule and post all videos across Instagram, TikTok,
, and YouTube Shorts

Maintain our content calendar and tracking in Google Sheets

using elevenlabs to do voice over proeprty tour videos 

Report on views, engagement, and follower growth, and use the data to improve what we post



What We're Looking For

Proven experience editing short form video (portfolio required)

Strong eye for hooks, pacing, and what makes people keep watching

Comfortable using AI tools for editing, scripting, research, and content generation

Proficient in Google Sheets

Strong research skills and genuine curiosity about trends, local news, and real estate

Self managed and reliable: you hit deadlines without being chased

Available for one weekly check in meeting



Bonus points for:



Experience with CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Descript, or similar

Experience growing accounts in real estate, finance, or local/lifestyle niches

Familiarity with Canva

Knowledge of Saskatoon or the Okanagan



Why Join Us

Flexible, remote, hourly work

Real creative ownership over a growing personal brand

Clear path to more hours and a full time role as the content grows

Work directly with the business owner, not through layers of management



How to Apply



Send the following with "Short Form Editor" in the subject line:



Your resume or a short intro about yourself

Links to 3 short form videos you've edited (and the views they got, if you know)

The AI tools you use most and how you use them

One real estate or local content account you think is crushing it, and why

title: Private Online Homeschool Teacher – Long-Term Position
description:
Private Online Homeschool Teacher – Long-Term Position



We are a U.S.-based family looking for a professional, caring, and energetic teacher from the Philippines to work with our daughter(s) as part of our homeschool program.



This is not a typical virtual assistant position. We are looking for someone with a genuine background in education who enjoys teaching children and can become a consistent part of their education long-term.

  - Reading and language arts

  - Mathematics

  - Science

title: Full-Time Video Editor – Direct Response Ecommerce Ads
description:
Full-Time Video Editor – Direct Response Ecommerce Ads

Growth Opportunity in a Global Jewelry Brand



We are looking for a full-time Video Editor to produce high-performing direct response ads for a fast-growing international jewelry brand.



You will be working directly on advertising content for a brand that sells to customers around the world. Your videos will be used in real marketing campaigns reaching millions of people.

- Comfortable handling a high daily production volume

title: Full-Time Wedding Highlight Film Editor - Garrett Museau Photography & Cinematography
description:
Wedding Highlight Film Editor



Garrett Museau Photography & Cinematography



Position: Wedding Highlight Film Editor

Work Type: Full-Time 

Work Arrangement: Remote

Production Volume: Minimum 1 wedding film per week



About the Role



Garrett Museau Photography & Cinematography is looking for a talented and reliable Wedding Highlight Film Editor to join our post-production team.



The ideal candidate has a strong eye for storytelling, pacing, music, emotion, and cinematic visuals. You will take professionally captured wedding footage and transform it into polished approximately 10-minute highlight films that capture the emotion, energy, and story of each couple's wedding day.



This role is ideal for an editor who understands wedding cinematography and can work independently while consistently meeting deadlines and maintaining the creative quality of our brand.



Key Responsibilities



- Edit at least one wedding highlight film per week

- Create approximately 10-minute cinematic wedding highlight films

- Review and organize large amounts of wedding footage

- Build a compelling story from the wedding day from preparation through reception

- Select the strongest and most emotionally impactful footage

- Create smooth, cinematic transitions and pacing

- Sync and edit dialogue, vows, speeches, interviews, and natural audio

- Incorporate music to enhance the emotion and storytelling

- Perform professional color correction and color grading

- Clean and mix dialogue, speeches, vows, music, and ambient audio

- Maintain consistent visual and audio quality throughout each film

- Incorporate drone footage and multiple camera angles when applicable

- Create engaging opening sequences and memorable endings

- Export final films in formats appropriate for YouTube and other platforms

- Create YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and other short-form social media content from wedding footage

- Make revisions based on creative direction and client requirements

- Maintain organized project files and media

- Communicate consistently regarding project status, deadlines, and revisions



Required Qualifications



- Extensive knowledge and experience with DaVinci Resolve

- Proven experience editing wedding films, highlight films, or cinematic event films

- Ability to consistently complete at least one approximately 10-minute film per week

- Strong understanding of cinematic storytelling and visual pacing

- Strong knowledge of color correction and professional color grading

- Strong audio editing and mixing skills

- Ability to work with multi-camera footage

- Experience working with high-resolution footage and large media files

- Ability to create engaging YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels

- Strong attention to detail

- Excellent time-management and organizational skills

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

- Reliable communication and responsiveness



Preferred Qualifications



- Experience editing Sony camera footage

- Experience working with S-Log/S-Log3 and other log footage

- Experience with LUTs and professional color workflows

- Experience editing drone footage

- Experience with cinematic wedding storytelling

- Understanding of social media trends and short-form video pacing

- Previous experience working with professional wedding photography/cinematography companies

- Portfolio demonstrating wedding films and/or cinematic event work



What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who can tell a story, not simply assemble clips.



Our ideal editor understands that a great wedding film should feel emotional, intentional, and cinematic. You should know how to build anticipation, create emotional moments, use speeches and vows effectively, and maintain the viewer's attention throughout the entire film.



Reliability is extremely important. We need an editor who can consistently take on a minimum of one film per week, meet established deadlines, communicate throughout the editing process, and maintain a high standard of quality from project to project.



Portfolio Requirement



Applicants should provide a portfolio showcasing their editing abilities.



Please include:



- Wedding highlight films

- Cinematic event films, if applicable

- Short-form content/Reels/YouTube Shorts

- Examples demonstrating color grading

- Examples demonstrating audio editing

- Any other work that demonstrates your storytelling ability



Equipment & Software



Required:



- DaVinci Resolve — advanced/extensive proficiency

- Reliable computer capable of handling professional 4K video editing

- Reliable high-speed internet connection

- Adequate storage and backup capabilities for large video projects



Please submit:



- Resume or brief professional background

- Editing portfolio

- At least 2–3 wedding films or relevant cinematic projects

- Examples of Reels/Shorts, if available

- Your experience with DaVinci Resolve

- Your typical turnaround time for a 10-minute wedding highlight film

- Your weekly editing capacity

- Your preferred rate per film



Garrett Museau Photography & Cinematography is looking for a long-term editing partner who can become an integral part of our post-production team and help us deliver beautiful wedding films to our couples consistently and professionally.

title: Web Delivery Lead (Web and Dev Project Manager)
description:
Web Delivery Lead (Web and Dev Project Manager)

Remote, Philippines | Full time, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern, Monday to Friday | English C1/C2 required



ABOUT TIER3 MEDIA

Tier3 Media is a US digital marketing agency for medical aesthetics practices: med spas, dermatologists and plastic surgeons. We build and run their websites, SEO and paid media, with a web fleet of more than 100 live client sites.



THE ROLE

You will own every web project from the day a client signs to the day the work is live and checked. You lead the people who build it: designers, a copywriter, a QA tester and a web support specialist. You work alongside our Head of Web Development, who owns how sites are built. You own what ships, when, and that the client always knows where things stand.



This is not a passive project manager role. You will not do the building yourself, but you need to understand the web development process from beginning to end well enough to problem solve with the team: spot why a task is stuck, ask the right technical question, weigh a fix with a developer, and make the call.



Our pipeline grew faster than the system behind it. Today a small edit can take weeks, and too many tasks wait in a queue without an owner or a date. We are also moving to an AI-assisted delivery process: call transcripts become a project brief, the brief splits into AI tasks and human tasks, and a person checks every risky step. You will run that process by hand while it is being built, so the load will be heavy for a while. We would rather you hear that now.



THE PROCESS YOU WILL RUN, END TO END

Discovery and kickoff, sitemap and content plan, SEO requirements, wireframes and design, copy, development, forms and CRM routing, QA and accessibility, launch (DNS, SSL, redirects, tracking), post-launch fixes, and ongoing edits and hosting. You should be able to explain what happens at each step, what usually goes wrong, and who fixes it.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Make sure every open web commitment has one owner, a next date and a clear definition of done.

- Solve problems with the team when work stalls: diagnose the blocker with the developer or designer, agree the fix and the date, and move on the same day.

- Assign every request within one business day, and get small edits closed in 5 business days or less.

- Lead the kickoff call for every new website build, send the brief back within two business days, and get the scope signed before work starts.

- Send every active client a written weekly update in plain English, with dates, so no client ever has to ask for status.

- Protect live client sites: nothing (forms, lead capture, URLs, pages) changes outside the approved scope without written sign-off.

- Close nothing without proof: a live link, a screenshot, or a test form submission landing in the CRM.

- Publish a short web scorecard every Monday that anyone in the company can read.

- Run weekly one-on-ones, give direct feedback, and hire our next QA tester.

- Keep every client login in the password manager, never in tasks or chat.



REQUIREMENTS

- English at C1/C2 level, spoken and written. You will lead US client calls and write to clients every week. We also assess English live in every interview.

- A bachelor's degree, ideally in business, communications, marketing, IT, computer science or a related field. A PMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum or similar certification is a plus.

- 4+ years leading web or digital delivery at an agency, with a delivery process you built and the numbers before and after.

- Experience leading people: coaching, giving hard feedback, and making staffing decisions.

- Hands-on use of AI in real delivery work, or experience delivering alongside people who build with it, and you can show how you catch its mistakes.

- Deep working knowledge of the full web development process, from discovery to launch to maintenance, so you can manage every moving part and problem solve with developers and designers. That includes WordPress and Elementor, page builders and themes, managed hosting, staging to live, forms and CRM routing, DNS and SSL, redirects, site speed, and launch checklists.

- A major plus: hands-on web development experience, SEO experience, or both (site structure, on-page SEO, redirects and migrations, technical SEO basics).

- ClickUp or a similar project management tool.

- Calm and organized when clients are upset and the queue is long.



YOU ARE NOT A FIT IF

- You manage by passing messages along and waiting. If you cannot follow a technical conversation with a developer, this seat is not for you.

- You would rather build than lead. If more than 30% of your ideal week is hands-on work, this seat will frustrate you.

- You prefer long sprints, ceremonies and change boards. We run same-day triage across many small sites.

- Your instinct on a small problem is a big change on a live site.

- You either avoid AI or trust its output without checking.

- You are an agency owner, or can only work part time.



HOW TO APPLY

Send:

1. Your resume or LinkedIn profile, including your degree and school.

2. A recorded Loom video of 3 minutes or less, in English, introducing yourself as if you were opening a kickoff call with a new client.



Start your application with the words "DELIVERY LEAD" so we know you read this far.



OUR PROCESS

1. Review of your application and recording.

2. A recorded first interview of about 45 minutes, same questions for every candidate, including a short kickoff call role play.

3. A deeper second interview plus a paid 90 minute work sample. (Possibly)

4. Reference calls, including someone who reported to you.

title: Senior Web Developer, Head of Web Development (AI + WordPress)
description:
Senior Web Developer, Head of Web Development (AI + WordPress)

Remote, Philippines | Full time, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern, Monday to Friday | $2,000 to $3,500 USD per month



ABOUT TIER3 MEDIA

Tier3 Media is a US digital marketing agency for medical aesthetics practices: med spas, dermatologists and plastic surgeons. We build and run their websites, SEO and paid media. Our fleet is more than 100 live client sites, most on WordPress, some of them a decade old.



THE ROLE

You will run web development at Tier3: the code, the platforms, the hosting and the developers. Most of all, you will lead our move to building websites with AI.



AI has changed how fast a good site can be built. One of our tests produced a full practice site in under 40 minutes, work that took about two days in the old page-builder workflow. We need someone to make that speed dependable: pages that look like the client and not like a template, that the next person can edit without breaking, on whatever platform the client needs. At the same time, 100+ legacy sites have to stay fast, secure and online. You own both.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

AI-built websites

- Build and rebuild client sites with AI every week, using agentic coders (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar), other LLMs, AI design and site generators, and MCP connectors.

- Own one documented AI build workflow that ships to WordPress (Elementor 4 or block themes), code-first sites (Next.js or Astro on Vercel) and GoHighLevel landing pages.

- Check AI output before it ships and keep the results editable by the people who maintain them.



Platforms and stack

- Pick the right platform for each client and write down why.

- Deliver a written stack recommendation, backed by a pilot, within your first 45 days.

- Keep all code and themes in git with staging and review.



WordPress fleet and legacy clients

- Keep every site fast, secure and online: updates, backups, monitoring, malware response.

- Fix recurring problems at the root.

- Maintain older builds (Elementor and other page builders, custom themes, plugins) without rebuilding what does not need it.

- Finish our hosting migration to WP Engine. Own DNS, Cloudflare, SSL and access, with every credential in a password manager.



Quality

- Write the definition of done and make sure every publish passes QA.

- Treat forms, lead routing, URLs and DNS as protected: staging first, written sign-off, tested before closing.

- Hold builds to Lighthouse mobile 90+ and WCAG 2.2 AA.



Leadership

- Lead two web developers now, plus a web support specialist once hired.

- Teach the AI workflow until each developer ships AI-assisted builds on their own.

- Run weekly one-on-ones, review code and give direct feedback.

- Work with our AI engineer and our Web Delivery Lead (who owns client scope and dates).



YOU ARE A FIT IF

- You build with AI every week and can show recordings of real builds on at least two platforms.

- You know WordPress deeply: themes, PHP, plugins, Elementor and other builders, block themes, hosting, migrations, DNS and security.

- You have shipped on code-first stacks (Next.js, Astro, Vercel) or headless CMSs and know when each is the right call.

- You use git, staging and code review by default.

- You have led or mentored developers.

- You can explain a technical tradeoff in plain English.



YOU ARE NOT A FIT IF

- Your AI experience is demos, not production sites.

- You know one tool and bend every project to fit it.

- You would rewrite every legacy site on a new stack.

- You would rather code alone than lead people.

- You skip QA when deadlines get tight.

- You are an agency owner, or can only work part time.



HOW TO APPLY

Send:

1. Your resume and/or LinkedIn profile.

2. Links to screen recordings (10 to 20 minutes each) of you building or rebuilding a real web page with AI, end to end, on at least two platforms, one of them WordPress. Loom or unlisted YouTube is fine.

3. A link to a git history you wrote (GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket).

4. Up to five sites you built or maintained, with your role and the dates.

Start your application with the words "AI BUILDER" so we know you read this far.



Applications without recordings will not be reviewed. We check the sites you list before any call.



OUR PROCESS

1. Review of your recordings and sites.

2. A 30 minute interview, same questions for every candidate.

3. A deeper second interview plus a paid 3 hour work sample. (Possible)

4. Reference calls, including someone who reported to you.

title: WE’RE HIRING: Full-Time Photo Editor + Digital Asset Organizer

We are looking for a talented, efficient, and highly organized Photo Editor to join our team full time.

You should be very comfortable working in Adobe Lightroom and managing large volumes of photos without becoming disorganized.



What You’ll Be Doing



• Editing large batches of dog and puppy photos in Adobe Lightroom

• Adjusting exposure, white balance, cropping, straightening, and overall image quality

• Creating a consistent editing style across thousands of photos

• Selecting the strongest photos from large photo sessions

• Identifying blurry, duplicate, poorly composed, or unusable images

• Organizing photos into clearly labeled folders

• Managing and maintaining our photo library in Dropbox

• Renaming and categorizing files so photos are easy for our team to find

• Keeping folders organized by dog, litter, date, category, or project

• Preparing photos for our website, social media, marketing, and other uses

• Paying close attention to small details such as expressions, eye contact, positioning, background distractions, and overall presentation

• Working quickly while still maintaining high-quality standards



We Are Looking for Someone Who Is:



• Highly experienced with Adobe Lightroom

• Very comfortable working with Dropbox

• Extremely organized

• Fast and efficient with large batches of photos

• Detail-oriented

• Dependable and consistent

• Able to work independently without constant supervision

• Good at following systems and keeping files organized

• Someone with a strong visual eye who can recognize what makes a photo beautiful

• Comfortable working with a very large photo library



You will be looking at a lot of adorable dogs and puppies, so it definitely helps if you enjoy animals!



A Big Plus



Experience with YouTube video editing is a major bonus.



In the future, we would love for this person to potentially help with:



• Editing educational YouTube videos

• Creating polished video content

• Organizing video footage

• Cutting long-form videos

• Adding captions, transitions, music, and graphics

• Helping us create consistent visual content across our brand



You do not have to be an expert video editor to apply, but experience with YouTube or video editing will make you stand out.



Position Details



Full-Time Position



This is not a temporary project. We have thousands of existing photos and continuously create new photography, so there will be ongoing work.



We are looking for someone who wants a stable, long-term position and can become an important part of our creative team.



Pay will depend on experience, speed, organization, and portfolio quality, with opportunities for growth as your responsibilities increase.



How to Apply



Please send us:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your experience with Adobe Lightroom

3. Before-and-after examples of photos you have edited

4. Your experience organizing large photo libraries

5. Your experience with Dropbox

6. Any experience you have editing YouTube videos

7. Which video-editing programs you are comfortable using

8. Your expected hourly or monthly salary

9. Your availability and preferred working hours



Important: Start your application with the words “LIGHTROOM + DOGS” so we know you carefully read the entire job posting.



Applicants who move forward may be given a small paid photo-editing test so we can see your editing style, speed, attention to detail, and organization.



If you love photography, organization, creative work, and animals, we would love to hear from you.

title: Video Creator + Editor (AI UGC, Editing, Scripting)
description:

What you'll do



Write scripts and hooks for direct response video (15 to 45 seconds)

Edit real footage: crew B-roll, customer-shot UGC, and talking head content

Produce AI UGC with tools like Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, Kling, and Seedance (we already have accounts and a trained avatar ready to go)

Design static ads and carousels

Turn one winning concept into 10+ variations: new hooks, new first 3 seconds, new CTAs, new formats

Review the numbers with us (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, cost per lead, cost per booked job) and iterate on what's working



How to Apply: Sample Ad Required



This is a serious opportunity. We're spending six figures a month on Meta and we need a weapon, so every applicant has to show us what they can do before we talk.



The brief: our client is one of the biggest moving companies in the US, and they only do long distance, out of state moves. Research the market, write the script, and produce a finished AI UGC ad for them. Here's an example of the style we're working with: 
 



CTA = Click the button to get a free quote / moving cost calculator 



Who you're talking to: middle-aged homeowners (think 35 to 55) with a 2+ bedroom house who are moving their whole household to another state. Tools: use whatever you want.



Send us:



Your edited final sample

A few lines on who the ad targets, why you chose that hook, and what tools you used

Your portfolio, with spend and results on past ads wherever you can share them

Your availability: hours per week, time zone, and when you can start

Why we should hire you 



Start your proposal with the word "POTATO" so we know you actually read this.



Generic proposals get skipped.

title: Senior SEO, Web Ops & Social Search Strategist (Multi-Brand & SaaS) – Fast-Growing Role
description:
Job Title:  Senior SEO, Web Ops & Social Search Strategist (Multi-Brand & SaaS) – Fast-Growing Role CDT



Company Overview:

We operate a high-growth portfolio of businesses in Middle Tennessee, including a corporate and ALE insurance relocation housing brand, an exclusive venue for retreats and private events, and a construction and real estate firm. *(Note: Exact brand names are kept confidential in this posting to prevent spam and will be shared with shortlisted candidates during the interview process).* We are also launching a new GoHighLevel-based SaaS company. Our infrastructure relies heavily on custom subdomains, government contracting pages, and automated funnels.



Role Overview:**

We are seeking an autonomous, senior-level SEO, Web Operations, and Social Search Strategist to take complete ownership of our organic visibility and technical web management. We are looking for a dedicated, long-term team member.



You will be managing our internal brands and handling technical onboarding/updates for our new SaaS clients. We need a dual-threat strategist who understands Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): executing deep technical site architecture inside GoHighLevel while systematically seeding social search and brand signals across platforms so AI engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI) actively recommend our businesses.



Adaptability & Growth Requirement:

Because we operate a fast-growing portfolio, things are always changing and evolving. You will frequently learn new systems and take on new types of tasks. Please note: your hourly baseline pay comprehensively covers all evolving responsibilities, ad-hoc tasks, and training periods. There is no additional pay for learning new skills or adapting to new operational requirements within your scheduled hours.



Compensation, Benefits & Uncapped Bonuses



*Base Pay:* $4.00 to $5.00 / hour. (Your starting rate will be determined by the experience and strategic depth you demonstrate during our messaging and vetting process).

*First-Month "Specialist Test" Bonus:* We are offering a one-time **$100.00 bonus** if four or more of our business websites are successfully audited and technically optimized within your first 30 days. This is our way of testing and rewarding a true specialist.

Long-Term Benefits:** As a long-term team member, you will receive a **$30/month health insurance (HMO) stipend** after 6 months of employment, and **13th-Month Pay** after 12 months.

Time Tracking:** Mandatory TimeProof tracking. All working hours must be logged using active desktop tracking with screenshot verification. Zero exceptions.

Monthly Performance Bonus:** Up to $100.00 USD extra every month, broken down into four clear $25 milestone targets:

15-Minute Response Time (+$25):* Immediate acknowledgement to all messages (Slack, WhatsApp, GoHighLevel) during scheduled shift hours.

Attendance & Punctuality (+$25):* Zero unexcused absences, zero missed meetings, 100% on-time arrival.

Task Speed & Turnaround (+$25):* All assigned technical tickets, client SaaS updates, and landing page audits completed on or ahead of deadline.

Core Search Metric KPIs (+$25):* Hitting monthly milestones (e.g., zero indexing errors, weekly GBP geo-tagged uploads).





Uncapped B2B Performance Bonuses (Targeting $8/hr Average):

Beyond your hourly base and monthly KPI bonuses, you will earn commission:



Tiered Ranking Bonus: $15.00 for every block of 5 primary commercial keywords (e.g., "Middle Tennessee corporate housing", "ALE insurance rentals") successfully maintained in the Top 3 organic positions on Google with lead flow.

* **Booked Lead Bonus:** $10.00 for every qualified B2B/corporate lead generated through your search and social efforts that successfully books with us. *(Note: This is a team effort—your role is to drive the highly targeted traffic and capture intent via our automated GoHighLevel funnels, and our internal team works to close the placement).*



*option to team partnership draw pay  at events and shows



**Key Focus Areas & Responsibilities**
